title_en: Micro inverter supervision control method and system based on Internet of things data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of micro-inverters, and discloses a micro-inverter supervision control method and a micro-inverter supervision control system based on Internet of things data, wherein the operation situation is judged by acquiring multidimensional environment parameters such as temperature, illumination intensity, power grid load and the like, extracting characteristics and identifying modes; the method comprises the steps of carrying out weighted fusion on heterogeneous data by adopting multivariate time sequence analysis and Kalman filtering, determining the credibility of a data source through information entropy calculation, carrying out anomaly detection, dynamically adjusting data fusion weights according to anomaly scores, constructing a control decision matrix based on operation scenes and anomaly degrees, carrying out intelligent adjustment on inverter output by adopting a fuzzy logic controller, and continuously optimizing operation parameters through feedback control to realize efficient and stable operation of the micro inverter. The invention can effectively cope with complex and changeable photovoltaic power generation environments, and improves the system reliability and the power generation efficiency.
assignees: SHENZHEN JINSICHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source public opinion data processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source public opinion data processing method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting public opinion data from at least two heterogeneous data sources, and obtaining source credibility weight and dynamic transmission heat index of each piece of data; the method comprises the steps of generating comprehensive priority scores based on a multidimensional fusion strategy of an attention mechanism, dividing data into a plurality of priority processing queues according to the scores, configuring an adaptive sampling rate for each queue, extracting multi-modal characteristics from representative samples in each queue, inputting a multi-modal analysis model, outputting emotion polarity, topic labels and credibility estimation values, deducing a plurality of indexes of non-sampled data by adopting a graph neural network semantic propagation model based on analysis results of the representative samples, and finally generating a multi-source public opinion situation map and outputting early warning signals. The invention can realize the efficient, accurate and self-adaptive processing of the multi-source public opinion data, and remarkably improve the efficiency and decision support capability of public opinion analysis.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF RADIN AMERICAS CHINESE ACADEMY OF SOC

title_en: Medical data multisource fusion checking and correcting method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical data processing, and discloses a medical data multisource fusion checking and correcting method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource data; the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic baseline model of emergency departments, ICUs and general wards, responding to and checking abnormal conditions of patient data and early warning, establishing a term library, carrying out multi-source fusion on the patient data acquired by a plurality of sources and carrying out data correction, generating multi-source data quality evaluation tables of different departments based on full-flow data, and updating the term library and fusion correction weights based on feedback of the quality evaluation tables. The invention can timely find and correct the quality problem in the data by the real-time monitoring and intelligent early warning mechanism, reduce human errors and greatly reduce the data management cost. Through multi-source data fusion and consistency verification, the system can ensure seamless docking of data from different data sources, and realize cross-system and cross-platform data consistency and collaborative work, so that the accuracy of medical decision and the reliability of data are improved.

title_en: Open-air geological survey monitoring system based on remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction, in particular to a field geological investigation monitoring system based on remote sensing data, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a multi-source data fusion module, a deep learning model module and an early warning module, wherein the data acquisition module, the data preprocessing module, the multi-source data fusion module, the deep learning model module and the early warning module are sequentially connected. Through the sequential connection of the modules, the system realizes the closed loop from data acquisition to analysis to early warning, and ensures the integrity, real-time performance and accuracy of the data. The data preprocessing module eliminates the interference of the source data while guaranteeing the data quality, and the fusion module promotes the synergistic effect of the multi-source data through an intelligent algorithm. The high-precision prediction of the deep learning model module ensures the timeliness and effectiveness of disaster early warning. Timely response of the early warning module helps related departments to do disaster prevention and reduction work, and risks brought by geological disasters are effectively reduced.
assignees: GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY TEAM SHANDONG BUREAU OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Mountain fire spreading dynamic prediction method based on meteorological data and geographic information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain fire spreading dynamic prediction method based on meteorological data and geographic information, which relates to the technical field of dynamic monitoring, and comprises the steps of acquiring real-time meteorological data through a meteorological station and a satellite, acquiring geographic information by utilizing a GIS technology to form a real-time meteorological information group, then denoising, outlier processing and normalizing preprocessing the data to ensure data quality and consistency, establishing an ARIMA model to predict time sequence meteorological data, calculating the gradient, slope direction and roughness of the terrain by a digital elevation model, predicting flame spreading speed related information through a Rothermel fire spreading model, finally fusing multi-source information by using a Bayesian network to acquire fire spreading probability P (F|X, Y), dividing and iterating training a training set and a testing set, and accurately predicting the spreading path and risk level of the mountain fire in real time, and providing a detailed spreading path diagram, risk early warning information, a resource allocation scheme and an emergency plan.
assignees: STATE GRID POWER SPACE TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Chinese herbal medicine full-link tracing anomaly detection method based on graph propagation and trust score
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and tracing, and discloses a traditional Chinese medicine full-link tracing anomaly detection method based on graph propagation and trust grading, which comprises the following steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data of a traditional Chinese medicine full-link, and constructing a tracing map containing traditional Chinese medicine circulation entity nodes and association side relations; and carrying out parallel detection on the nodes to be detected in the traceability map by utilizing a sub-model library to obtain original anomaly scores of multiple dimensions, and calculating self-adaptive fusion weights according to the characteristic adaptation degree of the sub-model and the nodes to be detected. By introducing the self-adaptive fusion weight in the local abnormal refining step, the system can automatically promote the weight of the sub-model sensitive to the high risk features, so that the system can dynamically identify and preferentially acquire the optimal model aiming at the current data features, and the problem of insufficient robustness of the traditional static fusion method in the face of diversified abnormal modes is avoided.
assignees: GUANGDONG PAOHE CHINESE HERBAL MEDICINE E COMMERCE CO LTD

title_en: Trans-regional flood risk prediction management system and method based on federal learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a federal learning-based trans-regional flood risk prediction management system and a federal learning-based trans-regional flood risk prediction management method, which relate to the technical field of flood risk prediction and comprise a trans-regional data acquisition module for acquiring multi-source flood observation data in a distributed mode and attaching a credibility label; the system comprises a coherent analysis clustering module, a joint prediction analysis module, a decision write-back module and a decision write-back module, wherein the coherent analysis clustering module calculates coherent correlation coefficients among monitoring stations based on weighted Pearson correlation coefficients, performs topological consistency clustering by combining physical connectivity and relationship stability, the joint prediction analysis module adopts a federal learning mode to train a flood risk prediction model based on clustering results, fuses a statistical channel and a physical channel to perform joint prediction, judges and optimizes simulation input through a leading boundary, and the decision write-back module generates multi-level early warning and targeted scheduling suggestions according to predicted values and writes back execution data to realize closed loop optimization. The problem of insufficient flood prediction precision under the heterogeneous and privacy protection of the trans-regional data is solved, and precise, efficient and safe trans-regional flood risk prediction management is realized.

title_en: Intelligent airport periphery safety monitoring method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of safety precaution, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring the security of an intelligent airport enclosure. The method comprises the steps of collecting monitoring information through a multi-type sensor array, carrying out time synchronization processing to obtain multi-source synchronous monitoring data, carrying out space registration and noise reduction processing on the data, generating situation fusion data according to sensor reliability configuration weights, extracting space-time characteristics to construct intrusion characteristic features to obtain threat assessment results, determining early warning grades and matching response measures to form a treatment scheme, obtaining an optimal prevention and control scheme through situation deduction, optimizing monitoring parameters according to execution data, and generating an updated monitoring strategy. The application realizes accurate identification and quick response to the security threat of the periphery through intelligent analysis and fusion processing of the multi-source data.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BAIYUN INT AIRPORT CONSTRUCTION AND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Geological survey data analysis system and method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological survey data analysis system and a geological survey data analysis method based on multi-source data fusion, and relates to the technical field of data analysis; the method comprises the steps of calculating similarity of a real-time environment feature matrix and each type of geological data in a knowledge base, selecting and judging to obtain a real-time survey geological type, calculating data fusion weights of the real-time survey geological type by using quality scores and correlations, carrying out weighted fusion on real-time data streams when surveying geology by using the calculated data fusion weights, calculating abnormal thresholds of different types of geology according to different types of geological historical survey data and carrying out standardization to generate an abnormal threshold database, extracting the abnormal threshold of the real-time survey geological type from the abnormal threshold database, judging the fusion data by using the abnormal threshold to obtain whether the real-time survey geology is abnormal or not and carrying out early warning.
assignees: SHANDONG GOLD GROUP INT MINING DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multisource data fusion supervision system for geological disaster management engineering
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster engineering supervision, and particularly discloses a multi-source data fusion supervision system for geological disaster management engineering, which is characterized in that the real-time acquisition, multi-protocol analysis, high-precision time synchronization, advanced denoising, missing value interpolation, outlier filtering and preliminary feature extraction of data are realized at a data source end, so that the data quality and the real-time performance are remarkably improved, and the processing load of a central platform is reduced; the real-time state mapping of the physical world and the virtual space and the recognition and correction scheme matching of the abnormal result of the disaster management project realize the matching of the multistage early warning linkage and the automatic emergency plan, provide visual and comprehensive visual display and decision support, greatly improve the supervision efficiency, early warning accuracy and emergency response speed, provide reliable technical guarantee for the safe and stable operation of the geological disaster management project, and effectively reduce the disaster risk and economic loss.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR DADI ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Three rainfall sensor data fusion calculation method, system and terminal
abstract_en: The application relates to a data fusion calculation method, a system and a terminal of three rainfall sensors, which are implemented by the following steps: acquiring minute rainfall values and hour rainfall values of three rainfall sensors, judging and calculating effective hour rainfall values according to four conditions, calculating reliable effective minute rainfall, and respectively outputting corresponding states of the three rainfall sensors; the observation data quality is greatly improved through the multi-sensor fusion observation practice of rainfall, more accurate rainfall observation data is provided for early warning and forecasting service, and the continuity of the data is ensured; on the other hand, the data state is identified through the computer background program, so that timely guidance is provided for equipment fault processing, the comprehensive popularization value is realized, meanwhile, experience is accumulated for next-step intelligent observation, the comprehensive intelligent direction is observed on the ground, and the method is worthy of further research of observation business personnel.

title_en: Medical clinical data quality analysis method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical clinical data quality analysis method and system based on a knowledge graph, and relates to the technical field of medical data analysis; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic medical field knowledge graph integrating a medical ontology and a semantic relation, accessing multi-source heterogeneous clinical data into the graph through entity link and standardized mapping, generating a personal data subgraph containing time sequence information for each patient, realizing deep discovery and accurate positioning of quality problems of known contradictions and unknown modes by combining logic reasoning based on a semantic rule base and anomaly detection based on a graph neural network, generating a targeted restoration scheme by utilizing traceability of the graph, quantitatively scoring quality problems and feeding the quantitative scoring to the graph to form closed loop management.
assignees: BEIJING FANGSHENG YUANLIN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Traffic infrastructure time sequence data quality discriminating and enhancing method based on artificial intelligent neural network
abstract_en: The invention designs a traffic infrastructure time sequence data quality anomaly detection method and a data reconstruction method based on a statistical method and an LSTM (BIlSTM) network, which comprise a model training method based on a statistical quadripotential method (Interquartile Range) and a long-short-Term Memory network (Long Short Term Memory), and a multi-sensor data reconstruction flow based on a Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory network (Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory), so that the problems of more abnormal data and low quality of the existing traffic infrastructure are solved. The invention discloses an abnormal data identification flow based on abnormal data types, which can detect various anomalies when the abnormal data types are contained. The invention expands independent anomaly detection and data reconstruction methods simultaneously, combines anomaly type detection and data reconstruction methods to form a complete flow scheme, thereby improving data quality. Finally, the detection method and the reconstruction network designed based on the invention can carry out efficient anomaly monitoring and data reconstruction tasks and are deployed in equipment.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Landslide potential displacement monitoring system using multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hidden danger displacement monitoring system using multi-source data fusion, which comprises a multi-source sensing unit, an earth surface deformation sensing module and an edge computing unit, wherein the multi-source sensing unit comprises a satellite-borne radar sensing module, the satellite-borne radar sensing module is used for acquiring large-range earth surface deformation data through a synthetic aperture radar, the earth surface deformation sensing module is used for monitoring earth surface displacement in real time through a dual-frequency GNSS receiver and a fiber grating sensor, the underground stress sensing module is used for acquiring underground rock-soil body stress change through a microseismic monitoring array and a distributed fiber sensor, and the edge computing unit comprises a dynamic weight fusion module, and is used for dynamically distributing multi-source sensor weights according to geological states to generate high-precision fusion displacement field data. The invention can break through the bottleneck of the traditional monitoring system in terms of data quality, model precision and response efficiency through multisource data fusion, model parameter real-time updating and closed-loop optimization mechanism, and provides data support for accurate early warning and intelligent emergency of landslide disasters.

title_en: Urban safety monitoring quantitative prediction method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative prediction method and a quantitative prediction system for urban safety monitoring based on big data analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining multiple monitoring indexes of urban safety development, collecting multi-source heterogeneous historical data of each monitoring index and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of carrying out data coupling and feature extraction on the preprocessed multi-source heterogeneous historical data, selecting an analysis model according to data features and data industry characteristics, training and cross-verifying the analysis model based on the multi-source heterogeneous historical data of each monitoring index to generate a city safety monitoring quantitative prediction model, carrying out quantitative prediction based on the multi-source heterogeneous real-time data of each monitoring index by utilizing the city safety monitoring quantitative prediction model, adapting to various data quality and data industry characteristics by selecting different analysis models, improving the accuracy of quantitative prediction of the monitoring indexes, and carrying out effective quantitative prediction on the running situation of the monitoring points and early warning based on the prediction.
assignees: BEIJING TESTOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data management method and system for distribution network line interconnection switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for managing multisource data of a distribution network line interconnection switch, and relates to the technical field of distribution network management. The method aims at solving the problems that the existing data management method often has non-uniform data sources, incompatible data formats and uneven data quality, so that the data management efficiency is low and the safe and stable operation of a power distribution network is affected; the multi-source data management method for the distribution network line interconnection switch comprises the following steps: s1: multi-source data integration and standardization; s2: real-time data monitoring and early warning; s3: visual display; s4: security and privacy protection; the GIS data is utilized to position the contact switch in the single line diagram, so that the real-time collection and monitoring of the state of the contact switch are realized, the fault prediction and early warning are carried out, the influence of the fault on the operation of the power grid is reduced, the data quality is monitored and evaluated in real time, the data management efficiency and effect are improved continuously, and the data quality is ensured to be always kept at a higher level.
assignees: STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY GONGYI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Permanent basic farmland quality intelligent monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a permanent basic farmland quality intelligent monitoring system and method, which realize accurate monitoring and dynamic management through multi-module cooperation, calculate terrain gradient and canopy height based on LiDAR point cloud, generate complexity index in combination with meteorological data, improve an A-algorithm to optimize an unmanned aerial vehicle inspection path, extract hyperspectral data to analyze soil and crop states, calibrate an electrode response curve, calculate biological effectiveness index in combination with humiture and dynamically adjust an early warning threshold value, identify abnormal data by adopting an isolated forest algorithm and conduct grading treatment, merge multisource data by adopting space-time Kriging interpolation and CNMF algorithm to construct a space-time cube, synthesize indexes such as ecological protection level, economic value and the like to generate a graded soil quality index model, generate disease thermodynamic diagram and store key data in an uplink, and realize farmland quality real-time monitoring, risk early warning and ecological economic balance decision through multisource heterogeneous data fusion, dynamic weight optimization and block chain technology.
assignees: UNIV JIANGXI AGRICULTURAL;JIANGXI INSTITUTE OF LAND AND SPACE INVESTIG AND PLANNING

title_en: Multi-source signal fatigue driving detection method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-source signal fatigue driving detection method, a device and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining time sequence data of multiple types of information in a driving process, segmenting the time sequence data of the multiple types of information to obtain multiple time sequence data fragments, respectively carrying out quality assessment on the multiple time sequence data fragments, determining target judgment models matched with the multiple time sequence data fragments from multiple judgment models according to data quality assessment grades, respectively judging the multiple time sequence data fragments through the target judgment models determined respectively to obtain a final total fatigue degree prediction result, and comparing the total fatigue degree prediction result with an early warning threshold value to judge whether to carry out early warning prompt on a driver or not. The characteristics of the data of the driver are effectively mined by using a plurality of data fusion methods, the data of different qualities are matched with the judging model, higher detection precision is achieved, the fatigue state of the driver is comprehensively measured, and the driving risk is reduced by reminding.

title_en: Intelligent positioning navigation early warning system and method for boats
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of navigation and positioning, in particular to an intelligent navigation early warning system and method for a boat. The method comprises the steps of collecting and evaluating sea state sensing and positioning signals according to a multisource sensor synchronous data set to obtain a sensor reliability scoring table, analyzing target motion situation according to the sensor reliability scoring table to obtain a fusion situation vector diagram, judging target motion states according to the fusion situation vector diagram to obtain a target motion state judging result, evaluating multiple target collision risks according to the target motion state judging result to obtain a risk evaluation matrix, performing navigation maneuvering performance constraint according to the risk evaluation matrix to obtain a navigation planning maneuvering constraint rule set, and performing navigation track search according to the navigation planning maneuvering constraint rule set to obtain a navigation track scheme. According to the invention, the positioning accuracy, navigation safety and early warning system practicability of the ship under the complex environment are obviously improved through the positioning navigation early warning technology.
assignees: CHANGHZOU FRP BOATBUILDING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent park property prevention and control management system based on data analysis and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data analysis-based intelligent park property prevention and control management system and an implementation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of property prevention and control. The invention comprehensively applies the data driving technology and the multi-mode fusion technology to the prevention and control management of the properties of the park, and builds a unified multi-mode universal management data analysis platform for multi-source heterogeneous data in the park. The system comprises a multi-mode information collection module and a multi-mode management and control module. The multi-mode information collection module uploads information data to the central machine room server through a network, and a multi-mode information model of the central machine room server performs model training and multi-mode association on property early warning information. And each multi-mode terminal feeds back and responds to the associated information. The intelligent park screening system reduces screening pressure for property prevention and control in the intelligent park, improves management and control efficiency, and improves flexibility, adaptability, safety and credibility of a property prevention and control management system.

title_en: Comprehensive traffic cooperative operation system and method based on multi-level index system
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive traffic cooperative operation system based on a multi-level index system, which comprises: the data resource layer is used for integrating multi-source heterogeneous data, establishing a data standard specification and an information resource catalog, constructing five comprehensive databases of a basic database, a business database, an index database, a subject database and a shared database, and realizing real-time supervision of data quality and distribution state based on the on-line management and control technology of data quality; the index system layer is used for constructing a traffic operation monitoring and early warning index system in the preset field; the business analysis layer is used for constructing an urban comprehensive traffic operation system facing the cooperation among enterprises, industry authorities and comprehensive traffic cooperative operation departments. The invention also provides a corresponding operation method. Therefore, the invention can improve the efficiency of traffic coordination.

title_en: Intelligent Internet of things public safety management and control system and method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent internet of things public safety management and control system and method based on multi-source data fusion, and belongs to the technical field of internet of things safety. The system comprises the steps of loading corresponding model parameters and response strategies by identifying a system operation scene, realizing unified acquisition and standardization processing of multi-source data, and constructing a unified semantic representation structure. The system performs anomaly detection at the edge node, combines the semantic structure and the anomaly characteristic information, completes risk scoring and hierarchical alarm judgment, and generates a control response instruction based on policy matching. Meanwhile, dynamic optimization of a scoring model and identity authentication, behavior audit and data compliance derivation in the running process are supported. The intelligent recognition system has the capabilities of intelligent recognition, self-adaptive analysis and response closed loop, and improves the precision and the credibility of public safety management in the environment of the Internet of things.
assignees: CHENGCHUANG INTELLIGENT TECH JIANGSU CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise climate risk prevention and control system applying big data and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprise climate risk prevention and control, and provides an enterprise climate risk prevention and control system applying big data and artificial intelligence, which comprises a multi-source climate data acquisition module, a satellite, a ground station and enterprise Internet of things data are integrated through federal learning; the system comprises an enterprise asset digital twin module, an AI risk prediction engine, a dynamic risk assessment module, a self-adaptive response decision module, a hierarchical early warning and linkage insurance platform, wherein the enterprise asset digital twin module integrates BIM/GIS to construct a dynamic asset model, the AI risk prediction engine adopts a space-time convolutional neural network to analyze weather-asset relevance, combines physical simulation with generation of an countermeasure network quantification physical/transformation risk, the dynamic risk assessment module generates a risk thermodynamic diagram and calculates a supply chain interruption probability, and the self-adaptive response decision module outputs a hierarchical early warning and links the insurance platform to trigger automatic claim settlement. The system verifies the credibility of the data through the blockchain, utilizes the edge computing nodes to realize local disaster recovery decision when the network is interrupted, forms a closed loop control mechanism of 'monitoring-predicting-evaluating-responding-optimizing', and solves the problems of data island, responding delay and unknown risk prediction in the traditional scheme.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG WANLI

title_en: Fan tower barrel settlement inclination monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for monitoring sedimentation and inclination of a fan tower, and relates to the technical field of monitoring of wind power generation equipment. By means of space-time alignment and dynamic feature screening, time sequence dislocation and redundant noise influence among different sensor data are eliminated, and the input data quality of the deformation quantity prediction model is improved. The characteristic weight distribution mechanism based on the time lag contribution degree enables the deformation quantity prediction model to capture the real deformation law more accurately, and avoids the interference of high-frequency noise on low-frequency deformation characteristic extraction. The problem that multisource sensor data fusion efficiency is low in a traditional fan tower settlement inclination monitoring system is effectively solved. The combined prediction precision of the inclination angle and the settlement of the tower is improved, the false alarm risk is reduced, and more reliable technical support is provided for the health monitoring and the safety early warning of the fan tower. The real-time verification mechanism is provided through unmanned aerial vehicle point cloud scanning, and the accuracy of the monitoring result is further improved.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Three-dimensional visual emergency management system for mining area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining area emergency management, and discloses a three-dimensional visual emergency management system for a mining area, which comprises a data acquisition module and a three-dimensional sand table generation module. The three-dimensional sand table generation module processes the data through a three-dimensional visualization engine, wherein a data preprocessing unit completes space coordinate system unification, missing data complementation and outlier correction, and a scene rendering unit generates a three-dimensional dynamic sand table through texture mapping, space feature fusion, space coupling modeling and three-dimensional scene synthesis. The system has the functional modules of offline data loading, disaster diffusion simulation, escape route planning and the like, and supports cross-platform rendering and user interaction operation. According to the invention, three-dimensional dynamic display and emergency analysis of multi-source data of a mining area are realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of disaster early warning and emergency decision are improved.

title_en: Comprehensive traffic cooperative operation system and method based on multi-level index system
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive traffic cooperative operation system based on a multi-level index system, which comprises: the data resource layer is used for integrating multi-source heterogeneous data, establishing a data standard specification and an information resource catalog, building five comprehensive databases of a basic library, a business library, an index library, a subject library and a sharing library, and realizing real-time supervision of data quality and distribution state based on a data quality online control technology; the index system layer is used for constructing a traffic operation monitoring and early warning index system in the preset field; and the business analysis layer is used for constructing a city comprehensive traffic operation system facing mutual cooperation among enterprises, industry administrative departments and comprehensive traffic cooperative operation departments. The invention also correspondingly provides an operation method. Therefore, the invention can improve the efficiency of traffic coordination.
assignees: BEIJING GAOCHENG SCIENCE & TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data fusion and downscaling method and system for earth surface soil humidity
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source data fusion and downscaling method and system for earth surface soil humidity, which comprise the following steps of carrying out quality assessment and standardization processing on multi-source soil humidity data, carrying out anomaly detection and restoration by adopting a hierarchical space-time feature extractor, carrying out region partitioning on the basis of a self-adaptive boundary generation algorithm and a soft boundary transition model, realizing data fusion and error control by a region cascade fusion network and an error chain tracking algorithm, and carrying out downscaling processing by utilizing a terrain self-adaptive downscaling frame and a multi-scale residual error learning model to obtain a soil humidity data product with 1km resolution. The soil humidity data of complex terrains and high vegetation coverage areas can be effectively processed, the data fusion precision and the scale reduction effect are remarkably improved, and the technical problems of the traditional method in the aspects of data quality assessment, anomaly detection, partition boundary processing, error control and the like are solved.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES

title_en: Geological survey data analysis system and method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological survey data analysis system and a geological survey data analysis method based on multi-source data fusion, and relates to the technical field of data analysis; the method comprises the steps of calculating similarity of a real-time environment feature matrix and each type of geological data in a knowledge base, selecting and judging to obtain a real-time survey geological type, calculating data fusion weights of the real-time survey geological type by using quality scores and correlations, carrying out weighted fusion on real-time data streams when surveying geology by using the calculated data fusion weights, calculating abnormal thresholds of different types of geology according to different types of geological historical survey data and carrying out standardization to generate an abnormal threshold database, extracting the abnormal threshold of the real-time survey geological type from the abnormal threshold database, judging the fusion data by using the abnormal threshold to obtain whether the real-time survey geology is abnormal or not and carrying out early warning.

title_en: Micro inverter supervision control method and system based on Internet of things data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of micro-inverters, and discloses a micro-inverter supervision control method and a micro-inverter supervision control system based on Internet of things data, wherein the operation situation is judged by acquiring multidimensional environment parameters such as temperature, illumination intensity, power grid load and the like, extracting characteristics and identifying modes; the method comprises the steps of carrying out weighted fusion on heterogeneous data by adopting multivariate time sequence analysis and Kalman filtering, determining the credibility of a data source through information entropy calculation, carrying out anomaly detection, dynamically adjusting data fusion weights according to anomaly scores, constructing a control decision matrix based on operation scenes and anomaly degrees, carrying out intelligent adjustment on inverter output by adopting a fuzzy logic controller, and continuously optimizing operation parameters through feedback control to realize efficient and stable operation of the micro inverter. The invention can effectively cope with complex and changeable photovoltaic power generation environments, and improves the system reliability and the power generation efficiency.

title_en: Medical data multisource fusion checking and correcting method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical data processing, and discloses a medical data multisource fusion checking and correcting method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource data; the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic baseline model of emergency departments, ICUs and general wards, responding to and checking abnormal conditions of patient data and early warning, establishing a term library, carrying out multi-source fusion on the patient data acquired by a plurality of sources and carrying out data correction, generating multi-source data quality evaluation tables of different departments based on full-flow data, and updating the term library and fusion correction weights based on feedback of the quality evaluation tables. The invention can timely find and correct the quality problem in the data by the real-time monitoring and intelligent early warning mechanism, reduce human errors and greatly reduce the data management cost. Through multi-source data fusion and consistency verification, the system can ensure seamless docking of data from different data sources, and realize cross-system and cross-platform data consistency and collaborative work, so that the accuracy of medical decision and the reliability of data are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN HUHUI SOFTWARE CO LTD;SANTAI COUNTY PEOPLES HOSPITAL SANTAI HOSPITAL AFFILIATED TO NORTH SICHUAN MEDICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Pollution monitoring and early warning method and system for drinking water source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring and early warning pollution of a drinking water source, which are used for acquiring hydrologic and geographic characteristics of the drinking water source so as to determine a plurality of monitoring points of the water source, generating a live state according to multi-source monitoring data of each of the plurality of monitoring points, transmitting the multi-source monitoring data, preprocessing and spatially fusing the multi-source monitoring data to obtain a water quality parameter observation value of the water source, correcting the water quality parameter observation value according to a dynamic baseline value of the water quality parameter observation value to obtain an improved water quality anomaly score, carrying out pollution identification and traceability analysis on the water source according to the improved water quality anomaly score, and generating an early warning notification message according to the result of the traceability analysis. Through setting up many monitoring points and the spatial fusion to multisource monitoring data, avoid single monitoring point to arouse the monitoring data and undulant too big and the unstable condition of whole monitoring, improve monitoring timeliness and early warning accuracy and credibility.
assignees: GUIZHOU WATER RESOURCES RESEARCH INST

title_en: Early fire monitoring and early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for early fire monitoring and early warning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step one: collecting indoor environment image information through a camera arranged indoors so as to judge fire disasters; the sensor arranged in a monitoring area which is easy to fire indoors is used for monitoring environmental parameter information which can represent fire indoors in real time; step two: processing the indoor environment image information and the environment parameter information to respectively obtain the posterior probability of flame detection and the posterior probability of fire disaster; step three: and inputting the posterior probability of flame detection and the posterior probability of fire disaster into DS evidence theory as basic credibility functions of different evidence sources to perform decision fusion so as to obtain a fire disaster prediction result. According to the invention, a fire prediction model is created by utilizing a multi-feature data fusion method, so that the accuracy and stability are improved, early warning can be achieved for the fire disaster, the fire disaster is effectively monitored in time, and the possibility of fire disaster occurrence is reduced to the minimum.

title_en: Air pollution prediction system and method based on meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air pollution prediction, and provides an air pollution prediction system and method based on meteorological data, wherein the air pollution prediction system comprises the following steps of: the system comprises a data acquisition and fusion module, a feature extraction module, a pollution prediction module, a model integration module, a model analysis module and a model analysis module, wherein the data acquisition and fusion module is used for acquiring meteorological data, air pollutant data and traffic data, carrying out fusion processing on the data, filling missing data, normalizing the data and extracting features, carrying out short-term and long-term prediction of air pollution based on the processed data, carrying out visual display and air pollution early warning notification on a prediction result, and the model integration module. The system realizes comprehensive monitoring of air pollution by integrating data of a meteorological station, an air pollution monitoring station, a traffic monitoring system and satellite remote sensing equipment. The interpolation and consistency processing of the data are performed by using the space-time data fusion unit, so that the coordination of the data from different sources is ensured, more comprehensive and accurate input data is provided, and the reliability of the prediction result is improved.
assignees: JIN WENYA

title_en: Geological disaster instant early warning method based on multi-source data dynamic fusion
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a geological disaster instant early warning method based on multi-source data dynamic fusion. The method comprises the steps of definitely obtaining physical parameters of various monitoring data in a monitoring area and preprocessing the physical parameters, dividing early warning levels, determining interval values of different early warning levels corresponding to the various monitoring data, calculating cloud model parameter values of the early warning levels corresponding to the various monitoring data, calculating the credibility of the early warning levels corresponding to the various monitoring data based on the parameter values, calculating the consistent quantity, conflict strength and unreliability among the multi-source monitoring data based on the credibility distribution, constructing an early warning level credibility redistribution equation, obtaining new credibility of the early warning levels corresponding to the various monitoring data, fusing the new credibility of the early warning levels, obtaining early warning level credibility based on multi-source data fusion, combining the maximum credibility principle, determining early warning information and dynamically updating the early warning result. The method solves the problem of multi-source data conflict fusion and improves the early warning efficiency of geological disasters.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING NORMAL

title_en: Quality control method and system based on buoy observation data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a quality control method and system based on buoy observation data. The method comprises the steps of carrying out multidimensional anomaly detection processing on preprocessed standard format data to obtain an anomaly detection report marked with anomalies and suspicious data points, carrying out multi-source data fusion and cross-validation processing on the data in the anomaly detection report to obtain initial data quality scores, carrying out intelligent correction processing on the anomaly detection report to obtain a correction data set and uncertainty estimation data corresponding to the correction data set, carrying out consistency analysis processing on the correction data set in space-time dimension to obtain space-time consistency scores and anomaly region marking data, carrying out comprehensive evaluation processing on the anomaly region marking data to obtain target data quality grade marks and target quality reports, and carrying out quality control strategy analysis to obtain target quality control strategies. The application improves the accuracy of quality control based on buoy observation data.
assignees: SHENGDONG RUDONG OFFSHORE WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST;HUANENG POWER INT JIANGSU ENERGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;HUANENG POWER INT JIANGSU ENERGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH;HUANENG OFFSHORE WIND POWER SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Metadata-driven data center management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a metadata-driven data center data management method and system, the method comprises the steps of connecting to various heterogeneous data sources through various access modes, automatically adjusting and optimizing metadata models, identifying the change rule of each field in historical data by using a machine learning method, generating an evolution rule of metadata evolution, automatically feeding back the difference between a real-time monitoring data source and an adaptive metadata model, using the adaptive metadata model to monitor the quality of the data source in real time, designing an early warning rule according to the quality of the data source, generating an early warning rule set, triggering early warning when a data quality problem exists, designing a machine learning-based repair model aiming at the data quality problem, and selecting an appropriate repair method to optimize. The invention overcomes the defects in the prior art by introducing the self-adaptive metadata evolution mechanism and the multi-level data quality early warning and repairing mechanism, and provides an efficient, flexible and intelligent data center management solution.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TAIXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bus real-time condition prediction management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bus management and discloses a bus real-time condition prediction management system, which comprises a bus data acquisition module, a cloud prediction analysis module, a real-time early warning management module, a machine maintenance management module, a driving behavior assessment module, a charging scheduling management module, a first-gear management module and a multi-source data fusion module; the method has the advantages that a multi-level bus data acquisition and cleaning mechanism is established, real-time analysis and verification are carried out on the CAN bus message, the message analysis accuracy of a data acquisition link CAN be detected in real time, the original data distortion of the running state caused by the data analysis error is avoided, the reliability of subsequent prediction analysis is ensured, meanwhile, the vehicle running parameters are integrated through a multi-source data fusion technology, the deviation of a single data source CAN be eliminated, the data quality is further improved, and an accurate data basis is provided for the running state assessment of the bus.
assignees: SHANDONG KEXING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Battery health diagnosis analysis method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery health diagnosis analysis method based on big data, which comprises the following steps of carrying out real-time monitoring and data acquisition through various sensors and data sources, carrying out multi-source data fusion based on feature selection of multi-source data to obtain a key feature set, creating a self-adaptive deep learning model, inputting features in the key feature set into the self-adaptive deep learning model to obtain a battery health state prediction result, generating a battery health score based on the battery health state prediction result and real-time data of a battery, adjusting an early warning threshold value based on the real-time battery health score, generating dynamic alarm, providing corresponding maintenance suggestions and early warning measures according to different health scores, and continuously optimizing the self-adaptive deep learning model according to historical battery health data and model prediction results. According to the invention, the data weight is dynamically adjusted based on the data quality, the sensor precision and the influence degree of the sensor precision on the health prediction, so that more accurate battery health state prediction can be realized.
assignees: DATANG HAINAN WENCHANG NEW ENERGY CO LTD;CHINA DATANG GROUP SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER TEST INSTITU;DATANG SANYA FUTURE ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Transformer fault prediction method based on multi-modal space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses a Transformer fault prediction method based on a multi-modal space-time diagram neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining concentration of dissolved gas in Transformer oil, electric operation parameters and vibration spectrum data, supplementing the missing data by adopting a linear interpolation method, eliminating abnormal values by adopting a Z-Score method, integrating multi-source data into a unified feature matrix by a feature weighted fusion technology, dynamically establishing a node association network, quantifying space-time coupling relation between the concentration of gas, the electric parameters and vibration signals, generating a feature map representing the state of equipment, capturing long time sequence dependency relation of the multi-source data by adopting a transducer framework through a multi-head attention mechanism, extracting deep space-time features, carrying out fault type reasoning and risk assessment based on the fault knowledge map, and triggering grading early warning response according to a risk assessment result. The problem of single data and response lag of the traditional transformer fault early warning method can be well solved.
assignees: YULIN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LD

title_en: Risk early warning method for bulk commodity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bulk commodity, and provides a risk early warning method of bulk commodity, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of target bulk commodity, carrying out association consistency detection to obtain cross characteristic candidate sets, and carrying out feature interaction modeling on the cross feature candidate set and the historical fluctuation features of the bulk commodity to generate different structured input sequences, inputting all the structured input sequences into a preset corresponding risk assessment submodel to generate a risk early warning report. By combining correlation consistency detection of multi-source data and extraction of cross features, various risk factors affecting price fluctuation of bulk commodities can be comprehensively identified, and early warning reports are generated in real time through feature interaction modeling, so that the problem that in practical application, complex interactions of multiple market factors cannot be comprehensively considered in the traditional method, and data quality inconsistency and response delay to sudden events exist under the influence of severe market emotion changes, information asymmetry or sudden events is solved.
assignees: TIANZE NINGBO DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mining new energy vehicle risk early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining new energy vehicle risk early warning system and a mining new energy vehicle risk early warning method, which relate to the field of data mining equipment and comprise the steps of collecting multi-source sensing data of a mining new energy vehicle, a mining operation working condition label, a real-time position of a mining area vehicle and mining area environment state information; the method comprises the steps of carrying out modal reliability assessment on multi-source sensing data according to mining area environment state information to obtain dynamic confidence weight, carrying out weighted fusion on the multi-source sensing data based on the dynamic confidence weight to generate fusion sensing characteristics, constructing a multi-mode large model based on the multi-source sensing data and the mining area environment state information, inputting the fusion sensing characteristics and mine operation working condition labels into the multi-mode large model to output thermal runaway risk probability, constructing a space-time diagram structure based on real-time position of a mining area vehicle and the thermal runaway risk probability, and calculating a risk propagation value by fusing initial risk of a single vehicle, inter-vehicle distance and aging attenuation factors based on a risk diffusion dynamics model and introducing the space-time diagram structure.

title_en: Underground cable evaluation, monitoring and maintenance method and system based on multi-source environment awareness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground cable evaluation, monitoring and maintenance method and system based on multisource environment perception, wherein the method synchronously collects electrical operation parameters of an underground cable, cable surface temperature parameters and environment parameters related to laying environment according to preset time granularity, and constructs a multisource environment perception parameter set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out characteristic screening on electric operation parameters, fusing state characteristic parameters, wire core temperature and grounding characteristic parameters after environmental calibration, constructing a system-level state characteristic vector, inputting a state evaluation model for processing to obtain a state evaluation result and corresponding evaluation credibility of an underground cable, and outputting monitoring early warning information or maintenance indication information based on the state evaluation result and the evaluation credibility.
assignees: WUHAN YINUOHONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Public safety risk real-time early warning method and system based on intelligent analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a public safety risk real-time early warning method and system based on intelligent analysis, which relates to the technical field of information safety, the invention constructs a alliance chain network and a setting authority by fusing multi-source heterogeneous data, when the shared data is applied, multiple approval is carried out, after the approval is passed, the shared data is put into a temporary shared scene for access monitoring, and evaluating the accessed target user, checking and auditing according to the evaluation result, analyzing and early warning the access audit of the temporary sharing scene in the sharing timeliness, ensuring the data credibility, the sharing and access security, the risk controllability and the service suitability, improving the accuracy of public safety risk real-time early warning, and guaranteeing the data safety.
assignees: SICHUAN POLICE COLLEGE

title_en: Marine environmental monitoring data quality management method and system based on double check method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of marine environmental monitoring data quality management method and system based on double check method, this method comprises the following steps：S1：Initial data is divided into input equipment input data and sensor gathered data, and is further subdivided into single source class and multi-source class；S2：Data outliers inspection is carried out, obtains the first data outliers and the second data outliers；S3：The order of magnitude according to where the first data outliers, the second data outliers with the difference of corresponding surrounding neighbor, obtain the first data outliers, abnormal cause classification corresponding to the second data outliers；S4：Based on default alarm rule, alarmed and correcting process；S5：In the corresponding databases of data Cun Chudao.Compared with prior art, the check algorithm of data Quality Control is integrated in software systems by the present invention, realize by being automatically imported of Monitoring Data result, classify, quality inspection, early warning, provide accurately and effectively data supporting for marine environment supervision and management.
assignees: FUJIAN STRONGSOFT CO LTD

title_en: Power quality early warning threshold calculation method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for calculating an early warning threshold of electric energy quality, and belongs to the technical field of electric power systems. The method aims at the problems of static state and lack of self-adaptability of the existing early warning threshold value setting, and comprises the steps of predicting future load by adopting a first preset prediction model based on multi-source heterogeneous data, carrying out combined weighting on a plurality of electric energy quality indexes based on a subjective weighting method and an objective weighting method to obtain combined weights, and solving an optimization model aiming at adjusting cost minimization by adopting a second preset intelligent optimization algorithm based on a predicted load result and the combined weights to obtain the early warning threshold value. The application also provides a device for executing the method. According to the scheme, the early warning threshold can be dynamically calculated, the cooperative optimization of economy and safety is realized, and the refinement level of power quality management is improved.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Medical clinical data quality analysis method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical clinical data quality analysis method and system based on a knowledge graph, and relates to the technical field of medical data analysis; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic medical field knowledge graph integrating a medical ontology and a semantic relation, accessing multi-source heterogeneous clinical data into the graph through entity link and standardized mapping, generating a personal data subgraph containing time sequence information for each patient, realizing deep discovery and accurate positioning of quality problems of known contradictions and unknown modes by combining logic reasoning based on a semantic rule base and anomaly detection based on a graph neural network, generating a targeted restoration scheme by utilizing traceability of the graph, quantitatively scoring quality problems and feeding the quantitative scoring to the graph to form closed loop management.

title_en: Gas turbine exhaust temperature sensor fault diagnosis system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault diagnosis system and method for a gas turbine exhaust temperature sensor, and relates to the technical field of industrial equipment state monitoring and diagnosis. The system comprises a sensor signal acquisition module for acquiring an original temperature signal, a signal preprocessing module for acquiring the original signal and working condition parameters and preprocessing, a characteristic extraction and windowing module for acquiring data and calculating characteristics, a data driving diagnosis module for receiving time sequence characteristics, evaluating health states, and a decision fusion module for comprehensively analyzing multi-source information and making final fault diagnosis decisions. The system can remarkably improve the accuracy and reliability of fault diagnosis, reduce false alarm rate and false missing rate, realize early warning and accurate identification of early weak faults of the sensor, improve the adaptability and robustness of the diagnosis system to variable working conditions of the gas turbine, and improve the operation safety, economy and operation and maintenance efficiency of the gas turbine.
assignees: SHANGHAI INSTITUTE OF PROCESS AUTOMATION INSTR;UNIV EAST CHINA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Power grid supply and demand balance dynamic evaluation method and system integrating multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching, in particular to a power grid supply and demand balance dynamic evaluation method and system integrating multi-source data, comprising the steps of collecting six types of heterogeneous data such as power grid operation, new energy prediction and the like, and counteracting conflict by using a credibility weight model and a weighted voting method after differential pretreatment; the improved Kalman filtering of the edge layer outputs real-time supply and demand characteristics, the multi-mode transducer model of the attention mechanism of the cloud layer outputs prediction characteristics, the scene self-adaptive adjustment is used for safety, economy, environmental protection and weight evaluation of power balance, and the optimization regulation and control suggestion is pre-warned in a grading manner and strengthened in a learning manner. The system adopts four layers of architecture of perception, edge, cloud and application to realize the method. The method has the advantages that the data conflict resolution rate is greatly improved, the real-time delay is lower, the prediction accuracy is effectively improved, early warning can be performed in advance, and the safe, economical and environment-friendly operation of the power grid is ensured.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Laser-based high-low suspended box girder safety angle calculation method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a laser-based high-low hoisting box girder safety angle calculation method, which realizes accurate monitoring and risk early warning of a box girder hoisting process through multi-source data fusion and dynamic safety evaluation. The method establishes a mapping relation between environment parameters and range errors, improves measurement accuracy by adopting a self-adaptive environment compensation mechanism, utilizes Kalman filtering and confidence weight to optimally fuse laser range and overhead travelling crane attitude data, extracts time sequence characteristics based on a long-short memory network, and predicts the change trend of a box Liang Qingjiao by combining a sliding time window and an autoregressive model, thereby realizing risk grading early warning. According to the method, the self-adaptive updating of the model is realized through continuously optimizing the database, and the safety monitoring level and the early warning capability in the construction process of the high-low suspended box girder are effectively improved.
assignees: UNIVERSAL UBIQUITOUS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting early warning method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting early warning method and a fire-fighting early warning system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which relate to the technical field of fire-fighting early warning. The unmanned aerial vehicle has the advantages that the unmanned aerial vehicle can cover a wider area which is difficult to contact, comprehensive and accurate monitoring of the pipeline is realized, and the monitoring precision and timeliness are remarkably improved. The data preprocessing module is used for filtering, denoising and standardizing the acquired data, so that the data quality is further improved, and the influence of environmental noise and interference is reduced. In addition, the data fusion and analysis module fuses and extracts features of early warning data through a particle filter data fusion algorithm, and can combine data of multiple sensors to provide more accurate risk prediction.

title_en: Power transmission line tree flash hidden danger monitoring method based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of safety monitoring of power systems, in particular to a multi-sensor fusion-based power transmission line tree flash hidden danger monitoring method which comprises a multi-source data acquisition, data fusion and preprocessing, risk feature extraction, dynamic risk assessment, intelligent early warning decision and monitoring feedback optimization module. Tree information is acquired in real time through a laser radar, an infrared thermal imager and other multiple sensors, data quality is optimized through improved Kalman filtering and wavelet transformation, risk characteristics are extracted based on a fractional differential equation, threat indexes are dynamically evaluated by combining self-adaptive fuzzy clustering and a Markov chain model, and finally an early warning strategy is generated through mixed integer linear programming. The application can obviously improve the identification accuracy of the tree flash hidden trouble, cover the potential risk in the whole area, reduce the manual inspection cost and provide intelligent safety guarantee for the power system.
assignees: BEIJING FENGQIAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent business decision method based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information and provides an intelligent business decision method based on multi-source heterogeneous data, which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data of different business scenes, judging whether the data meets the preset quality requirement by adopting a data quality evaluation model, and outputting available multi-source heterogeneous data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a data blood-cause relation graph according to available multi-source heterogeneous data, recording data copy generation, conversion and calculation processes, avoiding repeated calculation, generating a marketing recommendation list, a risk early warning list and a product recommendation list according to the data blood-cause relation graph, realizing real-time data updating according to three scene data assets through a Redis caching mechanism, ensuring that a calling interface obtains the latest data, and realizing efficient data query and real-time data updating. The full-flow intellectualization from data acquisition and processing to application is realized, the utilization efficiency of data assets is improved, accurate and timely business decision support is provided for enterprises, and the marketing effect, risk management and control capability and user experience are effectively improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG TOPWAY NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent ecological environment-friendly monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of environmental protection ecological monitoring, and particularly relates to an intelligent ecological environmental protection monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the steps of integrating and constructing a multi-source data acquisition network, introducing a Q-Learning algorithm to dynamically adjust sampling and cruising frequency, and realizing multi-dimensional data acquisition; identifying and eliminating abnormal values of data, standardizing heterogeneous data, designing a cross-modal fusion network containing a coordinate attention mechanism, extracting characteristics of various types of data, weighting by using an attention weight coefficient to generate a unified environment state vector, designing an intelligent analysis algorithm, intelligently identifying pollution sources, tracking the pollution sources by combining a graph attention network, dynamically adjusting an early warning threshold by combining a PPO algorithm, optimizing a self-adaptive monitoring strategy, detecting sensor faults by a self-encoder, repairing the missing data by adopting a K neighbor interpolation method, and maintaining data continuity. The invention can effectively improve the coverage range of ecological monitoring, enhance the intelligent processing capability of data and improve the early warning accuracy and adaptability.
assignees: JIANGXI HUANGZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Customer investigation report generation method based on artificial intelligence and RPA
abstract_en: The invention provides a client investigation report generation method based on artificial intelligence and RPA, which comprises the steps of synchronously acquiring client investigation data from a structured data source and an unstructured data source through an application programming interface, a database query engine, an optical character recognition technology and a robot flow automation technology, carrying out text denoising, key field extraction and structured conversion on the unstructured data based on preset rules, carrying out format standardization, data verification and field mapping processing on the structured data, adjusting a data analysis strategy according to user requirements and context information by utilizing a dynamic semantic analysis model to generate a weighted semantic analysis result, carrying out anomaly detection, repeated data deduplication and missing value filling on the cleaned structured data and semantic analysis result through a multimodal data fusion algorithm, and constructing a unified data pool with a quality score of not less than 95%.
assignees: HUBEI BRANCH OF CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine safety data processing method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly relates to a coal mine safety data processing method based on multi-source data fusion. The method comprises the steps of collecting various data affecting coal mine safety, such as gas concentration, wind speed and the like, denoising by adopting a mixed filtering algorithm combined with multi-scale analysis, fusing the data by adopting an improved weighted average fusion algorithm, extracting key features by using an improved pearson correlation coefficient, and judging the safety state. The method includes denoising data through multi-scale decomposition and filtering, establishing a weight evaluation index system to dynamically adjust weights for data fusion, setting correlation threshold screening key features, and carrying out safe state prediction and early warning in time by adopting a support vector machine. The method can effectively improve the data quality, accurately judge the coal mine safety state, and has important significance for guaranteeing the coal mine safety production.

title_en: Income and list calculation method for stream data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of enterprise financial management and big data processing, and particularly relates to a method for automatically and accurately identifying effective income and counting months by taking multi-source data analysis as a basis and taking a rule engine as a core and assisting semantic analysis and deep learning anomaly detection, which solves the problems of non-uniform fields and fuzzy semantics when multi-source heterogeneous flow data are manually processed, solves the data quality problem of mixing income statistics in invalid transactions, solves the risk control problem that related party transactions and large amount of anomaly transactions are difficult to identify, and avoids the inefficiency and subjectivity of manual statistics.
assignees: CHONGQING INST ENG

title_en: Laser-based high-low suspended box girder safety angle calculation method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a laser-based high-low hoisting box girder safety angle calculation method, which realizes accurate monitoring and risk early warning of a box girder hoisting process through multi-source data fusion and dynamic safety evaluation. The method establishes a mapping relation between environment parameters and range errors, improves measurement accuracy by adopting a self-adaptive environment compensation mechanism, utilizes Kalman filtering and confidence weight to optimally fuse laser range and overhead travelling crane attitude data, extracts time sequence characteristics based on a long-short memory network, and predicts the change trend of a box Liang Qingjiao by combining a sliding time window and an autoregressive model, thereby realizing risk grading early warning. According to the method, the self-adaptive updating of the model is realized through continuously optimizing the database, and the safety monitoring level and the early warning capability in the construction process of the high-low suspended box girder are effectively improved.

title_en: Air quality data quality control method based on time sequence data
abstract_en: The invention provides an air quality data quality control method based on time sequence data, which relates to the technical field of air detection and comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source atmospheric monitoring site data, constructing a spatial topological relation network of the monitoring site, defining a dynamic hierarchical structure of atmospheric pollutant data under different time-space scales and cross-level association rules thereof, carrying out anomaly detection and tracing analysis on the obtained monitoring data, carrying out data correction and filling, applying a space-time clustering algorithm, carrying out reliability evaluation and grading on the corrected monitoring data by combining the site topological relation and the data association rules to generate a data reliability grading result of time-space dimensions, adopting a graph neural network model fused into atmospheric diffusion physical constraints when data reliability abnormality or potential failure risk is detected, generating a visual atmospheric data quality evaluation and control decision report, and automatically triggering instrument calibration, maintenance or data review instructions aiming at specific sites or areas according to risk grades.
assignees: HENAN XINXIANG ECOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING CENTER;HENAN PROVINCE ECOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING AND SAFETY CENTER;SHANGHAI TUSHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Early warning method, system and medium based on environment monitoring data
