abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an early warning method, a system and a medium based on environment monitoring data, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source monitoring data of an ocean monitoring area at a plurality of latest acquisition moments; the method comprises the steps of determining the coverage concentration of plankton in each grid at corresponding time based on a remote sensing image, further determining the phytoplankton index of the plankton in the ocean monitoring area, determining the growth trend parameter of the ocean monitoring area based on the phytoplankton indexes at a plurality of collecting time, carrying out coupling analysis on the water quality parameter and the growth trend parameter of each grid, constructing an environment factor-biomass correlation model, calculating the risk value of abnormal proliferation of the plankton under different water quality index combinations through the correlation model, and carrying out risk early warning of the grid to a monitoring terminal when the risk value of any grid falls into a preset high risk interval.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG OCEAN

title_en: Edible fungus quality monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring edible fungus quality, which belong to the technical field of agricultural Internet of things and intelligent detection, and have the technical key points that: the system comprises an image acquisition module, a gas sensing module, a weight measurement module, an environmental parameter acquisition module, a data processing module and a display alarm module, and can acquire image characteristics, volatile gas concentration, weight loss rate and storage environment information of the edible fungi in real time. The system calculates the comprehensive quality index Q (t) through a fusion algorithm, judges the quality grade according to a preset threshold value, and realizes dynamic quality assessment and deterioration early warning of edible fungi in the storage and transportation process. The system and the method of the invention combine multisource perception and intelligent algorithm, have the characteristics of non-contact, automation, predictability and the like, can be widely applied to the scenes of storage monitoring, logistics quality control, intelligent classification and the like of edible mushrooms such as mushrooms, flammulina velutipes, oyster mushrooms and the like, and improves the quality management efficiency and the intelligent level of a supply chain.
assignees: HUANGGANG ACAD OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title_en: Animal physiological characteristic data acquisition system and analysis method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of the Internet of things, and discloses an animal physiological characteristic data acquisition system and an analysis method based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps of cleaning and standardizing original sensor data, including filling missing data, eliminating noise interference through a dynamic filtering technology, unifying dimensions of multi-source data, and eliminating redundant features, interpolating and aligning unsynchronized sampling data to a Beidou time service time reference, correcting time sequence phase difference of physiological and behavioral data through a dynamic path matching technology, and correcting GPS/Beidou positioning drift by combining Kalman filtering. According to the invention, through a multisource sensing fusion and edge-fog-cloud cooperative computing architecture, the effective acquisition rate of animal physiological data is realized, the abnormal response is delayed and compressed, the flexible energy supply technology and dynamic communication optimization are combined, the continuous voyage and communication success rate is maintained in pastures, the false alarm rate is reduced compared with the traditional method, and the common symptoms such as abnormal body temperature, digestive system diseases and the like are covered by accurate early warning.
assignees: WESTERN AGRICULTURE RES CENTER OF CHINA AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES;ZHONGNONG TEJIA CHANGCHUN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building safety warning level dynamic adjustment method and system based on artificial intelligent driving
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic adjustment method and a system for building safety warning level based on artificial intelligence driving, which comprise the steps of receiving original monitoring data, space position data and data quality indexes of a sensor array, sequentially carrying out space-time alignment, feature extraction, quality assessment and anomaly detection through a multi-source heterogeneous data preprocessing frame, carrying out multidimensional feature fusion and risk pattern recognition analysis on the preprocessed data, sequentially realizing feature space construction, risk pattern extraction, relevance analysis and level assessment, realizing feature fusion, threshold optimization, level adjustment and effect assessment through a warning level dynamic adjustment mechanism based on risk level and confidence level, and finally carrying out information fusion, content generation, level classification and push optimization through intelligent generation and hierarchical push processing of early warning information. The method and the system remarkably improve the accuracy and timeliness of building safety early warning.
assignees: JIANGSU TESTING CENTER FOR QUALITY OF CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Foundation pit safety early-warning method based on multi-source monitoring data fusion
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a foundation pit safety early-warning method based on multi-source monitoring data fusion. The method comprises: first constructing a foundation pit safety evaluation indicator system, and acquiring cumulative values and change rates of multi-source time-series monitoring indicators; then determining a foundation pit safety grade identification framework, using multi-source time-series monitoring data as different evidence, and performing normalization processing; then, on the basis of the multi-source time-series monitoring data, determining basic probability assignment values in the identification framework; then, separately calculating weights of multi-source monitoring indicators, and credibility; and finally, fusing multi-source monitoring data of a foundation pit, in order to obtain a foundation pit safety evaluation grade. The present invention is characterized in that the importance of different monitoring indicators and the credibility of evidence are taken into consideration while making full use of actually measured monitoring data of a foundation pit, thereby ensuring that foundation pit safety state identification is objective, avoiding interference from subjective human factors, and effectively overcoming the defects of a traditional D-S evidence theory.
assignees: GUANGZHOU INST OF BUILDING SCIENCE GROUP CO LTD;GUANGZHOU CONSTR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Automatic checking and intelligent repairing system for space data exchange quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic checking and intelligent repairing system for space data exchange quality, which relates to the technical field of geographic space data quality control and intelligent processing, and comprises the following steps of basic data preprocessing, deformation topology space-time coding generation, four-dimensional interlocking library construction, topology interlocking multidimensional verification tracing, deformation energy-time sequence association complement repairing and repairing effect verification; according to the invention, the root of the problem of data fake making and data quality definition is accurately identified through the unique characteristics of the deformed topology space-time coding chain and the double verification of the four-dimensional interlocking library, the problem of liability tearing is solved, the deformed rules of different acquisition platforms are adapted by combining the tracing results, the high-precision repair is realized through the corresponding algorithm, the space-time dead zone is synchronously complemented, the time sequence characteristics are reserved, the data fusion compatibility is improved, the data tamper resistance is realized through the code chain uniqueness, the hidden faults of the early warning equipment are analyzed through the time sequence characteristic abnormality, and the application risk is avoided.
assignees: SUKECE MEASUREMENT TECH HANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Industrial data quality analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an industrial data quality analysis method and system, and relates to the technical field of industrial data analysis. Firstly, acquiring an enterprise basic data set and a sensing data set from a target industry, and carrying out data fusion to obtain original data. And preprocessing the original data to obtain preprocessed data. Based on the preprocessed data, performing feature extraction by using a principal component analysis method to obtain feature vectors, and fusing the feature vectors to obtain a fusion vector set. Based on the fusion vector set, the industrial data quality analysis result is obtained by utilizing multi-mode anomaly detection and dynamic risk assessment. The industrial data quality analysis method provided by the invention realizes high-efficiency and accurate analysis of industrial data quality, and optimizes the monitoring and management efficiency of an industrial production process.
assignees: UNIV WUXI

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion method for low-altitude flight risk early warning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of low-altitude flight safety early warning, and provides a multi-mode data fusion method for low-altitude flight risk early warning, which comprises the steps of aligning flight state data and meteorological data, filling missing data, extracting spatial features, fusing the spatial features and the flight state data, and analyzing a time-space convolution neural network and a time-space graph convolution network; the method and the system improve the accuracy and the reliability of prediction by fusing the flight state and the meteorological data, can capture the space and time dependency relationship between the flight data and the meteorological data simultaneously through the space-time convolution neural network and the space-time diagram convolution network, can accurately align and complement missing data through space-time data fusion, and improve the data quality and the real-time performance of the system.
assignees: UNIV SW SCI & TECH SWUST

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for monitoring and early warning hidden danger of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for monitoring and early warning hidden danger of a transformer substation, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring monitoring data of hidden danger of the transformer substation and preprocessing the data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time synchronization and space alignment on preprocessed data, dynamically distributing weights by combining data credibility to realize multi-source data weighted fusion, carrying out hidden danger analysis on the fused data through a neural network, and issuing early warning information based on the detected hidden danger type. The method and the system cover the omnibearing monitoring of the running state of the internal equipment of the transformer substation and the surrounding macroscopic environment through the cooperative monitoring of the satellite remote sensing technology and the ground sensor network, improve the monitoring accuracy through adopting a space-time alignment technology and a dynamic weight fusion algorithm, complement the real-time performance of the ground data through the anti-interference capability of satellite data, improve the system robustness through combining the data correction technology in preprocessing, realize the automatic identification of hidden danger through a convolutional neural network, and reduce the response time and the labor cost.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent park multisource data dynamic monitoring and real-time analysis system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to a system and a method for dynamically monitoring and analyzing multi-source data in an intelligent park, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data analysis module, a data encryption and storage module, a real-time monitoring and early warning module, a comprehensive management module and a communication module; the method and the device have the advantages that the original data is directly processed simply and then analyzed in the prior art, the defects of low data quality, inaccurate feature extraction and the like exist, the data quality is improved through preprocessing steps such as data cleaning, format conversion, normalization and standardization, the data reliability is ensured through integrity, accuracy, consistency and interpretability inspection, the features are accurately selected and extracted, and finally the multisource sensor data is integrated through a data alignment and fusion technology.
assignees: GUANGDONG MOXIANG CULTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent early warning method for water level of sedimentation pipe inspection well based on self-adaptive smoothing algorithm and bidirectional gating circulation unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning method for the water level of a sedimentation pipe inspection well based on a self-adaptive smoothing algorithm and a two-way gating circulating unit, which comprises the following steps of establishing a multiphase flow control equation, establishing a 'sedimentation pipe-inspection well' space-time scale hydraulic response model, configuring boundary constraint and space-time transfer state information in a fluid-solid coupling numerical simulation process, establishing a high-resolution 'sedimentation pipe-inspection well' numerical simulation model, outputting a pipe inlet and outlet flow velocity/flow sample set with an inspection well water level label, establishing a self-adaptive smoothing algorithm to detect missing data and heterogeneous data, reconstructing a sedimentation pipe space-time flow velocity field and an inspection well water level in a training period, taking the sedimentation pipe space-time flow velocity field and the inspection well water level as training sets, verification sets and test sets, and utilizing the two-way gating circulating unit based on a dynamic conversion encoder to establish the intelligent early warning model for the water level of the sedimentation pipe, thereby realizing the intelligent early warning of the water level of the sedimentation pipe.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Charging station depth defense protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station deep defense protection method, relates to the technical field of fire early warning and safety protection, and aims to solve the problems of high fire early warning false alarm rate, fire isolation delay and insufficient credibility of accident tracing data in the prior art. The method constructs a full-period protection system of 'monitoring-disposal-tracing', wherein a temperature field, electrical parameters and environmental data are collected through multi-source sensor fusion before disaster, a self-adaptive safety threshold is generated based on a dynamic game model, a digital twin deduction and prejudging risk path is combined, a three-level response mechanism is adopted in disaster, an operation log is stored in a slicing mode through a blockchain space-time anchoring technology after disaster, and a digital twin reverse reconstruction accident evolution chain is utilized to generate tamper-resistant judicial evidence. According to the invention, early warning precision is improved through dynamic threshold optimization, response time is shortened through multistage linkage control, traceability reliability is guaranteed through a quantum evidence storage technology, and a closed-loop optimization system for fire protection of the charging station is formed.
assignees: QUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Landslide potential displacement monitoring system using multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hidden danger displacement monitoring system using multi-source data fusion, which comprises a multi-source sensing unit, an earth surface deformation sensing module and an edge computing unit, wherein the multi-source sensing unit comprises a satellite-borne radar sensing module, the satellite-borne radar sensing module is used for acquiring large-range earth surface deformation data through a synthetic aperture radar, the earth surface deformation sensing module is used for monitoring earth surface displacement in real time through a dual-frequency GNSS receiver and a fiber grating sensor, the underground stress sensing module is used for acquiring underground rock-soil body stress change through a microseismic monitoring array and a distributed fiber sensor, and the edge computing unit comprises a dynamic weight fusion module, and is used for dynamically distributing multi-source sensor weights according to geological states to generate high-precision fusion displacement field data. The invention can break through the bottleneck of the traditional monitoring system in terms of data quality, model precision and response efficiency through multisource data fusion, model parameter real-time updating and closed-loop optimization mechanism, and provides data support for accurate early warning and intelligent emergency of landslide disasters.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Multi-source data fusion law enforcement record generation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data fusion, in particular to a system and a method for generating a law enforcement record of multi-source data fusion, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the data acquisition module normalizes and eliminates repeated data, the anomaly detection module performs data check and cleaning, the information source evaluation module performs quantization scoring on the data source, the weight adjustment module dynamically adjusts the weight based on the scoring, the data fusion module performs weighted fusion and field check, and the collaborative law enforcement record is output. In the invention, the data quality is further ensured by calculating the checksum deviation value of the data value range, and the reliability of the data set is enhanced by removing the abnormal data. Quality evaluation and input fairness of the data sources are ensured through quantization scoring and dynamic weight adjustment, so that law enforcement records are more comprehensive and authoritative. The refined data processing not only improves the accuracy of law enforcement records, but also strengthens the safety and the integrity of information, thereby remarkably improving the response speed and the decision quality of law enforcement institutions.
assignees: GUIZHOU INST TECH;FOUNDER INT BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Multisource environment parameter fusion acquisition method based on agricultural four-condition monitoring system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of agricultural four-condition monitoring, and particularly relates to a multisource environment parameter fusion acquisition method based on an agricultural four-condition monitoring system; according to the method, an agricultural Internet of things sensing matrix integrating the world and the air is constructed, the multi-source heterogeneous data is effectively collected, each sensor node locally performs light preprocessing including anomaly detection and correction, missing data filling and normalization processing, data quality and consistency are guaranteed, then node characteristics are extracted through a characteristic extraction model, a multi-level fusion strategy is adopted, similar sensor data are fused through the node layers, different types of sensor data are fused through the regional layers, and finally multi-region data travel global characteristic vectors are integrated through the central fusion layer, so that the problems of data isomerism, space-time inconsistency and data quality inconsistency are effectively solved, reliable support is provided for four-situation assessment, and therefore accurate agricultural generation decisions are realized.
assignees: CHENGDU SHAMOYU AGRICULTURAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-sensor abnormality detection method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-sensor anomaly detection method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of anomaly detection and comprise the steps of collecting sampling data of sensors in a target system in real time, determining current total confidence weights of all the sampling data based on cloud model theory, constructing a fuzzy weighted generalized moment estimation model based on the current total confidence weights and the generalized moment estimation, determining optimal parameter estimation of each sensor based on the fuzzy weighted generalized moment estimation model, carrying out anomaly detection on the target system by utilizing the optimal parameter estimation, determining an anomaly detection result, carrying out deep fusion on the cloud model and the generalized moment estimation, fully utilizing the modeling capability of the cloud model on the uncertainty and the ambiguity of the multi-source heterogeneous sensor sampling data, and utilizing the structural parameter reasoning capability of the generalized moment estimation to realize consistent reasoning and optimization of the parameters of the target system, and effectively improving the robustness of the multi-sensor anomaly detection.
assignees: NO 711 RESEARCH INST OF CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION LIMITED

title_en: Node zero trust trusted access method for computing network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a node zero trust trusted access method and device for an algorithm network, and relates to the technical field of network security. The trust evaluation is carried out in the registration stage and the task execution stage of the computing node based on the principle of zero trust. In the registration stage, a multi-source trust modeling mechanism integrating identity attributes, capability observation and organization reputation is constructed, a Bayesian reasoning and graph regularization method is introduced to realize initial credibility assessment, in the operation stage, a multi-mode log anomaly detection method is designed, high-dimensional behavior modeling is carried out by combining semantics, time, parameters and quantity characteristics, anomaly identification capability is enhanced by utilizing long-sequence dependence, and a dynamic trust adjustment strategy is further provided by combining time attenuation and a user feedback mechanism to realize continuous evolution and refined access control of node trust. By utilizing the invention, the trusted access to the power computing nodes is realized by the scheduling system in the environment of the power computing network, and the safety and the reliability of the power computing network system are effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM

title_en: Intelligent data management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent data management method and system, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The standardized packaging and automatic execution of the data management instructions are realized, and the problem that the traditional storage medium cannot dynamically adapt to the multi-source data processing requirements is solved. Through the decoupling design of the pre-compiling instruction and the runtime environment, the same storage medium can be adapted to the data management nodes of different hardware architectures, and the deployment complexity of the system during upgrading is effectively reduced. Further, based on an instruction execution mechanism of the stream computing engine, the real-time performance of data quality evaluation and early warning triggering is ensured, and decision delay caused by batch processing delay is avoided. Through the on-demand loading characteristic of the modularized instruction set, the function expansion requirement of a specific service scene is supported while the core treatment function is ensured.
assignees: WUHAN ENYI HULIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hybrid energy storage system optimal scheduling method based on AI intelligent regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI intelligent regulation-based hybrid energy storage system optimization scheduling method, which relates to the technical field of hybrid energy storage and comprises the following steps of collecting real-time data, cross-verifying data consistency through a multi-source data fusion technology, and identifying data anomalies caused by sensor faults, communication delays and environmental interference and eliminating the anomalies by utilizing a self-adaptive threshold detection combined with a statistical analysis method. According to the invention, the energy storage scheduling is optimized through data cleaning, time sequence prediction and reinforcement learning, and the intelligent management and dynamic adaptability are improved. The data accuracy is ensured by adopting multi-source data fusion and anomaly detection, and the energy consumption is predicted by means of LSTM and Transformer, so that the energy storage strategy is optimized in advance. In combination with reinforcement learning, the system dynamically adjusts charge and discharge, improves the light Fu Xiaona rate, reduces the electricity purchasing cost, intelligently controls the SOC to be in the range of 40% -80%, and prolongs the service life of the battery. Meanwhile, the system stability is improved through abnormality detection and correction, and the maintenance cost is reduced.
assignees: ANHUI ZHICHU NEW ENERGY TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Efficient prediction method and system for pipe network operation and maintenance data
abstract_en: A high-efficiency prediction method and system for pipe network operation and maintenance data combines protocol access and automatic format conversion technology, realizes unified acquisition and hierarchical transmission of multi-source heterogeneous data, solves the problems of low acquisition efficiency and inconsistent formats of traditional pipe network data, and secondly, adopts a Kalman filtering to perform anomaly detection and correction by a real-time verification completion mechanism, and completes missing data by an interpolation algorithm, thereby improving data quality and timeliness. In the data integration stage, structural cleaning and archiving are carried out based on a preset data model, a high-efficiency data basis is provided for a subsequent prediction model, finally, time sequence features and space association analysis are fused, a joint feature space is constructed through event feature marks, a prediction model is trained by utilizing a collaborative modeling module, potential fault points are accurately identified, an operation and maintenance optimization plan is intelligently generated, real-time sharing and interactive display of a prediction result are realized through a decision pushing and visualizing module, and closed-loop management from data acquisition to prediction decision is realized.

title_en: Multi-dimensional parameter health monitoring system and method for offshore wind power tower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional parameter health monitoring system and method for an offshore wind turbine tower. The multi-source sensing module integrates a triaxial acceleration sensor, an optical fiber strain gauge, a corrosion rate probe and other devices, acquires structural response, environmental load and corrosion data in real time, the data preprocessing module improves data quality by adopting a self-adaptive Kalman filtering and multi-mode standardization method, the feature extraction module extracts 28-dimensional feature vectors through time domain statistics, frequency domain power spectrum and wavelet transformation, the state evaluation module outputs a health state index (SHI) based on a bidirectional LSTM-Attention model, the uncertainty quantization is realized by combining a Monte Carlo Dropout, the early warning output module triggers three-level grading early warning according to an SHI threshold, the linkage digital twin system realizes three-dimensional visualization and intelligent report generation, and the operation and maintenance intelligent level of the offshore wind power tower can be effectively improved.
assignees: SENKONG TECH JIANGSU CO LTD

title_en: Ship power station remote fault early warning system based on edge cloud cooperation
abstract_en: According to the ship power station remote fault early warning system based on edge cloud cooperation, the edge calculation layer is used for carrying out self-adaptive weighted data fusion processing operation on the collected fault information parameters, so that error data collected due to sensor faults are deleted, the data uploading amount is reduced, and the pressure of cloud server calculation and network transmission is reduced; the fuzzy recognition method based on the Bayesian algorithm improvement in the cloud computing layer is matched with fault information in the database, and a fault early warning result and a processing scheme are output, so that potential safety hazards and risk points can be found more accurately and rapidly, the early warning speed and the early warning accuracy are improved, and the false alarm, false alarm and missing alarm phenomena are reduced.
assignees: WUXI PROFESSIONAL COLLEGE SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-source measurement data fusion and state sensing method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system automation, and provides a method and a system for multi-source measurement data fusion and state perception of a power distribution network, wherein a data acquisition module is used for integrating multi-source measurement equipment and monitoring data quality, a data fusion module is used for realizing time alignment and evidence theory fusion, and then the power distribution network state estimation module is combined with the dynamic weighting and power supply uncertainty model to output an accurate state, the fault diagnosis module is used for locating faults and identifying types based on the Bayesian network, the risk assessment module is used for early warning after analyzing risks, and the visualization module is used for graphically displaying information. And after the starting, automatically acquiring multi-source data, carrying out state estimation after fusion processing, monitoring the state in real time, rapidly diagnosing and positioning during fault, synchronously evaluating risks and early warning, and grasping and processing the conditions by operation and maintenance personnel through a visual interface.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Self-attention sleep system and method for polymorphic sleep data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-attention sleep system and method for multi-state sleep data fusion, comprising a data acquisition module, a signal preprocessing module, a frequency division multiplexing module, a characteristic extraction module, a model training module, a sleep stage module, a correlation analysis module and an early warning system module, wherein the data acquisition module is responsible for acquiring environmental data and physiological data of a user, the signal preprocessing module is used for dividing, normalizing and denoising acquired EEG and EOG signals, the frequency division multiplexing module is used for decomposing a preprocessed signal frame into a plurality of narrow-band signals by using a frequency division multiplexing technology, the characteristic extraction module is used for extracting characteristics from the decomposed narrow-band signals, the model training module is used for training the characteristics, the sleep stage module is used for carrying out real-time or off-line sleep stage through the trained model, the sleep quality evaluation module is used for calculating sleep quality indexes based on the result of the sleep stage, the correlation analysis module is used for carrying out correlation analysis on the relations between different sleep stages and the sleep quality indexes, the quality evaluation model is generated, and the early warning system module is used for setting early warning threshold according to the sleep quality evaluation result and the quality evaluation model.

title_en: Structural monitoring data fusion probability abnormality early warning method based on streaming super threshold and evidence reasoning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structure monitoring data fusion probability abnormity early warning method based on a streaming type super-threshold value and evidence reasoning, which comprises the steps of establishing a historical data set of each sensor as sample data, carrying out temperature effect separation on the sample data, extracting response components after removing the temperature effect as an initial data set for abnormity detection, determining an initial threshold value, constructing the super-threshold value data set, fitting the super-threshold value data set, obtaining posterior probability distribution of shape parameters and scale parameters through Bayesian inference, calculating probability distribution of early warning trigger values, calculating an abnormity certainty index, dynamically updating the probability distribution of the early warning trigger values through the streaming type super-threshold value method, and synthesizing through the evidence fusion method to obtain a fusion abnormity certainty index. The method can form fusion anomaly certainty, further better benefits the conflict among indexes, avoids early warning false alarm caused by single sensor faults, and provides a certain data support for maintenance of the structure.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Industrial and commercial information early warning method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a business information early warning method based on big data, which comprises the steps of capturing data; risk calculation, correction generation, evidence and freshness, correction index calculation, simulation influence, punishment and credibility, correction execution, high risk judgment, grabbing range adjustment and early warning. According to the invention, the rolling risk index is formed by dynamically collecting the new number of enterprise judicial cases, the negative public opinion heat, the industrial and commercial change frequency, the registered capital change rate and the upstream and downstream enterprise abnormal constants, and carrying out standardized treatment and weighted fusion on the multi-source index, and the risk index is continuously regulated by combining a correction instruction, an evidence quick-viewing value, freshness, an influence quantity and a punishment item, so that the problems of early warning lag and insufficient risk prevention and control caused by difficulty in timely and accurate identification of enterprise high risk information due to data update delay, single risk judgment and static capture strategy are effectively solved.
assignees: WEIHAI VOCATIONAL COLLEGE WEIHAI TECH COLLEGE

title_en: Metadata-driven data center management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a metadata-driven data center data management method and system, the method comprises the steps of connecting to various heterogeneous data sources through various access modes, automatically adjusting and optimizing metadata models, identifying the change rule of each field in historical data by using a machine learning method, generating an evolution rule of metadata evolution, automatically feeding back the difference between a real-time monitoring data source and an adaptive metadata model, using the adaptive metadata model to monitor the quality of the data source in real time, designing an early warning rule according to the quality of the data source, generating an early warning rule set, triggering early warning when a data quality problem exists, designing a machine learning-based repair model aiming at the data quality problem, and selecting an appropriate repair method to optimize. The invention overcomes the defects in the prior art by introducing the self-adaptive metadata evolution mechanism and the multi-level data quality early warning and repairing mechanism, and provides an efficient, flexible and intelligent data center management solution.

title_en: Visual management system and method for construction progress of offshore wind farm based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to a GIS-based offshore wind farm construction progress visual management system and a GIS-based offshore wind farm construction progress visual management method, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing and storage module, a GIS visual module, a progress analysis and prediction module, a resource management and scheduling module and a risk early warning and decision support module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for collecting data of offshore wind farm construction through acquisition equipment, then transmitting the data to the data processing and storage module, and storing the data of the offshore wind farm construction through data cleaning and conversion of the data processing and storage module, and supplying the data to the GIS visual module, wherein the GIS visual module is used for constructing the offshore wind farm. According to the invention, the data acquisition module can comprehensively acquire multi-source data, an information basis is provided for solving engineering conditions, and the uncoordinated part is found by assistance, and the data quality can be ensured and the data can be orderly stored through the data processing and storage module, so that the problem that engineering is difficult to manage and coordinate is solved.
assignees: POWERCHINA FUJIAN ELEC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Coal and gas risk dynamic early warning method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring, in particular to a coal and gas risk dynamic early warning method and system based on multi-source data fusion. The coal and gas risk dynamic early warning method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining real-time prediction indexes of coal and gas outburst risk prediction, S2, obtaining direct monitoring indexes of coal and gas outburst risk prediction, S3, carrying out feature fusion on numerical values of all indexes through an artificial intelligent model to generate feature enhancement early warning index values, S4, calculating corresponding data confidence degrees based on data quality features of all indexes, and integrating the data confidence degrees of all indexes to calculate integrated confidence degrees, S5, adjusting an early warning threshold based on the integrated confidence degrees, and S6, judging that dangerous risks occur and carrying out safety early warning when the feature enhancement early warning index values exceed the adjusted early warning threshold. The invention can improve the accuracy, the real-time performance and the foresight of the dynamic early warning of the coal and gas risks.
assignees: CHONGQING MAS SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Road alarm help-seeking positioning early warning system based on multi-mode interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road alarming help-seeking positioning early warning system based on multi-mode interaction, which relates to the technical field of intelligent transportation and safety emergency, and comprises an alarming help-seeking positioning early warning platform and a mobile phone end information acquisition program, wherein a characteristic extraction and matching model is constructed by integrating voice, image and map positioning three-in-one information closed loop with characteristics of voice description event, visual image site presentation and accurate positioning and locking position is formed, the voice interaction can rapidly capture key semantics, make up the defect that an image cannot directly transmit text information, the image recognition can intuitively display site details, solve the problem that voice description is disturbed by noise or information loss caused by user tension, provide position coordinates through a GPS technology in map positioning, perform feature matching and credibility calculation on three-mode data, realize cross-validation of multi-source data, remarkably reduce treatment delay caused by information deviation and provide more reliable decision basis for rescue departments.

title_en: Partial discharge real-time monitoring and early warning system based on multisource data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of discharge monitoring and early warning, in particular to a partial discharge real-time monitoring and early warning system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein a signal physical separation module is used for classifying a decision tree of a mixed transient signal flow to separate pure electromagnetic wave velocity type signal sources and mechanical wave velocity type signal sources; the feature marking module extracts feature points with unified time references and marks physical attribute categories, the dual-path credibility fusion module respectively executes time difference logic verification on the two types of feature points, marks credible discharge events only when an electromagnetic wave verification result and a mechanical wave verification result are simultaneously logic value 1, generates event confidence parameters through dynamic confidence fusion, achieves physical interlocking verification and uniqueness locking, dynamically adjusts response threshold values based on the event confidence parameters, only confirms real discharge to physical essence, and triggers targeted response to threat that the confidence meets standards, solves the problem of distinguishing real discharge events from multi-source interference, and reliably identifies the real discharge events.

title_en: Slope disaster real-time monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster monitoring and provides a slope disaster real-time monitoring and early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of arranging a distributed optical fiber sensing network, a Beidou GNSS receiver, a micro pore water pressure gauge and an inclinometer at the surface position and the deep position of a target slope to obtain inner and outer cooperative monitoring data; the method comprises the steps of extracting and calculating a plurality of branch characterization values in internal and external collaborative monitoring data, calculating and generating multisource fusion characteristic data based on the plurality of branch characterization values, establishing a dynamic threshold monitoring model, calculating and generating a real-time early warning threshold, establishing a multi-level linkage early warning mechanism based on the real-time early warning threshold, and realizing internal and external collaborative monitoring through a multi-mode sensor network to comprehensively capture slope state information. The multi-source data fusion process improves the data quality and reliability, the dynamic threshold model is accurately adapted to different working conditions, and the multi-stage linkage early warning mechanism ensures timely response. The accuracy and timeliness of slope disaster early warning are improved greatly, and disaster loss is reduced effectively.
assignees: AEROSPACE PLANNING & DESIGN GROUP CO LTD;China aerospace construction group co ltd

title_en: Side slope early warning method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a side slope early warning method and a side slope early warning system based on a knowledge graph, and relates to the technical field of multi-source monitoring side slope early warning, comprising the following steps of firstly, unifying laser, radar, satellite remote sensing and ground water level monitoring flow into an index-structure-disaster graph containing traceable metadata; the method comprises the steps of generating a destabilizing trigger coefficient by using a gradient lifting model driven by coupling trend and credibility, automatically outputting a short message, broadcasting and social templates, implanting abstract code release, comparing returned texts in real time, marking deviation nodes according to graph consistency and tracing source links, hashing and solidifying core early warning fragments and transmission performance to the alliance links, and writing back knowledge graph optimization templates and channels. The scheme realizes the alignment of multi-source data, accurate and reliable early warning, consistent cross-medium semantics and traceable evidence chains, and meets the requirements of the whole disaster prevention process in mountain areas.
assignees: UNIV XIAN AERONAUTICAL

title_en: Multi-sensor fused marine engineering gear processing real-time quality prediction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sensor fusion real-time quality prediction system for marine engineering gear machining, which relates to the technical field of marine engineering gear machining prediction and comprises a multi-dimensional sensing data acquisition module, a self-adaptive data preprocessing module, a space-time feature fusion module, a quality prediction model, a real-time decision feedback module and a system cooperative control module, wherein the acquisition module comprises a multi-type sensor and synchronously records technological parameters, the preprocessing module is used for reducing noise, smoothing data and supplementing abnormal values, the feature fusion module is used for extracting multi-source data feature construction vectors, the prediction model is used for improving DBN output quality indexes, the decision module is used for comparing threshold early warning or adjusting parameters, and the cooperative module adopts an edge-cloud architecture to ensure real-time prediction and model updating. The multi-sensor fusion covering full-dimensional information can predict quality in real time, avoid post detection waste, is high in model adaptability, can cope with multi-material working conditions, accurately positions defect sources, and improves processing quality and production efficiency.
assignees: NANJING JINTUO OCEAN ENG EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: High-precision fault tracking and positioning method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision fault tracking and positioning method based on the Internet of things, and belongs to the technical field of the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing four state models based on vibration frequency spectrums, temperature fields, oil liquid states and noise time domain characteristics of equipment respectively, outputting corresponding state coefficients, then calculating the adaptation degree of the vibration and noise state coefficients under the constraint of the temperature field coefficients to evaluate data consistency, and finally fusing the adaptation degree of the vibration and noise, the oil liquid state coefficients and the equipment using time length, and constructing equipment confidence degree through an exponential decay model. The confidence is a quantitative indicator between 0 and 1, with a larger value indicating that the device is healthier. The method overcomes the limitations of the existing single parameter diagnosis method through multi-source information depth fusion and dynamic credibility evaluation, realizes accurate quantitative evaluation of the health state of the electromechanical equipment and early warning and high-precision positioning of faults, and remarkably improves the intelligent level and reliability of equipment management.
assignees: ZHU WEIWEI

title_en: Petrochemical wastewater discharge detection method based on multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wastewater discharge detection, and discloses a petrochemical wastewater discharge detection method based on multi-source data analysis, which comprises the steps of firstly, deploying an environment sensor at each drainage outlet, and monitoring various physical and chemical parameters of water quality to obtain multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of collecting data, preprocessing the collected data, including noise filtering, abnormal value correction and filling of missing values, normalizing the missing values to improve the data quality, analyzing the processed data, respectively extracting a first characteristic index reflecting the current instantaneous water quality state and a second characteristic index reflecting the accumulated emission trend in a time period, quantifying the two characteristic indexes by calculating cosine similarity of a real-time state vector and a standard state vector, and finally performing intelligent diagnosis based on the key characteristic indexes, and performing hierarchical assessment and early warning on the sewage emission risk by adopting a three-level early warning mechanism, so that the accurate and automatic monitoring of the emission of the sewage is realized.
assignees: TIANJIN ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE TIANJIN ENVIRONMENTAL PLANNING INSTITUTE TIANJI

title_en: Internet of things middleware monitoring system and method based on multi-protocol compatibility
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring of the Internet of things, and provides a monitoring system and a monitoring method based on multiprotocol compatible middleware of the Internet of things, which are used for monitoring sensor performance degradation and correcting data in an atmospheric pollution environment. The method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting multi-source data through multi-protocol compatible middleware, constructing a basic data set with unified space-time labels, extracting core characteristic indexes of quantitative performance degradation from the basic data set, constructing a short-term correction model and a long-term degradation model, calculating equipment health indexes by combining the long-term models, judging health state grades, implementing grading data guarantee according to the state grades, compensating normal and early-warning sensors in real time, reconstructing data of a failure sensor based on spatial interpolation, and finally outputting standardized monitoring data streams. The invention realizes the real-time perception, predictive evaluation and self-adaptive correction of the sensor performance, changes the periodic maintenance into predictive maintenance, and improves the reliability and the data quality of the monitoring network.
assignees: TAIZHOU HUANKE ENVIRONMENTAL PROT EQUIPMENT OPERATION MAINTENANCE CO LTD

title_en: Atmospheric pollutant transmission diffusion model optimization method and prediction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method and a prediction system for an atmospheric pollutant transmission diffusion model. In the invention, the data quality basis is improved through dynamic layering preprocessing. The self-adaptive filtering technology is adopted to effectively filter random noise in environment monitoring data, the interpolation method combined with the attention mechanism enables missing data to fill up more fitting actual monitoring rules, and when the early warning level changes, the abnormal value judgment standard is automatically adjusted, so that the problem of error filtering or retention caused by fixed threshold values is avoided, the preprocessed environment data is more similar to the actual state, reliable input is provided for subsequent feature extraction, and the cross-modal feature enhancement extraction enhances the adaptability of the model to complex environments. The self-supervision learning framework can mine deep associated features from multi-source data, and after the physical features and the deep learning features are fused, the self-supervision learning framework helps the model to better capture the change characteristics of pollutants under different time-space conditions, so that more comprehensive feature support is provided for subsequent anomaly detection and early warning.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG SHUREN

title_en: Visual early warning method for fusion risk identification of multi-source heterogeneous data of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network multi-source heterogeneous data fusion risk identification visual early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of power transmission and distribution of power systems and comprises the following steps of S1, multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and preprocessing, S2, primary data fusion based on dynamic credibility, S3, risk identification and depth fusion based on a hybrid reasoning model, and S4, risk conduction link mining and visual early warning. According to the invention, by introducing the dynamic credibility weight and the Bayesian and deep learning mixed reasoning model, more accurate and reliable risk identification is realized, and three-dimensional visualization is performed by constructing the risk conduction link, so that visual insight on the risk evolution process is realized, the early warning capability of the safe operation of the power distribution network is greatly improved, the origin and evolution process of the risk and possibly caused linkage influence can be visually displayed, and an operation and maintenance person can quickly position the core problem and formulate an effective treatment strategy.
assignees: WUZHI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Multi-source business data restoration method based on offline data warehouse
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data warehouse, in particular to a method for repairing multi-source abnormal business data based on an offline data warehouse, which comprises the steps that a data server submits or modifies business abnormal data processing in a business abnormal data processing base according to the latest offline business data which is processed, the business abnormal data processing base generates repairing tasks on time, the multi-source changed business data and the repairing tasks are compared, an optimal repairing scheme or no repairing is adopted according to a data repairing optimization rule, detailed record information of repairing each field and a repairing database table after the fields are combined are finally generated, and error data and early warning data can be further extracted from the detailed record information for the next round of data repairing work. The method can be used for self-adapting to the data change of the source system to effectively assist or replace each source system to finish the repair of the business abnormal data in a synchronous mode, greatly improving the data quality of a data warehouse and simultaneously reducing the burden caused by the data abnormality of the source system.
assignees: JIANGXI YIYUAN MULTI MEDIA TECH CO LTD;JIANGXI HUARUI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide disaster point big data acquisition and sample library updating method based on event triggering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster point big data acquisition and sample library updating method based on event triggering. And after big data fusion is carried out on the heterogeneous data, the heterogeneous data is stored in a landslide geological disaster sample library, so that the data of the sample library is updated, and the aim of improving the landslide geological disaster monitoring and early warning data quality is fulfilled. According to the method, the timeliness of large-data acquisition of landslide disaster points is improved, the problem that the existing geological disaster reporting site is not accurate enough is solved, the accuracy of obtaining the topographic data of the disaster point area is improved, and large-area and low-cost calculation processing of the surface deformation data of the disaster point area is realized.

title_en: Website performance optimization supervision system and method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a website performance optimization supervision system and method based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the technical field of Internet, and are used for acquiring access feedback data of all webpages in a website to be checked, analyzing the running state of the webpages, determining the abnormal situation of the webpages, generating a directed weighted graph of the website according to the jump relation between the webpages, analyzing the abnormal sources of the webpages, obtaining the quality scores of the webpages based on the abnormal sources of the webpages, obtaining the quality scores of the website based on the quality scores of the webpages and the directed weighted graph of the website, monitoring the access feedback data of the webpages, finding the webpages related to the abnormal sources, analyzing the webpage and the website according to the abnormal sources, so that the quality evaluation of the webpage and the website is more reasonable, timely finding and processing the webpages related to the abnormal sources, obtaining better index scores when the website is subjected to inspection, facilitating the improvement of the image of the website, and checking and processing the abnormal sources, and improving the efficiency and speed of the website detection.
assignees: NANJING NANBAO ZIJINYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Health information monitoring and management system based on multisource data fusion analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health information monitoring and management, and discloses a health information monitoring and management system based on multi-source data fusion analysis. The physiological data acquisition unit acquires multi-source heterogeneous data streams, a multi-layer fusion topology is constructed through preprocessing, the fusion analysis engine realizes data feature association and anomaly detection through feature association and pattern recognition, and the intelligent decision management module generates a health state reference strategy and dynamically distributes data source weights. The real-time calibration module calibrates the signal time domain, adapts the analysis frequency, the data weight optimization module evaluates the optimization strategy based on the credibility, and the fault-tolerant processing module combines the distributed cache unit to complete data verification and recovery. The system realizes the efficient fusion, dynamic decision and reliable management of multi-source data, improves the accuracy of health monitoring and the robustness of the system, and is suitable for intelligent health management scenes.
assignees: BEIJING DAOKETUO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for fault water disaster sensing and danger relieving operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine disaster prevention and control, in particular to a fault water disaster sensing and danger eliminating operation method and system, comprising the steps of setting a monitoring area, carrying out three-dimensional space grid segmentation, calculating the coupling coefficient of data in each grid, setting a multi-level risk threshold value, and judging the risk level of the coupling coefficient of each grid; based on the determined grid risk level, a knowledge reasoning mode, an acoustic warning mode and a three-dimensional visual mode are established, a normalization result is weighted and fused according to a preset credibility weight to obtain a final risk value, the final risk value is compared with a preset early warning threshold value to trigger corresponding level early warning, the grid of high risk early warning is determined based on the determined grid of the corresponding level early warning, a drilling verification and grouting plugging danger solving process is started, and the technical problem of collaborative perception, early warning and danger solving intelligent collaborative difference of mine disaster multisource data is solved.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Reservoir dam operation safety sky land hydraulic intelligent sensing system and operation method
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent sensing system and an operation method for a sky-land hydraulic engineering of reservoir dam operation safety, and relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering safety monitoring. The system is composed of a sky-ground hydraulic engineering integrated monitoring sensing system, a self-adaptive sampling module, a layered distributed architecture and a software-hardware integrated module, wherein the system dynamically adjusts the monitoring frequency by utilizing a self-adaptive sampling strategy through five dimensions of a space domain, an air domain, a region, a water area and a working domain to cooperatively collect multi-source data such as deformation, seepage, stress strain, vibration and environmental quantity, and completes data cleaning, standardization, space-time registration and fusion processing through the distributed architecture, so as to generate a high-quality comprehensive data set. The system can realize the fine monitoring of the whole elements and the whole process, effectively eliminate the data island, improve the data quality and the monitoring efficiency, has high reliability, instantaneity and expandability, and provides powerful data support and decision basis for dam safety evaluation and intelligent early warning.
assignees: CHANGJIANG SPATIAL INFORMATION TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD WUHAN;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Hybrid energy storage system optimal scheduling method based on AI intelligent regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI intelligent regulation-based hybrid energy storage system optimization scheduling method, which relates to the technical field of hybrid energy storage and comprises the following steps of collecting real-time data, cross-verifying data consistency through a multi-source data fusion technology, and identifying data anomalies caused by sensor faults, communication delays and environmental interference and eliminating the anomalies by utilizing a self-adaptive threshold detection combined with a statistical analysis method. According to the invention, the energy storage scheduling is optimized through data cleaning, time sequence prediction and reinforcement learning, and the intelligent management and dynamic adaptability are improved. The data accuracy is ensured by adopting multi-source data fusion and anomaly detection, and the energy consumption is predicted by means of LSTM and Transformer, so that the energy storage strategy is optimized in advance. In combination with reinforcement learning, the system dynamically adjusts charge and discharge, improves the light Fu Xiaona rate, reduces the electricity purchasing cost, intelligently controls the SOC to be in the range of 40% -80%, and prolongs the service life of the battery. Meanwhile, the system stability is improved through abnormality detection and correction, and the maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Ocean ecological abnormity danger identification method and device based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine ecological abnormity risk identification method based on multi-source heterogeneous data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a multi-source heterogeneous data file of a target sea area; generating a quality control report according to the multi-source heterogeneous data file; establishing a marine information database according to multi-source heterogeneous data meeting a data quality standard; establishing an ocean numerical model on a cloud platform, and updating an ocean information database to obtain an updated ocean information database; acquiring a primary marine ecological anomaly index data product according to the updated marine information database; carrying out weighted average on each marine ecological anomaly index data product to obtain a secondary marine ecological anomaly index data product of a target sea area; and detecting a threshold value of the secondary marine ecological abnormal index data product, and if an abnormal index greater than a first preset threshold value exists, sending early warning information. The marine ecological abnormal danger identification method based on the multi-source heterogeneous data can effectively improve the accuracy of marine ecological abnormal danger identification.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA SEA MARINE FORECASTING CENTER OF STATE OCEANIC ADMINISTRATION MARINE FORECAST STATION OF

title_en: Power transmission line defect hidden danger prediction method and system based on multi-source meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting hidden danger of a transmission line defect based on multisource meteorological data, which relate to the technical field of prediction of hidden danger of the transmission line defect, and comprise the steps of dividing the transmission towers in a transmission tower distribution diagram into areas based on geographic information, dividing the transmission towers with the same geographic information into one area, numbering the areas to obtain numbered areas, establishing a historical line defect association model, predicting the meteorological data according to multisource, the method comprises the steps of obtaining weather-influencing parameters of a power transmission tower and weather-influencing parameters of a wire, obtaining the regional quality index, enabling a predictor to predict that line defects can occur in the power transmission tower and the wire in a numbering region under the weather-influencing of a multi-source weather environment in the future, sequencing the numbering region through early warning indexes of the power transmission line, obtaining maintenance line information, enabling the predictor to make a maintenance plan faster, and reducing maintenance cost of the power transmission line.
assignees: LIANZHI TECH TIANJIN CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fatigue driving monitoring and early warning method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fatigue driving monitoring and early warning method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, and relates to the technical field of multi-source data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting and preprocessing the face, physiological signs, historical driving behaviors, vehicle environment and maintenance multi-source data of a driver; and then three layers of fusion are carried out, wherein the unified dimension of the data layer is aligned with time, the characteristic layer is used for constructing a fatigue characteristic index FCF, the decision layer is used for calculating a fatigue driving risk index FDR by adopting an entropy weight-AHP combined weighting method, four early warning grades are divided for hierarchical early warning through cluster analysis based on the FDR value, and meanwhile, the robustness of the system is improved through sensor fault switching, data conflict resolution and personalized baseline calibration. The invention fuses all-link data of 'physiological-behavior-environment-vehicle', and obviously improves the accuracy, early stage and reliability of fatigue monitoring.

title_en: Slope stability early warning method based on multisource monitoring data change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope stability early warning method based on multi-source monitoring data change, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and comprises the following steps of S1, deploying various monitoring devices such as geological sensors, weather stations, remote sensing devices and the like, and collecting multi-source monitoring data of slope areas such as geology, weather and remote sensing images and the like in real time; the method comprises the steps of S2, cleaning, format conversion and outlier processing of collected original monitoring data, ensuring data quality to adapt to subsequent analysis, S3, comprehensively processing the data of different monitoring sources by utilizing a data fusion technology, reducing errors of a single data source and improving data reliability.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Multi-source monitoring data fusion foundation pit safety early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foundation pit safety early warning method based on multisource monitoring data fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a foundation pit safety evaluation index system and obtaining the accumulated value and the change rate of multisource time sequence monitoring indexes; secondly, determining a foundation pit safety level identification framework, taking multi-source time sequence monitoring data as different evidences and carrying out normalization processing; then, according to the multi-source time sequence monitoring data, determining a basic probability distribution value in the identification framework; then respectively calculating the weight and the credibility of the multi-source monitoring index; and finally, fusing the multisource monitoring data of the foundation pit to obtain the safety evaluation grade of the foundation pit. The invention is characterized in that: on the basis of fully utilizing actual measurement monitoring data of the foundation pit, importance of different monitoring indexes and credibility of evidence are considered, objectivity of foundation pit safety state identification is guaranteed, interference of subjective human factors is avoided, and defects of a traditional D-S evidence theory can be effectively overcome.
assignees: GUANGZHOU INST OF BUILDING SCIENCE GROUP CO LTD;GUANGZHOU CONSTR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Lead bismuth fast reactor multiplexing Kuang Duo sensor state monitoring method, device and verification system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sensor on-line state monitoring and signal reconstruction, in particular to a lead bismuth fast reactor multiplexing Kuang Duo sensor state monitoring method, a device and a verification system. The method comprises the following steps of fault mechanism mathematical modeling, determining pressure measuring instrument mechanism and mathematical modeling, fault injection and data preprocessing analysis, multi-task identification and multi-sensor association relation analysis, data anomaly detection, sensor and system fault identification model construction, fault sensor positioning model construction, sensor fault type identification model construction, sensor failure reconstruction and reconstruction signal local fusion based on inverse variance weighting. According to the invention, under the complex environment of the nuclear facility and under the condition of sensor failure, the reconstruction of signals is realized by analyzing redundancy by using an artificial intelligent algorithm, so that the use reliability of the sensor of the nuclear facility is improved, and the prevention capability of the nuclear facility on sensor faults and accidents and the self-adaptive capability under severe environments are improved.
assignees: NUCLEAR POWER INST CHINA

title_en: Intelligent management platform system for data integration of whole process of pond engineering construction
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent construction and digital twinning, and discloses an intelligent management platform system for the whole process data integration of the construction of a pond engineering, which comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module, a core data fusion and reasoning module, an intelligent application and evolution module and a comprehensive visualization and decision support module, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module is used for acquiring and standardizing construction data, the core data fusion and reasoning module is used for constructing a construction process causal map for representing the relation between elements, the credibility of each state node is calculated through a multi-source evidence theory fusion engine, the intelligent application and evolution module is used for carrying out risk forward propagation early warning and root cause backward retroactive diagnosis based on the construction process causal map, and the comprehensive visualization and decision support module is used for fusing and displaying an analysis result and a BIM/GIS model. According to the application, a causal knowledge graph and evidence fusion reasoning mechanism is constructed, so that the problems of data island and information uncertainty are solved, active early warning, accurate tracing and dynamic self-adaptation of a system of construction risks are realized, and the intelligent management level of the pond engineering is remarkably improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HYDROPOWER CONSTRUCTION AND INSTALLATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent prediction method for large passenger flow of railway junction based on space-time attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent prediction method for large passenger flow of a railway junction based on a space-time attention mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent transportation and transportation prediction. The method comprises the steps of multi-source data acquisition and preprocessing, constructing a fusion model based on an LSTM network and a random forest algorithm, obtaining a third passenger flow prediction result by using the trained fusion model, performing cross-model residual correction on the third passenger flow prediction result to obtain a final fusion prediction result, performing early warning grade division according to the fusion prediction result and an early warning threshold value, and performing corresponding dynamic response and scheduling output. The intelligent early warning and dynamic control output of the large passenger flow of the railway junction are realized based on multi-source decision fusion of the deep learning prediction result and the nonlinear characteristic model result, a multi-model decision confidence fusion mechanism is established through a D-S evidence theory, and the credibility enhancement and early warning grading response of the prediction result are realized by combining a passenger flow threshold grading strategy.
assignees: HUAIYIN INST TECHNOLOGY;XUZHOU TRANSP COMPREHENSIVE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW ENFORCEMENT DIVISION

title_en: Power supply network power failure monitoring and early warning method based on data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply network monitoring, in particular to a power supply network power failure monitoring early warning method based on data fusion, which realizes dynamic intelligent fusion of multi-source heterogeneous data, improves the data quality and reliability of risk assessment, simultaneously realizes key technical transition from passive response to failure to active blocking risk, avoids risk diffusion through early intervention, finally realizes preventive operation and maintenance of a power supply network, converts macroscopic risk level into accurate node-level risk positioning by combining physical connection relation and load characteristics of the power supply network, and simultaneously automatically generates an operation and maintenance suggestion table with priority by constructing a comprehensive influence coefficient model, and the output result provides clear decision basis for accurate delivery of operation and maintenance resources, scheduling sequence of emergency repair teams and starting of emergency plans, thereby being capable of shortening power failure time to the maximum extent, reducing power failure range and reducing social economic loss.
assignees: LESHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Data quality improvement method and system based on multidimensional treatment strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data quality improving method and system based on a multidimensional governance strategy, which relate to the technical field of data governance and comprise the steps of constructing a repeated data identification mechanism of a dynamic main key through metadata blood-margin analysis; the multi-mode incomplete data complement strategy based on field importance comprises a three-level error processing flow with automatic correction, rule early warning and manual intervention, and full-link management tracing based on a blockchain technology. The invention can obviously improve the data availability, reduce the manual intervention cost and is suitable for automatic data cleaning and quality management in a large-scale heterogeneous data environment.
assignees: TIANYUAN BIG DATA CREDIT MAN CO LTD

title_en: Automatic driving system reliability self-diagnosis method and platform based on multi-mode sensor fusion
