abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic driving system reliability self-diagnosis method and platform based on multi-mode sensor fusion, the method comprises the steps of obtaining image mode data, carrying out feature extraction by utilizing a vision transducer model, generating an environment scene tag, representing the type of a current environment, carrying out statistics on key mode features in actual automatic driving operation data, obtaining a mode scoring vector corresponding to each environment scene tag, reflecting priori credibility of each sensor mode in the environment, calculating mode trust weight by softmax, obtaining a confidence weight vector, carrying out weighted fusion on the key mode features based on the confidence weight vector, obtaining fusion features, generating mode reconstruction features according to the fusion features, generating a mode consistency error vector based on the mode reconstruction features, combining the confidence weight vector and the mode consistency error vector, and determining an early warning signal of the current system, wherein the early warning signal is used for judging whether fusion degradation or mode failure risk exists in the system.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRONIC PROD RELIABILITY & ENVIRONMENTAL TESTING RES INST 5TH ELECTRONIC RES

title_en: Agricultural product safety risk prediction and self-adaptive supervision system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of agricultural product safety supervision, in particular to an agricultural product safety risk prediction and self-adaptive supervision system based on deep learning, wherein a data acquisition module acquires agricultural product growth environment, soil, fertilizer and pesticide information, a storage module is utilized to store the agricultural product growth environment, soil, fertilizer and pesticide information in a distributed big data form, a data analysis module adopts technologies such as multi-mode data fusion, self-adaptive attention feature extraction, growth variable prediction and self-correction, progressive deep learning network and the like to carry out deep analysis and risk prediction on data, an evaluation module evaluates, classifies and early-warns the agricultural product safety risk according to analysis results, an optimization module analyzes deviation of environmental risk data and a target safety quality index according to safety quality evaluation results, calculates adjustment parameters to guide agricultural production, and a visual early warning module displays the environmental data, the safety quality prediction data and the adjusted guide parameters, so that the comprehensiveness and accuracy of risk identification are remarkably improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU RUISEN BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD;GUANGDONG INST FOR FOOD

title_en: Urban waterlogging risk early warning method based on radar observation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar observation-based urban waterlogging risk early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of weather radar early warning, and comprises the steps of carrying out data quality control on refined X-band radar data obtained by observation of an X-band weather radar, carrying out quantitative rainfall estimation on the data subjected to the data quality control by using radar observation polarization parameters, obtaining a multi-source fusion rainfall driving field capable of covering a whole domain, constructing a waterlogging simulation model, simulating a rainfall runoff generating process, calculating a slope converging process by using a nonlinear reservoir model, simulating a converging transmission process of a river channel and a pipe network by using a san-veling process, checking whether overflow occurs in the river channel and the pipe network, and carrying out visual presentation on disaster factors, important processes and waterlogging risk distribution in the flow domain based on a ground surface inundation simulation result.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Sugarcane acid aluminum resistance prediction method based on multimode data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sugarcane acid-aluminum resistance prediction method based on multimode data fusion, which comprises the following steps of constructing an artificial data acquisition frame, developing visible light vegetation indexes, providing novel acid-response indexes AVI  AI , establishing a parameter optimizer driven by artificial detection data, dynamically calibrating DSSAT parameters, generating a continuous field AL  3+  distribution map by adopting Kriging interpolation, embedding an aluminum toxicity inhibition function in DSSAT-CANEGRO source code plant environment.for files, calculating an acid-response index based on a smart phone RGB image, calculating a browning area occupation ratio, performing cubic spline interpolation on discrete artificial detection data, designing a model frame by using a double-stage training strategy, and adjusting model fusion weights according to artificial data quality. The early warning of aluminum stress is realized, the fertilizer utilization rate is improved, and the application amount of the phosphate fertilizer is reduced.
assignees: GUANGXI ACADEMY AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title_en: Digital twinning-fused cable manufacturing multi-process optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent control and optimization systems, in particular to a multi-process optimization method and system for cable manufacture fusing digital twinning, comprising the steps of constructing a cable multi-process digital twinning model comprising a core library and a core list; the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data of multiple procedures in cable manufacture, preprocessing the multi-source data to generate a time sequence data set, calculating the load coefficient of each procedure by using a procedure load coefficient algorithm based on the data set, dynamically identifying the bottleneck procedure of a production line by combining bottleneck judgment rules, pre-judging quality indexes by using the digital twin model, calculating risk values, carrying out hierarchical early warning based on early warning threshold values, starting reverse tracing, combining associated data of a core library to locate quality anomalies, optimizing technological parameters by using a simulated annealing algorithm and a double population genetic algorithm, generating a parameter compensation scheme, completing multi-procedure technological optimization of the cable, and solving the problem of technological optimization deficiency caused by multi-source data fragmentation.
assignees: SHANDONG ZHONGHE CABLE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide disaster point big data acquisition and sample library updating method based on event triggering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster point big data acquisition and sample library updating method based on event triggering. And after big data fusion is carried out on the heterogeneous data, the heterogeneous data is stored in a landslide geological disaster sample library, so that the data of the sample library is updated, and the aim of improving the landslide geological disaster monitoring and early warning data quality is fulfilled. According to the method, the timeliness of large-data acquisition of landslide disaster points is improved, the problem that the existing geological disaster reporting site is not accurate enough is solved, the accuracy of obtaining the topographic data of the disaster point area is improved, and large-area and low-cost calculation processing of the surface deformation data of the disaster point area is realized.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA

title_en: Multi-source data quality improving method and system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, in particular to a multi-source data quality improving method which is particularly suitable for processing and optimizing load data. The method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on multi-source load data to obtain load data comprising a data mode and a data structure, carrying out anomaly detection on the load data by applying a local anomaly factor LOF algorithm to screen out anomaly data, correcting the detected anomaly data by a Pearson correlation analysis method, calculating a weight relation between load data features based on the feature extraction and anomaly correction results by applying an entropy weight method, and further optimizing a data correction and feature extraction process to improve overall data quality and accuracy. The method and the system not only provide a reliable data basis for big data analysis and running state evaluation of the intelligent power grid, but also effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of data mining and analysis, and provide solid guarantee for optimal scheduling and decision support of the power grid.
assignees: SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Road alarm help-seeking positioning early warning system based on multi-mode interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road alarming help-seeking positioning early warning system based on multi-mode interaction, which relates to the technical field of intelligent transportation and safety emergency, and comprises an alarming help-seeking positioning early warning platform and a mobile phone end information acquisition program, wherein a characteristic extraction and matching model is constructed by integrating voice, image and map positioning three-in-one information closed loop with characteristics of voice description event, visual image site presentation and accurate positioning and locking position is formed, the voice interaction can rapidly capture key semantics, make up the defect that an image cannot directly transmit text information, the image recognition can intuitively display site details, solve the problem that voice description is disturbed by noise or information loss caused by user tension, provide position coordinates through a GPS technology in map positioning, perform feature matching and credibility calculation on three-mode data, realize cross-validation of multi-source data, remarkably reduce treatment delay caused by information deviation and provide more reliable decision basis for rescue departments.
assignees: SHANXI XINGYUYUN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Node zero trust trusted access method for computing network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a node zero trust trusted access method and device for an algorithm network, and relates to the technical field of network security. The trust evaluation is carried out in the registration stage and the task execution stage of the computing node based on the principle of zero trust. In the registration stage, a multi-source trust modeling mechanism integrating identity attributes, capability observation and organization reputation is constructed, a Bayesian reasoning and graph regularization method is introduced to realize initial credibility assessment, in the operation stage, a multi-mode log anomaly detection method is designed, high-dimensional behavior modeling is carried out by combining semantics, time, parameters and quantity characteristics, anomaly identification capability is enhanced by utilizing long-sequence dependence, and a dynamic trust adjustment strategy is further provided by combining time attenuation and a user feedback mechanism to realize continuous evolution and refined access control of node trust. By utilizing the invention, the trusted access to the power computing nodes is realized by the scheduling system in the environment of the power computing network, and the safety and the reliability of the power computing network system are effectively improved.

title_en: Multi-dimensional information fusion-based early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional information fusion early warning method and system, which relate to the technical field of fusion analysis, and the method comprises the steps of preprocessing acquired real-time data streams to obtain real-time data snapshots, comparing analog quantity data, switching quantity data, protection information and equipment side monitoring data in the real-time data snapshots based on a predefined alarm threshold value and rule set to generate an initial alarm event list, verifying the credibility of each initial alarm event in the initial alarm event list, marking the credibility of each initial alarm event as credibility, forming a verified alarm event list by the initial alarm events, and aggregating a plurality of alarm events which are derived from the same physical disturbance in the verified alarm event list into an alarm event cluster based on system topological relation data according to time proximity and space correlation.
assignees: LANZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Wind turbine generator system gearbox fault early warning system based on space-time causal reasoning network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind turbine gearbox fault early warning system based on a space-time causal reasoning network, relates to a wind turbine early warning technology, and provides a scheme for solving the problem of insufficient early warning capability in the prior art. The system comprises a causal reasoning module, a time-space analysis module, a fault cause and confidence weighting module, an early fault early warning module and a hierarchical early warning suggestion, wherein the causal reasoning module is used for extracting time domain and frequency domain characteristics from original signals acquired by a plurality of vibration acceleration sensors of a wind turbine generator, constructing a dependency relationship network among the sensors through causal reasoning, establishing a dynamic causal map, the spatio-temporal analysis module is used for capturing an abnormal propagation mode through a spatio-temporal collaboration mechanism by combining stability of a time sequence and topological characteristics of a space causal network, the fault cause and confidence weighting module is used for identifying a fault root cause through the causal reasoning mechanism and enhancing confidence of a detection result based on multi-source evidence, and the early fault early warning module is used for realizing intelligent fault detection and accurate positioning based on a causal enhanced probability model. The method has the advantages that the causal relationship is established by combining the correlation analysis, and the causal graph and the comprehensive health index are constructed.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Distribution network side micro-environment multi-source meteorological data space-time alignment and fusion method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time alignment and fusion method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for micro-environment multi-source meteorological data on a distribution network side, which comprise the steps of acquiring equipment coordinates and cloud grid meteorological data, and acquiring point measurement meteorological data in real time; according to the grid where the equipment is located and the adjacent grids, interpolating grid meteorological data to the equipment position for space alignment, carrying out time synchronization on the grid meteorological data and point measurement meteorological data based on a preset time reference and a historical change trend, constructing a state space model, carrying out self-adaptive fusion on the interpolated grid meteorological data and point measurement meteorological data, carrying out anomaly detection on multi-source data in the fusion process, calculating the confidence coefficient of a fusion result based on fusion errors, dividing data quality grades according to the confidence coefficient, scheduling data transmission strategies according to the quality grades, and carrying out anomaly monitoring on the running state of the system. The data precision and reliability of multi-source meteorological data fusion can be improved, and the energy consumption is low and the adaptability is strong.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent business decision method based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information and provides an intelligent business decision method based on multi-source heterogeneous data, which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data of different business scenes, judging whether the data meets the preset quality requirement by adopting a data quality evaluation model, and outputting available multi-source heterogeneous data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a data blood-cause relation graph according to available multi-source heterogeneous data, recording data copy generation, conversion and calculation processes, avoiding repeated calculation, generating a marketing recommendation list, a risk early warning list and a product recommendation list according to the data blood-cause relation graph, realizing real-time data updating according to three scene data assets through a Redis caching mechanism, ensuring that a calling interface obtains the latest data, and realizing efficient data query and real-time data updating. The full-flow intellectualization from data acquisition and processing to application is realized, the utilization efficiency of data assets is improved, accurate and timely business decision support is provided for enterprises, and the marketing effect, risk management and control capability and user experience are effectively improved.

title_en: Intelligent park property prevention and control management system based on data analysis and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data analysis-based intelligent park property prevention and control management system and an implementation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of property prevention and control. The invention comprehensively applies the data driving technology and the multi-mode fusion technology to the prevention and control management of the properties of the park, and builds a unified multi-mode universal management data analysis platform for multi-source heterogeneous data in the park. The system comprises a multi-mode information collection module and a multi-mode management and control module. The multi-mode information collection module uploads information data to the central machine room server through a network, and a multi-mode information model of the central machine room server performs model training and multi-mode association on property early warning information. And each multi-mode terminal feeds back and responds to the associated information. The intelligent park screening system reduces screening pressure for property prevention and control in the intelligent park, improves management and control efficiency, and improves flexibility, adaptability, safety and credibility of a property prevention and control management system.
assignees: HANGZHOU LVCHENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent airport periphery safety monitoring method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of safety precaution, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring the security of an intelligent airport enclosure. The method comprises the steps of collecting monitoring information through a multi-type sensor array, carrying out time synchronization processing to obtain multi-source synchronous monitoring data, carrying out space registration and noise reduction processing on the data, generating situation fusion data according to sensor reliability configuration weights, extracting space-time characteristics to construct intrusion characteristic features to obtain threat assessment results, determining early warning grades and matching response measures to form a treatment scheme, obtaining an optimal prevention and control scheme through situation deduction, optimizing monitoring parameters according to execution data, and generating an updated monitoring strategy. The application realizes accurate identification and quick response to the security threat of the periphery through intelligent analysis and fusion processing of the multi-source data.

title_en: Multi-parameter self-adaptive fusion evaluation method for transient process of hydroelectric generating set
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-parameter self-adaptive fusion evaluation method for a transient process of a hydroelectric generating set, and belongs to the field of operation state evaluation of hydroelectric generating sets. According to the method, key operation parameters such as vibration, pressure, rotating speed and the like are synchronously acquired through a multipoint high-precision sensor, and characteristic indexes are extracted through pretreatment. And combining Logistic chaotic mapping to give weight to each parameter in a self-adaptive way, and fusing multi-source uncertainty data by adopting interval value fuzzy integration to realize comprehensive and objective assessment of the starting dynamic characteristics of the water turbine. The method overcomes the defects of strong subjectivity, poor anti-interference performance, poor robustness and the like of the traditional method, improves the accuracy and the credibility of the evaluation result, and can provide scientific basis for intelligent monitoring and risk early warning of the running state of the unit.
assignees: CHINA INST OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RESEARCH

title_en: Multi-dimensional health data fusion method based on large model
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-dimensional health data fusion method based on a large model, which belongs to the technical field of health data, and comprises the steps of collecting multi-dimensional health data of users by adopting multi-source sensing equipment, establishing a data quality evaluation mechanism for integrity detection and outlier processing, establishing a health data semantic alignment layer for realizing uniform and standardized processing of timestamps, carrying out deep feature extraction and multi-head attention association analysis by utilizing a health evaluation optimization model based on a Transformer framework, screening key index combinations by using an ecological niche competition optimization algorithm, establishing a health risk early warning mechanism for hierarchical evaluation and dynamic monitoring, establishing a dynamic feedback adjustment mechanism for optimizing model parameters, and forming a complete multi-dimensional health data fusion analysis system, thereby solving the technical problem of low accuracy of health state evaluation caused by the lack of an effective fusion mechanism of the multi-dimensional health data.
assignees: MEILEHUI SHANDONG HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Regional landslide hidden danger automatic identification system and method based on geological features
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic identifying system and method for regional landslide hidden danger based on geological features, and relates to the technical field of intelligent sensors. The regional landslide hidden danger automatic identification system and method based on the geological features comprise the steps of S1, obtaining multi-source monitoring data and geological constraint data, preprocessing the multi-source monitoring data to construct a landslide monitoring database, S2, analyzing the credibility of physical parameters of a sliding belt based on weighted sensitivity and residual accumulation of the multi-source monitoring data, S3, carrying out space coupling analysis through multi-source deformation and geometric parameter data, dynamically optimizing sliding belt form identification and connectivity adjustment operation, S4, carrying out dynamic instability analysis through deformation rate and sliding surface geometric fusion data, quantifying the instability trend of the sliding belt, and S5, merging the three-dimensional sliding surface probability body and space-time evolution indexes to comprehensively judge the stable state of a monitoring unit. The problems of inaccurate sliding belt parameter inversion, low sliding surface judgment precision and early warning hysteresis in regional landslide hidden danger identification are solved.
assignees: QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION TECH GUIDANCE CENTER QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORIN

title_en: Hydropower station plant deformation monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower house deformation monitoring method, which comprises the following steps of collecting multidimensional monitoring data and point cloud data of a hydropower house, carrying out self-adaptive filtering noise reduction on the multidimensional monitoring data, carrying out spatial registration on the multidimensional monitoring data and the point cloud data under a unified three-dimensional coordinate system, constructing a multichannel time sequence deep learning model, constructing a dynamic early warning threshold model based on material characteristics, equipment operation parameters and historical monitoring data, carrying out risk assessment, triggering a three-level response mechanism according to a risk assessment result, establishing a sensor reliability evaluation index, dynamically optimizing data fusion weight, adjusting a classification model decision boundary, and carrying out visualization and traceability analysis on the multidimensional monitoring data.
assignees: ZHONGYU BRANCH STATE ENERGY GROUP TIBET ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;POWERCHINA NORTHWEST ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Quality detection system of thermal power plant fuel
abstract_en: The invention provides a quality detection system of thermal power plant fuel, which relates to the technical field of detection and comprises a multi-mode acquisition module, a data fusion processing module, an evaluation module and an intelligent early warning module, wherein the multi-mode acquisition module is used for acquiring multi-mode parameters of the thermal power plant fuel, the data fusion processing module is used for preprocessing the multi-mode parameters of the thermal power plant fuel and generating multi-dimensional feature vectors through the preprocessed multi-mode parameters, the evaluation module is used for evaluating the multi-dimensional feature vectors through the multi-mode fusion evaluation model, the intelligent early warning module comprises a first early warning unit and a second early warning unit, the first early warning unit is used for carrying out primary early warning when a certain mode parameter exceeds a preset threshold value, the second early warning unit is used for carrying out secondary early warning when the cosine similarity of the multi-dimensional feature vectors and historical inferior fuel features is larger than or equal to the preset value, and the third early warning unit is used for carrying out tertiary early warning when the predicted quality score is lower than the preset value through predicting multi-mode parameter trend. The multi-mode acquisition module covers various quality related parameters of the fuel, and compared with the traditional single parameter detection, the fuel quality characterization dimension is improved.
assignees: Huaneng qingdao thermoelectricity co ltd

title_en: Risk identification method and system based on mine data
abstract_en: The application discloses a risk identification method and system based on mine data, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The application realizes the effective fusion and collaborative analysis of the multi-source heterogeneous monitoring data and solves the problem of data island in the traditional method to a certain extent. And the space-time propagation rule of mine risks is captured through multi-level feature modeling of the dynamic space-time diagram. And by combining a dynamic correction mechanism of the real-time mining state, the adaptability of the risk identification result to the complex mining environment is improved. The application of the data quality evaluation matrix reduces the influence of low-quality data on analysis results to a certain extent, and improves the reliability of risk early warning.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PAISHAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire remote sensing intelligent monitoring integrated system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire remote sensing intelligent monitoring integrated system which comprises a multidimensional sensing subsystem, a unified data fusion platform module, an intelligent recognition and early warning module, a fire risk level evaluation module and a user interaction module, wherein the multidimensional sensing subsystem is responsible for collecting fire related data, the unified data fusion platform module is responsible for cleaning, checking, integrating and analyzing the fire related data to generate fire monitoring information, the intelligent recognition and early warning module is responsible for intelligently analyzing the fire monitoring information to recognize potential fire, the fire risk level evaluation module is responsible for evaluating fire risk level in real time, the real-time data quality control module is responsible for carrying out real-time monitoring and quality control on the data input into the system, and the user interaction module is used for providing a user interaction interface.
assignees: UNIV CHUZHOU

title_en: Emergency resource modularization allocation method for quick and accurate early warning response
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency resource allocation, and particularly relates to an emergency resource modularization allocation method with rapid and accurate early warning response. The method comprises the steps of collecting emergency event related information by utilizing a multi-source data acquisition channel, carrying out data cleaning pretreatment, evaluating risk level by utilizing an enhanced random forest algorithm, triggering an early warning mechanism, predicting emergency resource types and quantity by utilizing a multi-layer perceptron MLP based on historical data and current information, dividing the emergency resource types and quantity into different modules for allocation, and finally planning an optimal resource transportation path by utilizing a genetic algorithm. The method can effectively improve the data quality and the prediction accuracy, accurately judge the risk level, reasonably allocate the resources, optimize the transportation path, improve the emergency response efficiency and ensure the safe and stable operation of the power grid.
assignees: SHANDONG LURUAN DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Structural health monitoring method and system for multi-physical-field data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a structural health monitoring method and a system for multi-physical field data fusion, which are applied to the field of electronic digital data processing, and the structural health monitoring system comprises a structural health monitoring system, wherein the structural health monitoring system is used for carrying out fusion processing on a plurality of physical field data by dynamically regulating and controlling fusion weights, so that multidimensional reliability analysis and dynamic adjustment can be carried out on the data transmitted by a sensor, the error of the sensor data can be effectively reduced, the precision of data fusion is promoted, the structural health condition can be comprehensively reflected, the monitoring precision and reliability are improved, noise is effectively removed by utilizing a signal processing technology, the data quality is improved, the historical data can be subjected to deep analysis, intelligent fault prediction and health assessment are performed, real-time fault early warning is provided, accidents are reduced, potential problems can be found in advance through accurate fault prediction and health assessment, unnecessary inspection and maintenance are reduced, the maintenance efficiency is improved, and the maintenance cost is reduced.
assignees: WENLING CONSTRUCTION ENG QUALITY TESTING CO LTD

title_en: Building safety warning level dynamic adjustment method and system based on artificial intelligent driving
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic adjustment method and a system for building safety warning level based on artificial intelligence driving, which comprise the steps of receiving original monitoring data, space position data and data quality indexes of a sensor array, sequentially carrying out space-time alignment, feature extraction, quality assessment and anomaly detection through a multi-source heterogeneous data preprocessing frame, carrying out multidimensional feature fusion and risk pattern recognition analysis on the preprocessed data, sequentially realizing feature space construction, risk pattern extraction, relevance analysis and level assessment, realizing feature fusion, threshold optimization, level adjustment and effect assessment through a warning level dynamic adjustment mechanism based on risk level and confidence level, and finally carrying out information fusion, content generation, level classification and push optimization through intelligent generation and hierarchical push processing of early warning information. The method and the system remarkably improve the accuracy and timeliness of building safety early warning.

title_en: Intelligent acquisition method based on environment monitoring data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring, in particular to an intelligent acquisition method based on environmental monitoring data fusion, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-sensor distributed monitoring network, acquiring atmospheric, water quality, soil and meteorological environment data, S2, preprocessing data, including smoothing, anomaly detection, interpolation and time alignment, S3, carrying out three-level fusion of data sources, features and decisions, outputting environmental quality grades, S4, constructing a quality index system, monitoring data quality and adaptively optimizing fusion parameters in anomaly, S5, carrying out environmental trend prediction and pollution tracing based on fusion results, generating early warning information, S6, constructing a cross-mode causal graph, reasoning multi-source causal paths, and identifying pollution key factors and source responsibility main bodies. According to the invention, through multi-source environment data fusion and cross-modal causal reasoning, high-precision early warning of environment abnormality and intelligent traceability identification of pollution sources are realized.
assignees: WUHAN RUISITU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Three rainfall sensor data fusion calculation method, system and terminal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data fusion calculation method, a system and a terminal of three rainfall sensors, which are implemented by the following steps: acquiring minute rainfall values and hour rainfall values of three rainfall sensors, judging and calculating effective hour rainfall values according to four conditions, calculating reliable effective minute rainfall, and respectively outputting corresponding states of the three rainfall sensors; the observation data quality is greatly improved through the multi-sensor fusion observation practice of rainfall, more accurate rainfall observation data is provided for early warning and forecasting service, and the continuity of the data is ensured; on the other hand, the data state is identified through the computer background program, so that timely guidance is provided for equipment fault processing, the comprehensive popularization value is realized, meanwhile, experience is accumulated for next-step intelligent observation, the comprehensive intelligent direction is observed on the ground, and the method is worthy of further research of observation business personnel.
assignees: SHENZHEN NAT CLIMATE OBSERVATORY SHENZHEN ASTRONOMICAL OBSERVATORY

title_en: Intelligent Internet of things public safety management and control system and method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent internet of things public safety management and control system and method based on multi-source data fusion, and belongs to the technical field of internet of things safety. The system comprises the steps of loading corresponding model parameters and response strategies by identifying a system operation scene, realizing unified acquisition and standardization processing of multi-source data, and constructing a unified semantic representation structure. The system performs anomaly detection at the edge node, combines the semantic structure and the anomaly characteristic information, completes risk scoring and hierarchical alarm judgment, and generates a control response instruction based on policy matching. Meanwhile, dynamic optimization of a scoring model and identity authentication, behavior audit and data compliance derivation in the running process are supported. The intelligent recognition system has the capabilities of intelligent recognition, self-adaptive analysis and response closed loop, and improves the precision and the credibility of public safety management in the environment of the Internet of things.

title_en: Charging station depth defense protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station deep defense protection method, relates to the technical field of fire early warning and safety protection, and aims to solve the problems of high fire early warning false alarm rate, fire isolation delay and insufficient credibility of accident tracing data in the prior art. The method constructs a full-period protection system of 'monitoring-disposal-tracing', wherein a temperature field, electrical parameters and environmental data are collected through multi-source sensor fusion before disaster, a self-adaptive safety threshold is generated based on a dynamic game model, a digital twin deduction and prejudging risk path is combined, a three-level response mechanism is adopted in disaster, an operation log is stored in a slicing mode through a blockchain space-time anchoring technology after disaster, and a digital twin reverse reconstruction accident evolution chain is utilized to generate tamper-resistant judicial evidence. According to the invention, early warning precision is improved through dynamic threshold optimization, response time is shortened through multistage linkage control, traceability reliability is guaranteed through a quantum evidence storage technology, and a closed-loop optimization system for fire protection of the charging station is formed.

title_en: Heavy rain terminal early warning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heavy rain early warning, in particular to a heavy rain terminal early warning method and system based on deep learning, and consistency judgment is carried out on the turning state of the rain gauge and image characteristics such as a rain curtain, a water trace and the like, so that effective elimination of unnatural triggering factors (such as artificial water pouring and the like) is realized, and the credibility of rainfall sensing data is improved. And a locally-deployed double-branch deep learning model is adopted, multi-source data such as rainfall, temperature and humidity, topography factors and the like are fused, feature extraction and reproduction period prediction are performed based on a cross attention mechanism, and a threshold correction coefficient is dynamically generated by combining historical events, so that the self-adaptive adjustment of early warning standards is realized, and the false alarm and false alarm risk is effectively reduced. The system supports low-power-consumption local operation, performs early warning decision, and effectively improves timeliness and accuracy of local early warning response.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HUIYUAN ZHITONG TECH CO LTD;GUANGDONG FLOOD CONTROL SUPPORT AND RURAL WATER CONSERVANCY CENTER

title_en: Trans-regional flood risk prediction management system and method based on federal learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a federal learning-based trans-regional flood risk prediction management system and a federal learning-based trans-regional flood risk prediction management method, which relate to the technical field of flood risk prediction and comprise a trans-regional data acquisition module for acquiring multi-source flood observation data in a distributed mode and attaching a credibility label; the system comprises a coherent analysis clustering module, a joint prediction analysis module, a decision write-back module and a decision write-back module, wherein the coherent analysis clustering module calculates coherent correlation coefficients among monitoring stations based on weighted Pearson correlation coefficients, performs topological consistency clustering by combining physical connectivity and relationship stability, the joint prediction analysis module adopts a federal learning mode to train a flood risk prediction model based on clustering results, fuses a statistical channel and a physical channel to perform joint prediction, judges and optimizes simulation input through a leading boundary, and the decision write-back module generates multi-level early warning and targeted scheduling suggestions according to predicted values and writes back execution data to realize closed loop optimization. The problem of insufficient flood prediction precision under the heterogeneous and privacy protection of the trans-regional data is solved, and precise, efficient and safe trans-regional flood risk prediction management is realized.
assignees: SHAANXI WATER RESOURCES AND ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY AND DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Automatic data cleaning method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data quality processing, and discloses an automatic data cleaning method based on artificial intelligence. The method aims to solve the technical problem that in the prior art, under the condition of facing the coexistence of structured, semi-structured and unstructured multi-mode data, the high detection accuracy and the low false alarm rate are difficult to maintain simultaneously. According to the invention, multisource business data are uniformly mapped to the same feature space, and are analyzed by adopting a supervision classification logic and an unsupervised anomaly detection logic in parallel, a fusion weight is dynamically allocated according to a data leading mode, and the accurate identification of anomaly data is realized by combining a dynamic threshold value automatically adjusted based on a real false alarm rate and a fuzzy interval judgment mechanism every day, and the change of data distribution is monitored in real time through a closed loop feedback sample, and incremental update and gray verification are triggered when significant drift is detected, so that the stability of cleaning precision and false alarm rate is maintained when the data distribution is changed.
assignees: YUNJIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel monitoring method and device for data fusion, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel monitoring method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for data fusion, which comprise the following steps: s1, acquiring original data of tunnel deformation monitoring; s2, preprocessing the original data according to the type of the original data; s3, carrying out weighted fusion processing on the preprocessed data; s4, inputting the obtained original data into a training model to obtain prediction data at a prediction moment; s5, obtaining tunnel deformation strength at a prediction moment according to the prediction data; s6, comparing the tunnel deformation strength at the predicted moment with an early warning threshold value. By processing and fusing different data sources, the technology can comprehensively monitor and early warn tunnel deformation, improve the safety and sustainable operation of the tunnel, and ensure that factors such as data quality, a data fusion method and an early warning model are important so as to ensure the accuracy and reliability of a monitoring and early warning system.
assignees: CHINA 19TH METALLURGICAL CORP;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Remote monitoring method and system for floor metering device
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote monitoring method and a remote monitoring system for a floor metering device, which are characterized in that heterogeneous complementary original data are provided for data fusion through non-invasively acquired multi-source signals, clutter suppression pretreatment is carried out on the multi-source signals, the credibility foundation of the data fusion is directly improved, then a dynamic weight fusion technology is adopted, all signals after clutter suppression pretreatment are fused to obtain fused feature vectors, feature patterns are built according to the fused feature vectors, time sequence features are embedded, the feature patterns embedded with the time sequence features are input into a time sequence diagram neural network model based on transfer learning, state probability distribution is output, health indexes of internal elements are calculated in an inversion mode according to the state probability distribution, monitoring and early warning are carried out according to the health indexes and a double-dimensional early warning mechanism, and depth perception of the internal state of the floor metering device is realized.
assignees: JIANGXI SHIZHEN POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Park energy consumption monitoring and early warning method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a park energy consumption monitoring and early warning method and system based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of energy monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical energy consumption data of a park and multi-source heterogeneous data at the current moment, sending early warning and generating initial candidate metering points, after receiving the early warning, constructing a fault cause multi-dimensional evidence set, carrying out aggregation and confidence scoring on the fault cause multi-dimensional evidence set, starting secondary repeated mining and evidence reinforcement on candidate abnormal causes with high confidence, generating a structured positioning record and triggering corresponding treatment processes. According to the invention, through three steps of closed loop data management of digital ledger, NTP clock synchronization and credibility label, the problems of unified data quality, working condition self-adaptive early warning and minute-level accurate root cause positioning are achieved, and the problems of false report missing report and coarse positioning granularity caused by asynchronous multi-source data clocks, missing jump and fixed threshold in the prior art are solved.
assignees: GUONENG NINGXIA YUANYANG LAKE SECOND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Ocean ecological abnormity danger identification method and device based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine ecological abnormity risk identification method based on multi-source heterogeneous data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a multi-source heterogeneous data file of a target sea area; generating a quality control report according to the multi-source heterogeneous data file; establishing a marine information database according to multi-source heterogeneous data meeting a data quality standard; establishing an ocean numerical model on a cloud platform, and updating an ocean information database to obtain an updated ocean information database; acquiring a primary marine ecological anomaly index data product according to the updated marine information database; carrying out weighted average on each marine ecological anomaly index data product to obtain a secondary marine ecological anomaly index data product of a target sea area; and detecting a threshold value of the secondary marine ecological abnormal index data product, and if an abnormal index greater than a first preset threshold value exists, sending early warning information. The marine ecological abnormal danger identification method based on the multi-source heterogeneous data can effectively improve the accuracy of marine ecological abnormal danger identification.

title_en: Intelligent positioning navigation early warning system and method for boats
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of navigation and positioning, in particular to an intelligent navigation early warning system and method for a boat. The method comprises the steps of collecting and evaluating sea state sensing and positioning signals according to a multisource sensor synchronous data set to obtain a sensor reliability scoring table, analyzing target motion situation according to the sensor reliability scoring table to obtain a fusion situation vector diagram, judging target motion states according to the fusion situation vector diagram to obtain a target motion state judging result, evaluating multiple target collision risks according to the target motion state judging result to obtain a risk evaluation matrix, performing navigation maneuvering performance constraint according to the risk evaluation matrix to obtain a navigation planning maneuvering constraint rule set, and performing navigation track search according to the navigation planning maneuvering constraint rule set to obtain a navigation track scheme. According to the invention, the positioning accuracy, navigation safety and early warning system practicability of the ship under the complex environment are obviously improved through the positioning navigation early warning technology.

title_en: Intelligent management platform system for data integration of whole process of pond engineering construction
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent construction and digital twinning, and discloses an intelligent management platform system for the whole process data integration of the construction of a pond engineering, which comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module, a core data fusion and reasoning module, an intelligent application and evolution module and a comprehensive visualization and decision support module, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module is used for acquiring and standardizing construction data, the core data fusion and reasoning module is used for constructing a construction process causal map for representing the relation between elements, the credibility of each state node is calculated through a multi-source evidence theory fusion engine, the intelligent application and evolution module is used for carrying out risk forward propagation early warning and root cause backward retroactive diagnosis based on the construction process causal map, and the comprehensive visualization and decision support module is used for fusing and displaying an analysis result and a BIM/GIS model. According to the application, a causal knowledge graph and evidence fusion reasoning mechanism is constructed, so that the problems of data island and information uncertainty are solved, active early warning, accurate tracing and dynamic self-adaptation of a system of construction risks are realized, and the intelligent management level of the pond engineering is remarkably improved.

title_en: Coal mine safety data processing method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly relates to a coal mine safety data processing method based on multi-source data fusion. The method comprises the steps of collecting various data affecting coal mine safety, such as gas concentration, wind speed and the like, denoising by adopting a mixed filtering algorithm combined with multi-scale analysis, fusing the data by adopting an improved weighted average fusion algorithm, extracting key features by using an improved pearson correlation coefficient, and judging the safety state. The method includes denoising data through multi-scale decomposition and filtering, establishing a weight evaluation index system to dynamically adjust weights for data fusion, setting correlation threshold screening key features, and carrying out safe state prediction and early warning in time by adopting a support vector machine. The method can effectively improve the data quality, accurately judge the coal mine safety state, and has important significance for guaranteeing the coal mine safety production.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHIYIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Machine learning-based power transmission line high wind foreign matter tripping early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine learning-based power transmission line strong wind foreign matter tripping early warning method and a machine learning-based power transmission line strong wind foreign matter tripping early warning system, which belong to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance and artificial intelligence intersection of a power system, and comprise the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data in a power transmission line historical tripping record, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous data comprises a strong wind foreign matter tripping sample, tower static environment data and gas image data; preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data, preprocessing, introducing credibility assessment, dividing a processed sample set into a training set and a verification set according to time sequence, training and verifying a power transmission line high wind foreign matter tripping prediction model by using a XGBoost machine learning model, inputting power transmission line real-time meteorological data and tower static environment data into the trained power transmission line high wind foreign matter tripping prediction model to obtain probability values of occurrence of high wind foreign matter tripping of each tower in a future preset period, and performing high wind foreign matter tripping early warning when the probability values are larger than a dynamic early warning threshold value.
assignees: BAOJI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Sparse data-oriented meteorological missing information fusion filling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sparse data-oriented meteorological missing information fusion filling method, which relates to the technical field of meteorological detection and comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data source unit, a data preprocessing unit, a missing data detection unit, a missing data filling unit, a data reconstruction unit, a data fusion enhancement unit and a data evaluation unit; missing data shim cell, specifically for: the global information is fully mined, the local detail information is complemented, and the integrity of meteorological observation data is improved; the data reconstruction unit is specifically used for reconstructing fine scale details in the high-resolution image, complementing the space and time relevance, effectively solving the defect of insufficient details of the large-magnification image and improving the space-time resolution of the meteorological satellite image; the data fusion enhancement unit is specifically used for: and the accuracy and the reliability of the filled data are improved. By the structure, the invention solves the actual difficulties of difficult acquisition of the observed data, sparse observation stations, aging hysteresis and the like in the current prediction service of specific areas at home and abroad, meets the requirements of the meteorological service on the quality of the data, and promotes the high-quality development of modern meteorological enterprises such as smart weather monitoring, prediction early warning, disaster prevention and reduction and the like by high-precision meteorological element data.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY;NO 10 INST OF CETC

title_en: Intelligent benchmarking analysis method and system based on multidimensional data fusion
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent benchmarking analysis method and system based on multidimensional data fusion. The method comprises the steps of firstly determining various operation data related to the white feather broiler chicken raising process of a target enterprise, carrying out standardized definition, storing the data in a unified data storage layer, secondly detecting and cleaning data quality problems through a rule engine and a machine learning algorithm, then collecting historical data of all monitoring enterprises in the industry, establishing a multi-dimensional benchmarking analysis system, then processing the cleaned data based on the benchmarking analysis system to generate an improvement suggestion for the target enterprise, and finally carrying out real-time data acquisition and analysis to realize rapid processing and analysis of the real-time data. The application provides accurate business decision support and risk early warning for enterprises through intelligent data processing and analysis means.
assignees: BEIJING BOYA HEXUN AGRICULTURAL AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Marine environment monitoring data quality management method and system based on double inspection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a marine environment monitoring data quality management method and system based on a double inspection method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: dividing original data into input data of input equipment and data acquired by a sensor, and further dividing the input data and the data into a single source class and a multi-source class; s2: performing data abnormal value detection to obtain a first data abnormal value and a second data abnormal value; s3: obtaining the abnormal reason categories corresponding to the first data abnormal value and the second data abnormal value according to the magnitude of the difference value between the first data abnormal value and the second data abnormal value and the corresponding surrounding adjacent value; s4: alarming and correcting processing is carried out based on a preset alarming rule; s5: the data is stored in a corresponding database. Compared with the prior art, the invention integrates the inspection algorithm of data quality control into a software system, realizes automatic import, classification, quality inspection and early warning of the monitoring data result, and provides accurate and effective data support for marine environment supervision and management.

title_en: Reservoir water quality model prediction method and system based on big data
abstract_en: A reservoir water quality model prediction method and system based on big data relates to the technical field of water resource monitoring and management, and comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in a target reservoir range, marking the collection time, setting a collection period, carrying out data preprocessing on the multi-source heterogeneous data, carrying out real-time dynamic prediction and early warning on the target reservoir range according to the multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a long-term water quality prediction model, obtaining stability coefficient lower limit threshold values of various water quality indexes in the next collection period, carrying out water flow stability analysis on the target reservoir range, dividing the target reservoir range into a plurality of new grids according to analysis results, and carrying out ultra-short-term water quality prediction on the new grids to which early warning signals for generating water quality indexes belong, thereby obviously improving the reservoir water quality prediction precision and efficiency.

title_en: Auxiliary transportation management system based on video perception technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary transportation management system based on a video sensing technology, which relates to the technical field of transportation management and comprises a multi-source video sensing module, a data processing module, a scheduling decision module, a risk early warning module, a heterogeneous communication module and a distributed storage module, wherein the multi-source video sensing module is used for acquiring and transporting full-scene videos and environment multidimensional data, and comprises a multi-type camera unit, an environment parameter acquisition unit and an environment adaptation adjustment unit. Compared with the prior art, the video acquisition scene adaptation and data quality accurate optimization are realized by arranging the multi-source video perception module, and the video acquisition scene adaptation method can improve the pertinence and the accuracy of video data through custom deployment and quantization optimization, so that the problems of poor scene adaptation and data processing result deviation caused by lack of quantization basis in video quality optimization of video perception equipment in the prior art are solved.
assignees: SHANDONG XINYUNPENG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Website performance optimization supervision system and method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a website performance optimization supervision system and method based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the technical field of Internet, and are used for acquiring access feedback data of all webpages in a website to be checked, analyzing the running state of the webpages, determining the abnormal situation of the webpages, generating a directed weighted graph of the website according to the jump relation between the webpages, analyzing the abnormal sources of the webpages, obtaining the quality scores of the webpages based on the abnormal sources of the webpages, obtaining the quality scores of the website based on the quality scores of the webpages and the directed weighted graph of the website, monitoring the access feedback data of the webpages, finding the webpages related to the abnormal sources, analyzing the webpage and the website according to the abnormal sources, so that the quality evaluation of the webpage and the website is more reasonable, timely finding and processing the webpages related to the abnormal sources, obtaining better index scores when the website is subjected to inspection, facilitating the improvement of the image of the website, and checking and processing the abnormal sources, and improving the efficiency and speed of the website detection.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and automatic early warning system and method for channel construction safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring and automatic early warning system and method for channel construction safety, wherein the intelligent monitoring and automatic early warning system comprises a multi-mode sensing module, a data quality evaluation module, a dynamic risk evaluation module and an intelligent early warning module, wherein the multi-mode sensing module is used for collecting real-time monitoring data of a channel construction area, the data quality evaluation module is used for calculating data quality evaluation scores of various sensors in the multi-mode sensing module in real time, the dynamic risk evaluation module is used for adjusting data fusion weights based on the data quality evaluation scores and processing real-time monitoring data to generate an area comprehensive risk value, the intelligent early warning module is used for comparing the area comprehensive risk value with a dynamic risk threshold and triggering early warning signals, and the resource scheduling module is used for evaluating the scores according to early warning signal grades and data quality. The system has the advantages of remarkably improving the monitoring precision, improving the target recognition accuracy through multi-mode data fusion and quality evaluation, along with strong self-adaptive capacity, automatically adjusting system parameters according to environmental changes and sensor states, and keeping the optimal working state.
assignees: CCCC GUANGZHOU DREDGING CO LTD;CCCC SOUTH CHINA TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Medical field academic information intelligent retrieval analysis and traceability system based on AI drive
abstract_en: The invention relates to an AI-driven intelligent medical field academic information retrieval analysis and traceability system, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent medical academic information processing. The system comprises an academic tracking collaboration unit, an information format extraction unit, a depth interpretation rasterization unit, an academic tracing verification unit and an academic tracing verification unit, wherein the academic tracking collaboration unit builds an information priority quantization model based on a multi-source medical information priority ordering algorithm, the information format extraction unit extracts data format characteristics of multi-source medical information through a dynamic format adaptation iteration algorithm and a layering deviation early warning mechanism, the depth interpretation rasterization unit classifies and performs multi-dimensional analysis according to medical sub-fields by adopting an academic granularity weighted aggregation algorithm, and outputs academic granularity analysis results, the academic tracing verification unit receives all-link data and generates a verification report through multi-source comparison, abnormal point intelligent identification and tracing link visualization mechanism. The system effectively improves the information retrieval efficiency, analysis precision and traceability credibility of medical academic through the advanced fusion of the characteristics of the AI technology and the medical field, and provides high-efficiency data support for medical research.
assignees: SHANGHAI YIWANG NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pulmonary tuberculosis multimode fusion diagnosis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of diagnostics and discloses a pulmonary tuberculosis multi-modal fusion diagnosis system which comprises a data acquisition module, a multi-modal fusion module, an intelligent diagnosis module, an early warning output module and a system management module, wherein unified format conversion, coding and space-time registration are carried out on multi-source heterogeneous data from imaging equipment, laboratory systems and clinical records by formulating standardization and alignment rules of the multi-modal data, so that diagnosis information with different sources and different time sequences is ensured to have consistent structures and comparable references before fusion, and deep features of all modes are deeply integrated through feature extraction and fusion mechanisms, so that feature contradictions and noise interference caused by different data standards and information dislocation can be eliminated, consistency and reliability of a multi-modal fusion diagnosis information base are ensured, and diagnosis errors caused by original data quality defects are reduced.
assignees: SUZHOU FIFTH PEOPLES HOSPITAL SUZHOU OCCUPATIONAL DISEASE HOSPITAL SUZHOU INST OF LIVER DISEASE AND

title_en: Reservoir water quality model prediction method and system based on big data
abstract_en: A reservoir water quality model prediction method and system based on big data relates to the technical field of water resource monitoring and management, and comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in a target reservoir range, marking the collection time, setting a collection period, carrying out data preprocessing on the multi-source heterogeneous data, carrying out real-time dynamic prediction and early warning on the target reservoir range according to the multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a long-term water quality prediction model, obtaining stability coefficient lower limit threshold values of various water quality indexes in the next collection period, carrying out water flow stability analysis on the target reservoir range, dividing the target reservoir range into a plurality of new grids according to analysis results, and carrying out ultra-short-term water quality prediction on the new grids to which early warning signals for generating water quality indexes belong, thereby obviously improving the reservoir water quality prediction precision and efficiency.
assignees: WUHAN YIMIJING TECH CO LTD;WUHAN ZHUIYUE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban climate risk monitoring system based on multi-source data fusion and early warning application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart cities, in particular to a city climate risk monitoring system based on multi-source data fusion and an early warning application thereof. According to the invention, reliability of multi-source meteorological data is effectively enhanced by carrying out credibility grade assessment on a plurality of data sources, accuracy of data fusion and space positioning reliability are improved, sensitivity of risk precursor events and accuracy of factor propagation prediction are enhanced by utilizing depth identification of trend consistency and response delay relation, stability and space continuity of risk grade division are optimized by combining regional space continuity factors, space impedance characteristics are brought into diffusion path prediction, accurate deduction of urban climate risk space diffusion paths and dynamic marking of risk regions are realized, and accuracy and dynamics of urban climate risk monitoring and prevention and control decision are enhanced.
assignees: INST URBAN ENVIRONMENT CAS;SINO JAPAN FRIENDSHIP CENTER FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROT ENVIRONMENTAL DEVELOPMENT CENTER OF MINISTRY OF

title_en: Multi-mode data acquisition-cleaning integrated method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of Internet of things and artificial intelligence, and discloses a multi-mode data acquisition-cleaning integrated method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing a device description file through a protocol automatic matching layer, dynamically adapting to a communication protocol of a heterogeneous data source, and realizing plug and play of the device; performing time stamp verification and batch marking on an input data stream to generate a traceable source tag, processing the data stream in parallel by adopting a rule engine and a machine learning engine to finish anomaly detection, missing value filling and time sequence alignment, calculating a data quality Score QA Score based on a cross-modal quality assessment model, dynamically optimizing cleaning strategy parameters by a reinforcement learning scheduler, and outputting cleaned data to a storage system according to a standardized format. The method forms a closed loop of protocol abstraction, full-mode cleaning, quality quantification and self-evolution, reconstructs a real-time data management paradigm, and solves the problems of multi-mode data management protocol fragmentation, mode limitation, quality black box and strategy rigidification.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR INTELLIGENT TERMINAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hail early warning method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hail warning method based on multi-source data fusion, which belongs to the field of radio and comprises the following steps: acquiring sounding data, satellite data and radar data, performing data quality control, and sequentially calculating hail occurrence probabilities F1, F2 and F3; and obtaining hail occurrence probability F; and acquiring local operable image equipment and an operation range, searching whether a region with hail occurrence probability exceeding a preset value exists in the operable range, if so, sequencing the probability of the region with hail occurrence probability exceeding the preset value in the operable range, and sequentially issuing the hail attack instruction according to the hail occurrence probability from high to low. The invention can more accurately capture the occurrence, development and dissipation processes of hail weather through comprehensive observation, improve the accuracy and timeliness of forecasting, more comprehensively analyze the formation mechanism of hail, provide real-time monitoring data, help timely release hail early warning, reduce disaster loss and greatly improve the identification effect of hail.
assignees: CHENGDU YUANWANG SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD;CHENGDU YUANWANG OBSERVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Detection system and detection method for high-altitude falling object
abstract_en: The application discloses a detection system and a detection method for a high-altitude object, the system comprises a multi-sensor fusion module, an image acquisition module, a data processing module, a track prediction module, an early warning module and a data storage module. The application obviously improves detection precision and reduces false alarm rate by combining vibration, sound wave, radar and image data through a multi-sensor fusion technology, realizes real-time calculation of falling object falling points through a track prediction module, provides decision support for evacuation and protection, adopts cooperative work of infrared thermal imaging and a wide-angle camera to ensure all-weather monitoring around the clock, supports event backtracking and responsibility identification through a data storage module, and further ensures data credibility through the introduction of a blockchain technology. In addition, the system can be linked with equipment such as an elevator and a roadblock, so that active protection is realized, and the public safety level is greatly improved.
assignees: BEIJING SHUTONG MAGIC SQUARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unified management system for multi-source heterogeneous data of railway facilities
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of railway facility data management, in particular to a railway facility multi-source heterogeneous data unified management system which comprises a data acquisition module, a data quality evaluation module, a data standardization module, a data consistency verification module, a data analysis module and a fault diagnosis module. The system carries out quality assessment, standardization processing and consistency verification by collecting the original data of the track detection, contact net detection and power supply monitoring system in real time, finally stores the data in a distributed database, and generates a device state assessment report and fault early warning information. The application can effectively solve the problems of the dispersibility and the isomerism of the railway facility data, improve the accuracy and the reliability of data integration, realize the intelligent operation and maintenance management of data driving and improve the economy and the stability of the railway facility operation.
assignees: RESEARCH INST OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECHNOLOGY CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMIT;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd

title_en: Meteorological service center data visualization and interaction platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meteorological service center data visualization and interaction platform, in particular to the field of meteorological data visualization, which comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and preprocessing module, a space-time fusion and data enhancement module, a distributed storage and intelligent indexing module, a dynamic visualization module, an intelligent decision and early warning module and an interaction module; the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source meteorological data through an API and a protocol, carrying out wavelet transformation noise reduction processing by utilizing an edge computing node, carrying out space-time alignment and fusion, filling missing data by using an LSTM, realizing dynamic visualization and interaction by using WebGL and ARCore/ARKit, integrating WRF and Transformer to generate early warning information and pushing decision suggestions through a natural language interface, providing accurate meteorological early warning for a user by combining a WRF numerical model and a Transformer algorithm, constructing a geospatial index based on the GeoHash algorithm, realizing efficient geospatial query and data retrieval, providing a real-time feedback mechanism and a multidimensional visual view, and optimizing user operation flow and experience.
assignees: JIANGXI METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER JIANGXI PROFESSIONAL METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY JIANGXI METEOR

title_en: Automatic processing method for hydrologic information forecast data collection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of big data processing, in particular to a hydrologic information forecast data collection automatic processing method, which comprises the steps of automatically collecting and accessing multi-source data, intelligently diagnosing and processing data quality and early warning abnormality, constructing a multi-index comprehensive drought assessment model, intelligently predicting drought trend, performing GIS spatial analysis and visual display, and dynamically reflecting drought evolution; user-defined configuration and adaptive learning. The method can display the state condition of equipment, prompt related personnel to conduct station measurement maintenance in time, fully apply the existing hydrologic data of hydrologic bureau, determine single items such as rainfall, river flow, soil moisture content and the like to determine drought level, comprehensively judge drought according to a plurality of indexes according to proportion, determine drought diagrams of the whole administrative division area of Xinjiang by utilizing an interpolation method and an adjacent correlation method based on a GIS technology, and automatically sort out soil moisture content brief report materials according to the analysis data.
