assignees: XINJIANG UYGUR AUTONOMOUS REGION HYDROLOGY BUREAU

title_en: Park energy consumption monitoring and early warning method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a park energy consumption monitoring and early warning method and system based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of energy monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical energy consumption data of a park and multi-source heterogeneous data at the current moment, sending early warning and generating initial candidate metering points, after receiving the early warning, constructing a fault cause multi-dimensional evidence set, carrying out aggregation and confidence scoring on the fault cause multi-dimensional evidence set, starting secondary repeated mining and evidence reinforcement on candidate abnormal causes with high confidence, generating a structured positioning record and triggering corresponding treatment processes. According to the invention, through three steps of closed loop data management of digital ledger, NTP clock synchronization and credibility label, the problems of unified data quality, working condition self-adaptive early warning and minute-level accurate root cause positioning are achieved, and the problems of false report missing report and coarse positioning granularity caused by asynchronous multi-source data clocks, missing jump and fixed threshold in the prior art are solved.
assignees: GUONENG NINGXIA YUANYANG LAKE SECOND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Street grain particulate matter distribution monitoring system with multisource sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource sensor fusion street and valley particulate matter distribution monitoring system, which relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring and comprises a particulate matter distribution monitoring platform, wherein the particulate matter distribution monitoring platform is in communication connection with a sensor network module, a multisource data fusion module, an air quality model module, a trend prediction module and an air quality early warning module, the sensor network module is used for deploying a plurality of sensor nodes according to the spatial structure characteristics of the street and valley. According to the invention, by arranging a plurality of sensor nodes, according to the spatial structure characteristics of streets and valleys, the subdivided areas such as streets and roadways are covered on the whole surface, the problem that the traditional fixed monitoring stations are difficult to comprehensively monitor is effectively solved, the collection of particulate matter concentration data at different positions is ensured, the data quality is optimized through a data fusion algorithm, the noise and the error are reduced, and the coverage area and the accuracy of monitoring are remarkably improved.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING JIAOTONG;CHONGQING TRAFFIC RESOURCES DEV CO LTD

title_en: Hail early warning method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hail warning method based on multi-source data fusion, which belongs to the field of radio and comprises the following steps: acquiring sounding data, satellite data and radar data, performing data quality control, and sequentially calculating hail occurrence probabilities F1, F2 and F3; and obtaining hail occurrence probability F; and acquiring local operable image equipment and an operation range, searching whether a region with hail occurrence probability exceeding a preset value exists in the operable range, if so, sequencing the probability of the region with hail occurrence probability exceeding the preset value in the operable range, and sequentially issuing the hail attack instruction according to the hail occurrence probability from high to low. The invention can more accurately capture the occurrence, development and dissipation processes of hail weather through comprehensive observation, improve the accuracy and timeliness of forecasting, more comprehensively analyze the formation mechanism of hail, provide real-time monitoring data, help timely release hail early warning, reduce disaster loss and greatly improve the identification effect of hail.

title_en: A earth anchor calculates auxiliary measuring and calculating system for electric power construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anchor calculation auxiliary measuring and calculating system for electric power construction, which relates to the technical field of anchor construction, and comprises the following components: and the data input module is used for inputting the ground anchor information and receiving the related parameters of the electric power construction ground anchor input by a user. According to the invention, the microprocessor is combined with ground anchor data to evaluate the safety condition, the sensor calibration module calibrates the sensor and provides accurate original data for the real-time monitoring data fusion module, the data are integrated and then are provided for the safety evaluation of the microprocessor, the data quality evaluation module evaluates the instruction of the microprocessor and provides basis for the abnormality and early warning module, the module receives related data, the data abnormality with small deviation is corrected by a moving average algorithm and a smooth and linear interpolation method, and the modules and the algorithms are matched to realize the functions of accurate safety evaluation, effective early warning and risk prediction, so that the method is beneficial to popularization.
assignees: HUADA TIANYUAN BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent data quality monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent data quality monitoring method and system, which comprises the steps of performing data processing on multi-source heterogeneous data by using a unified data model, inputting historical data as a training set to a pre-training model for training and optimizing to obtain an optimized pre-training model, performing threshold judgment on standardized distribution data streams by using the optimized pre-training model in combination with a self-adaptive threshold module, inputting a processed abnormal event list to a context sensing and dynamic priority management module for deduplication and optimization transmission, performing root analysis on the deduplication optimized abnormal event list by using a root analysis tool, generating a restoration strategy by using a restoration suggestion engine for assistance on a root analysis result, and inputting the restoration strategy and a visual report to a cross-platform monitoring interface to generate a restoration suggestion and an early warning notification. According to the invention, the data blood-margin map is constructed based on the map database, so that minute-level tracing of abnormal events is realized, and the fault investigation time is shortened by 50%.

title_en: Intelligent high-voltage switch cabinet fault diagnosis method and system based on heterogeneous graph structure learning
abstract_en: A fault diagnosis method and system for intelligent high-voltage switch cabinet based on heterogeneous graph structure learning comprises the following steps: collecting, cleaning and processing sensor data of the intelligent high-voltage switch cabinet; using an unsupervised anomaly detection algorithm to find an anomaly value to distinguish an operation state from an anomaly state, including using a K-means algorithm to separate a normal value and an anomaly value in data and using an isolated forest algorithm to perform anomaly detection on the data, and adopting a union of anomaly data of the two algorithms as finally screened anomaly data; constructing a switch cabinet fault diagnosis database; and designing an abnormal composition structure learning algorithm, finding out a representation space which accords with the data similarity measurement of the heterogeneous sensors, and automatically learning the interaction relation of the heterogeneous group component sensor network of the intelligent high-voltage switch cabinet. The invention has the advantages that: abnormal points in the sensor data distribution are accurately perceived, the marking efficiency is obviously improved, the accuracy and the credibility of data marking are ensured, and the accuracy of fault diagnosis of the high-voltage switch cabinet is obviously improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Partial discharge real-time monitoring and early warning system based on multisource data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of discharge monitoring and early warning, in particular to a partial discharge real-time monitoring and early warning system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein a signal physical separation module is used for classifying a decision tree of a mixed transient signal flow to separate pure electromagnetic wave velocity type signal sources and mechanical wave velocity type signal sources; the feature marking module extracts feature points with unified time references and marks physical attribute categories, the dual-path credibility fusion module respectively executes time difference logic verification on the two types of feature points, marks credible discharge events only when an electromagnetic wave verification result and a mechanical wave verification result are simultaneously logic value 1, generates event confidence parameters through dynamic confidence fusion, achieves physical interlocking verification and uniqueness locking, dynamically adjusts response threshold values based on the event confidence parameters, only confirms real discharge to physical essence, and triggers targeted response to threat that the confidence meets standards, solves the problem of distinguishing real discharge events from multi-source interference, and reliably identifies the real discharge events.
assignees: CHONGQING ZHONGJIQING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic negative pressure monitoring and AI deep venous thrombosis risk early warning health information system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep venous thrombosis risk early warning health information system for dynamic negative pressure monitoring and AI, which relates to the technical field of intelligent medical health information, and comprises a dynamic negative pressure sensor module, a multi-mode data acquisition module, a waveform primitive analysis module, a layered attention fusion module, a risk assessment classifier module and an early warning output module; the dynamic negative pressure sensor module is used for continuously collecting dynamic negative pressure signals of the lower limb part of the user. The deep venous thrombosis risk early warning health information system based on dynamic negative pressure monitoring and AI solves the problem of multi-source heterogeneous physiological data fusion, converts an original dynamic negative pressure signal into a symbolized primitive sequence with definite physiological significance, fundamentally improves data quality, realizes self-adaptive fusion of multi-mode data and accurate focusing of key time slices, improves the specificity and robustness of a risk assessment model, and reduces false alarm phenomenon caused by physiological activity interference.
assignees: THE FIRST AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF ZHEJIANG UNIV COLLEGE OF MEDICINE THE FIRST HOSPITAL OF ZHEJIANG PR

title_en: Landslide risk trend intelligent analysis method and device based on trend prediction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide risk trend intelligent analysis method and device based on a trend prediction model, and relates to the technical field of landslide risk data analysis. According to the method, multisource time sequence monitoring data are collected through the micro-core pile and the auxiliary sensor, intelligent data analysis processing is conducted based on workflow built in the micro-core pile, interference data optimization and data quality analysis are completed, high reliability of the data is guaranteed, intelligent analysis is conducted based on a trend prediction model, future landslide risk is predicted, model prediction stability judgment and feedback adjustment are conducted, and risk judgment and early warning execution are conducted by combining real-time monitoring data with known environmental factors such as rainfall. According to the invention, through multi-level data optimization, stability feedback adjustment and comprehensive analysis of environmental factors, the accuracy and instantaneity of landslide risk prediction are effectively improved, the early warning capability is enhanced, and particularly, a more stable and reliable risk analysis result can be provided under the low-power and external interference environment.

title_en: Wind turbine generator system fault early warning method and system based on multi-mode data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind turbine generator fault early warning and discloses a wind turbine generator fault early warning method and system based on multi-modal data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-modal sensor data and performing space-time alignment pretreatment; the method comprises the steps of extracting multi-modal features by adopting methods such as variable modal decomposition, STL decomposition and the like, realizing cross-modal fusion by adopting a dimension self-adaptive projection and multi-head attention mechanism, carrying out weighted fusion by calculating dynamic weights based on three factors of data quality, fault type correlation and information gain, constructing a dynamic unit topological graph, capturing cross-unit correlation features by adopting a space-time diagram convolution network, realizing long-time early warning with confidence degree by combining a Bayesian neural network through double-branch gating fusion, identifying multi-fault modes by adopting multi-label classification, and optimizing operation and maintenance decisions by adopting a self-adaptive large neighborhood search algorithm. The method can realize the long early warning window of the offshore wind turbine and provide uncertainty quantification and intelligent operation and maintenance decision support.
assignees: GUODIAN POWER HUNAN LANGSHAN WIND POWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Structural monitoring data fusion probability abnormality early warning method based on streaming super threshold and evidence reasoning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structure monitoring data fusion probability abnormity early warning method based on a streaming type super-threshold value and evidence reasoning, which comprises the steps of establishing a historical data set of each sensor as sample data, carrying out temperature effect separation on the sample data, extracting response components after removing the temperature effect as an initial data set for abnormity detection, determining an initial threshold value, constructing the super-threshold value data set, fitting the super-threshold value data set, obtaining posterior probability distribution of shape parameters and scale parameters through Bayesian inference, calculating probability distribution of early warning trigger values, calculating an abnormity certainty index, dynamically updating the probability distribution of the early warning trigger values through the streaming type super-threshold value method, and synthesizing through the evidence fusion method to obtain a fusion abnormity certainty index. The method can form fusion anomaly certainty, further better benefits the conflict among indexes, avoids early warning false alarm caused by single sensor faults, and provides a certain data support for maintenance of the structure.

title_en: Sleep stage method and system based on two-way non-contact sensing and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of physiological signal processing and deep learning, and discloses a sleep stage method and a sleep stage system based on double-path non-contact sensing and deep learning, wherein a non-contact type sensor is arranged below a mattress to collect multi-source signals by utilizing a non-contact type multi-channel body movement signal collecting module, and the multi-source signals are fused; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a multi-mode signal preprocessing module to call multi-source signals of a non-contact multi-channel body movement signal acquisition module, carrying out synchronous, denoising, artifact correction and segmentation standardization processing on the multi-source signals, utilizing a deep learning sleep stage module to call signals processed by the multi-mode signal preprocessing module, adopting a deep learning network to extract and classify space-time characteristics of the processed signals, establishing an end-to-end deep learning model, utilizing a sleep stage output and analysis module to call the deep learning model established by the deep learning sleep stage module, generating a sleep structure diagram and sleep quality index through the deep learning model, and carrying out abnormal early warning.
assignees: NINGBO DIGITAL TWIN DONGFANG INST OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: New energy data integration method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy equipment data integration and processing, in particular to a new energy data integration method and system. By constructing a three-dimensional unified storage array of equipment, time and state, and establishing an intelligent processing chain comprising scheduling, acquisition, calculation, storage and feedback. The processing flow is driven by a dynamic priority scheduling mechanism, the data quality is ensured by adopting two-channel data acquisition and multi-level verification, differential analysis and multi-equipment cooperation degree comparison are further executed to realize grid-level risk early warning, and finally, the data consistency is ensured by strict write arbitration and version control. The whole system has abnormal self-adaptive processing and feedback optimization capability, and the high efficiency, the robustness and the intelligent level of the new energy mass heterogeneous data integrated processing are remarkably improved.

title_en: Adapter service life prediction system based on digital twinning and dynamic early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based adapter life prediction system and a dynamic early warning method, wherein the system comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a digital twin model construction module, a data coordination module, a life prediction module and a calibration module; the invention breaks through the unidirectional static analysis limitation of the traditional life prediction technology by constructing the adapter full life cycle digital twin body, realizes the dynamic health assessment under the drive of multidimensional data, creatively provides a cross-dimension feature fusion and closed loop calibration mechanism, effectively solves the problems of weak relevance of multi-source asynchronous data and delayed sudden abnormal response, remarkably improves the stability and credibility of a prediction result under complex working conditions by the synergistic effect of an opposing generation network and an attention model, and can adapt to the severe use environment of an industrial adapter, thereby providing a quantifiable and traceable decision support for the intelligent operation and maintenance of power electronic equipment.

title_en: Heavy rain terminal early warning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heavy rain early warning, in particular to a heavy rain terminal early warning method and system based on deep learning, and consistency judgment is carried out on the turning state of the rain gauge and image characteristics such as a rain curtain, a water trace and the like, so that effective elimination of unnatural triggering factors (such as artificial water pouring and the like) is realized, and the credibility of rainfall sensing data is improved. And a locally-deployed double-branch deep learning model is adopted, multi-source data such as rainfall, temperature and humidity, topography factors and the like are fused, feature extraction and reproduction period prediction are performed based on a cross attention mechanism, and a threshold correction coefficient is dynamically generated by combining historical events, so that the self-adaptive adjustment of early warning standards is realized, and the false alarm and false alarm risk is effectively reduced. The system supports low-power-consumption local operation, performs early warning decision, and effectively improves timeliness and accuracy of local early warning response.

title_en: Digital archive management system based on multidimensional information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital archive management system based on multidimensional information fusion, which relates to the technical field of digital archive management and comprises an identity authority management module, a data fusion module, a monitoring audit module and a comprehensive analysis module; by monitoring and evaluating the user identity verification, the authority management and the user operation and data fusion process, the security, the data quality and the monitoring capability of the system are improved, the system can ensure that only authorized users access sensitive information, the availability and the accuracy of data are improved, the user operation is monitored, the risk is evaluated, the abnormal situation is found in time, the early warning is carried out, the system can comprehensively grasp the system operation condition through comprehensive evaluation of the monitoring force, and the safety management and the use of the digital file are effectively ensured.
assignees: BEIJING ZHIQI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geographic grid-based public service facility supply and demand matching site selection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a public service facility supply and demand matching site selection method and system based on a geographic grid, which integrates multi-source heterogeneous data by adopting the geographic grid, maps population, land utilization and other data to a unified grid, combines statistics and space anomaly detection to ensure data quality, reduces manual operation and lowers technical thresholds, enables non-professionals to develop analysis through a standardized process, lays accurate data foundation for subsequent work, simultaneously fuses domestic space planning and current situation data, builds population prediction models to deduce future distribution, brings planning data into analysis, adapts the result to urban development requirements for 5-10 years, gives consideration to foresight and operability, provides a long-term decision basis for government, finally quantifies accessibility gaps through a Gaussian two-step mobile search method, combines a greedy algorithm to iteratively screen optimal scheme, and clear facility construction priority, avoids resource idling and repeated construction, and ensures that newly-added facilities fill service gaps with high efficiency.
assignees: GUANGDONG URBAN & RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN INSTITUTE TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line defect hidden danger prediction method and system based on multi-source meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting hidden danger of a transmission line defect based on multisource meteorological data, which relate to the technical field of prediction of hidden danger of the transmission line defect, and comprise the steps of dividing the transmission towers in a transmission tower distribution diagram into areas based on geographic information, dividing the transmission towers with the same geographic information into one area, numbering the areas to obtain numbered areas, establishing a historical line defect association model, predicting the meteorological data according to multisource, the method comprises the steps of obtaining weather-influencing parameters of a power transmission tower and weather-influencing parameters of a wire, obtaining the regional quality index, enabling a predictor to predict that line defects can occur in the power transmission tower and the wire in a numbering region under the weather-influencing of a multi-source weather environment in the future, sequencing the numbering region through early warning indexes of the power transmission line, obtaining maintenance line information, enabling the predictor to make a maintenance plan faster, and reducing maintenance cost of the power transmission line.

title_en: Efficient prediction method and system for pipe network operation and maintenance data
abstract_en: A high-efficiency prediction method and system for pipe network operation and maintenance data combines protocol access and automatic format conversion technology, realizes unified acquisition and hierarchical transmission of multi-source heterogeneous data, solves the problems of low acquisition efficiency and inconsistent formats of traditional pipe network data, and secondly, adopts a Kalman filtering to perform anomaly detection and correction by a real-time verification completion mechanism, and completes missing data by an interpolation algorithm, thereby improving data quality and timeliness. In the data integration stage, structural cleaning and archiving are carried out based on a preset data model, a high-efficiency data basis is provided for a subsequent prediction model, finally, time sequence features and space association analysis are fused, a joint feature space is constructed through event feature marks, a prediction model is trained by utilizing a collaborative modeling module, potential fault points are accurately identified, an operation and maintenance optimization plan is intelligently generated, real-time sharing and interactive display of a prediction result are realized through a decision pushing and visualizing module, and closed-loop management from data acquisition to prediction decision is realized.
assignees: GUANGDONG ANGWEI ENVIRONMENTAL PROT INDUSTRIAL CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster risk intelligent early warning method integrating multi-source information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent flood disaster risk early warning method integrating multi-source information, and relates to the technical field of flood disaster prediction, wherein the method acquires multi-source data such as meteorological, hydrology, topography, remote sensing, ground monitoring terminals and the like, and a unified data set is constructed through time synchronization, space resampling, outlier rejection and missing data filling; the method comprises the steps of constructing multidimensional space-time characteristics based on elements such as rainfall process, terrain characteristics, earth surface coverage, drainage capacity, river network structure and soil humidity, inputting the space-time characteristics into a multisource information fusion model, predicting flood occurrence probability in future time period, generating flood risk indexes according to the prediction probability, real-time monitoring and historical samples, dividing regional risks into different grades, automatically generating and releasing early warning information according to the risk grades, and carrying out feedback correction on early warning results through on-site monitoring and inspection data to achieve self-adaptive updating of early warning parameters and model structures.
assignees: GUANGXI VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF WATER RESOURCES AND ELECTRIC POWER;Jiangsu Climate Center

title_en: Intelligent data quality monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent data quality monitoring method and system, which comprises the steps of performing data processing on multi-source heterogeneous data by using a unified data model, inputting historical data as a training set to a pre-training model for training and optimizing to obtain an optimized pre-training model, performing threshold judgment on standardized distribution data streams by using the optimized pre-training model in combination with a self-adaptive threshold module, inputting a processed abnormal event list to a context sensing and dynamic priority management module for deduplication and optimization transmission, performing root analysis on the deduplication optimized abnormal event list by using a root analysis tool, generating a restoration strategy by using a restoration suggestion engine for assistance on a root analysis result, and inputting the restoration strategy and a visual report to a cross-platform monitoring interface to generate a restoration suggestion and an early warning notification. According to the invention, the data blood-margin map is constructed based on the map database, so that minute-level tracing of abnormal events is realized, and the fault investigation time is shortened by 50%.
assignees: JIANGXI TONGRUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Abnormality detection method for multi-source sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides an anomaly detection method for multi-source sensor fusion, and belongs to the technical field of operation and maintenance of power supply systems. According to the invention, a multisource sensor acquisition network covering a transmission line, a transformer substation, a power distribution network and environment auxiliary types is constructed, effective data with the integrity standard of data is screened by combining edge calculation, the problems of limitation and data quality of a single sensor are solved, a multidimensional data source is provided for fusion detection, then effective data is preprocessed and time-space aligned to obtain structured data, the quality and compatibility of the data are optimized, characteristics are extracted to form a data set, after reduction and normalization optimization, a fusion characteristic vector is obtained by weighting by a double-attention mechanism, the problem of single conventional fusion weight is solved, finally the optimal algorithm detection is matched by depending on a multi-algorithm switching module, grading early warning is output, the problems of insufficient adaptation of the single algorithm and confusion of early warning response are solved, and abnormal accurate detection, efficient response and flexible adaptation of a power supply system are realized.
assignees: LUOHE POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fishing port supervision method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fishing port supervision method and system based on multi-source data fusion. The method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting sensing data from an optical image sensor, a radio frequency positioning signal receiver and an environment parameter sensor, uniformly converting multi-source sensing data to the same space-time reference, processing and analyzing the sensor data to extract target observation information, fusing the multi-source observation information of the same target by adopting an evidence reasoning method based on dynamic confidence weight of each sensor to generate fused target information with comprehensive confidence, performing cross-modal identity verification and association on the fused target information to construct fishing port comprehensive situation information, and performing real-time analysis on the situation information and generating an alarm according to predefined complex event mode rules. The system comprises a perception layer, a data fusion and processing center and an intelligent early warning module. The invention realizes all-weather, high-precision and intelligent active supervision of the fishing port through multi-source data fusion.
assignees: CRCC HARBOUR & CHANNEL ENGINEERING BUREAU GROUP SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional visual emergency management system for mining area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining area emergency management, and discloses a three-dimensional visual emergency management system for a mining area, which comprises a data acquisition module and a three-dimensional sand table generation module. The three-dimensional sand table generation module processes the data through a three-dimensional visualization engine, wherein a data preprocessing unit completes space coordinate system unification, missing data complementation and outlier correction, and a scene rendering unit generates a three-dimensional dynamic sand table through texture mapping, space feature fusion, space coupling modeling and three-dimensional scene synthesis. The system has the functional modules of offline data loading, disaster diffusion simulation, escape route planning and the like, and supports cross-platform rendering and user interaction operation. According to the invention, three-dimensional dynamic display and emergency analysis of multi-source data of a mining area are realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of disaster early warning and emergency decision are improved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA ANBANG SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Adapter life prediction system and dynamic early warning method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based adapter life prediction system and a dynamic early warning method, wherein the system comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a digital twin model construction module, a data coordination module, a life prediction module and a calibration module; the invention breaks through the unidirectional static analysis limitation of the traditional life prediction technology by constructing the adapter full life cycle digital twin body, realizes the dynamic health assessment under the drive of multidimensional data, creatively provides a cross-dimension feature fusion and closed loop calibration mechanism, effectively solves the problems of weak relevance of multi-source asynchronous data and delayed sudden abnormal response, remarkably improves the stability and credibility of a prediction result under complex working conditions by the synergistic effect of an opposing generation network and an attention model, and can adapt to the severe use environment of an industrial adapter, thereby providing a quantifiable and traceable decision support for the intelligent operation and maintenance of power electronic equipment.
assignees: SHENZHEN JUMBO ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Knowledge graph construction method and system based on disaster caused by electrical fault
abstract_en: The invention discloses a knowledge graph construction method and system based on disaster caused by electrical faults, and belongs to the technical field of electrical fire early warning and intelligent security. The method comprises the steps of constructing an electric fault disaster-causing multi-source data acquisition system, dynamically adjusting an acquisition strategy based on a safety threshold, establishing an electric fire disaster-causing link relation library, identifying an entity relation mode specific to an electric fault through an electric field specific corpus and a field word embedding technology, establishing a knowledge graph with dynamic evolution capability, adopting an incremental updating mechanism and a partition life cycle management, solving entity attribute conflict based on credibility weighted fusion, constructing an electric fire situation awareness model, carrying out early warning threshold self-adaptive optimization, and generating an analysis report containing technical responsibility and management responsibility through a multi-stage disaster-causing factor backtracking mechanism. The full-chain closed-loop management from perception, cognition to decision of the electrical fire risk is realized, and the accuracy and the traceability depth of fire early warning under a complex environment are obviously improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI YIJING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source signal fatigue driving detection method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-source signal fatigue driving detection method, a device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring time sequence data of multiple types of information in the driving process; cutting the time sequence data of the multiple types of information to obtain multiple time sequence data fragments; respectively carrying out quality evaluation on the time sequence data fragments, and determining a target judgment model matched with each time sequence data fragment from the judgment models according to the data quality evaluation grade; judging the time sequence data fragments through the respectively determined target judgment models to obtain a final total fatigue degree prediction result; and comparing the total fatigue degree prediction result with an early warning threshold value to judge whether to carry out early warning prompt to a driver. The characteristics of the data of the driver are effectively mined by using a plurality of data fusion methods, the data of different qualities are matched with the judging model, higher detection precision is achieved, the fatigue state of the driver is comprehensively measured, and the driving risk is reduced by reminding.
assignees: BEIJING ANXINCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tropical region offshore marine meteorological fusion analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tropical region offshore marine meteorological fusion analysis method which comprises the following steps of firstly collecting and preprocessing data, secondly controlling data quality, namely checking the data and analyzing error characteristics of marine meteorological observation data, thirdly, performing intelligent fusion on the quality-controlled multi-source data fusion analysis system in the tropical region, constructing a marine meteorological fusion analysis data set, fourthly, constructing a coupling analysis model, performing coupling analysis on marine meteorological elements by combining a physical model and a numerical simulation technology, finding early warning rules and influence factors of the marine meteorological system by simulating and predicting interaction process between marine meteorological elements and the atmosphere, and thirdly, dynamically applying and evaluating the data in real time, and finding and analyzing potential marine meteorological disaster risk.
assignees: HAINAN INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Multi-source geological disaster information intelligent processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent processing method of multisource geological disaster information, which particularly relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, wherein multisource monitoring data such as remote sensing images, earth surface deformation, weather, ground water level, earthquake micro-motion and the like are collected and preprocessed to form a feature vector set, a credibility weight matrix is built based on data continuity and consistency evaluation, a main disaster factor combination feature is extracted through a self-adaptive feature extraction model, a disaster evolution map is built by combining historical disaster data, and geological disaster early warning output is triggered when the node attribute variation rate in the map exceeds a threshold value and an abnormal path chain is formed in the continuous monitoring process.
assignees: NANJING KENTOP CIVIL ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide risk trend intelligent analysis method and device based on trend prediction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide risk trend intelligent analysis method and device based on a trend prediction model, and relates to the technical field of landslide risk data analysis. According to the method, multisource time sequence monitoring data are collected through the micro-core pile and the auxiliary sensor, intelligent data analysis processing is conducted based on workflow built in the micro-core pile, interference data optimization and data quality analysis are completed, high reliability of the data is guaranteed, intelligent analysis is conducted based on a trend prediction model, future landslide risk is predicted, model prediction stability judgment and feedback adjustment are conducted, and risk judgment and early warning execution are conducted by combining real-time monitoring data with known environmental factors such as rainfall. According to the invention, through multi-level data optimization, stability feedback adjustment and comprehensive analysis of environmental factors, the accuracy and instantaneity of landslide risk prediction are effectively improved, the early warning capability is enhanced, and particularly, a more stable and reliable risk analysis result can be provided under the low-power and external interference environment.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGGUANCUN ZHILIAN SAFETY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Smart manhole monitoring system using multiple sensors
title_ko: 다중 센서를 이용한 스마트 맨홀 감시시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart manhole monitoring system using multiple sensors, which prevents a gas accident, comprising: a manhole cover (1) for opening and closing a manhole; a manhole monitoring device (100) including a proximity sensor (110), a wireless communication unit (170), and a control unit (180); and a control server (200) including a manhole management engine (230).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 센서를 이중으로 구비하고, 그 구비되는 이중의 센서 중 어느 하나가 오작동 시 다른 하나의 센서를 통해 오작동 여부를 인지하여 대응가능하게 안내할 뿐만 아니라 이중으로 구비되는 센서 2개 모두가 오작동을 하더라도 이 또한 인지하여 대응가능하게 안내하는 다중 센서를 이용한 스마트 맨홀 감시시스템에 관한 것으로, 도로에 형성되는 맨홀을 개폐시키는 맨홀덮개(1)와; 맨홀 내부에 설치되는 것으로, 상기 맨홀덮개(1)을 근접감지하여, 맨홀의 존재여부를 나타내는 맨홀 존재감지신호를 생성하는 근접센서(110), 맨홀 내부에 설치되는 것으로, 상기 맨홀덮개(1)의 기울기 변위를 감지하여, 맨홀덮개(1)의 기울기 정도를 나타내는 맨홀 기울기감지신호를 생성하는 자이로센서(120), 신호를 송수신하는 통신 인터페이스 기능을 수행하는 무선통신부(170), 상기 근접센서(110) 및 상기 자이로센서(120)로부터 입력되는 맨홀 존재감지신호 및 맨홀 기울기감지신호를 판독하고, 그 판독된 결과로 맨홀 존재감지신호의 경우 맨홀덮개(1)가 있는 것으로 확인되고, 맨홀 기울기감지신호의 경우 맨홀덮개(1)가 기울어진 것으로 확인되면, 맨홀덮개(1)를 식별하는 덮개식별자정보, 맨홀덮개(1)의 위험상황을 안내하는 맨홀경보정보 및 근접센서(110)의 고장을 안내하는 센서 고장안내정보를 포함하는 맨홀경보신호를 상기 무선통신부(170)를 통해 무선전송되도록 제어하는 제어부(180)를 포함하는 맨홀 감시장치(100)와; 상기 맨홀 감시장치(100)로부터 무선전송되는 맨홀경보신호를 참조하여, 서버운영자가 확인가능하게 맨홀경보신호 내역을 디스플레이부(210)를 통해 출력되도록 제어하는 맨홀관리엔진(230)을 포함하는 관제서버(200);로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SAEMON TECH CO LTD;DS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sea surface pollution intelligent monitoring system based on multisource data
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent sea surface pollution monitoring system based on multi-source data, which comprises an integrated analysis module, an information topology module, an sea surface monitoring module and a data transmission module, wherein the sea surface monitoring module is used for acquiring sea surface pollution monitoring data, the data transmission module is used for realizing interactive communication between the sea surface monitoring module and the information topology module, the interactive communication comprises the transmission of the sea surface pollution monitoring data to the integrated analysis module, the integrated analysis module and the information topology optimization module are used for analyzing and early warning the multi-source data, integrating, cleaning and analyzing the data, identifying and correcting errors, anomalies or noise in the data, ensuring the accuracy and credibility of the data, and performing intelligent decision distribution after the data information is mined by utilizing deep learning, thereby improving the monitoring, early warning and emergency response capability of sea surface pollution events. Through the module, the all-round, three-dimensional and real-time monitoring and early warning of offshore sudden pollution are realized.
assignees: HANGZHOU CENTER OF CHINA ACADEMY OF SPACE TECH

title_en: Power distribution cabinet operation dynamic safety assessment analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution cabinet operation dynamic safety assessment analysis method and a system thereof, which relate to the technical field of safety assessment analysis; the method has the advantages of improving data quality and consistency by effective data preprocessing, ensuring more accurate and timely abnormality detection by comprehensive safety analysis coefficient and detailed abnormality grade evaluation, and ensuring the safety and reliability of a power distribution system by timely alarming and maintenance measures. In general, the method remarkably improves the efficiency and effect of dynamic safety assessment of the operation of the power distribution cabinet, reduces potential safety hazards, ensures stable operation of a power system, calculates a safety analysis coefficient FXZ by using a formula, and realizes comprehensive safety assessment based on multi-source data. Compared with the traditional method, the method has the advantages of remarkably improving accuracy, flexibility, instantaneity and early warning capability.
assignees: LIYANG SHUNQIAN HARDWARE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent risk early warning method and system for prefabricated box girder production in bridge engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk early warning, in particular to an intelligent risk early warning method and system for prefabricated box girder production in bridge engineering. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional data acquisition network to acquire data, preprocessing the acquired multi-dimensional data, constructing a multi-source data fusion engine and establishing a data quality scoring mechanism to realize data fusion, predicting risk of the fused data by utilizing a multi-mode fusion analysis model, and performing intelligent linkage response based on the predicted risk. Through reinforcement learning scheduling and equipment linkage control, intelligent coordination of production elements such as personnel, equipment and technology is realized, the efficiency of key working procedures is improved by 20% -30%, and the resource waste is reduced by more than 15%.
assignees: SHANDONG HI SPEED ENG CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: White spirit product carbon label management method and system
abstract_en: S1, collecting carbon emission activity data of a white spirit product in a full life cycle, wherein the life cycle comprises raw material planting, brewing production, packaging and logistics transportation links, and cleaning and standardizing the collected data to obtain a structured data set; S2, performing anomaly detection and data verification on the structured data set to ensure that the data quality meets the carbon footprint calculation requirement. According to the invention, a full life cycle data acquisition system covering raw material planting, brewing production, packaging and logistics transportation is constructed, and multi-source heterogeneous data is cleaned and standardized, so that a unified and standard structured data set is formed, and the problems of insufficient data integrity and non-uniform reference caused by manual input and local acquisition due to scattered and different sources of traditional carbon footprint accounting data are solved.
assignees: SHANXI XINGHUACUN FEN JIU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional heterogeneous data targeting risk causal reasoning method for whole cereal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional heterogeneous data targeted risk causal reasoning method for whole cereal food, which is suitable for grain safety early warning. In order to solve the problems of large quantity of missing of spot check data and lack of omnibearing target risk early warning in the whole cereal risk early warning, the method constructs a whole cereal risk index system comprising attribute information indexes and hazard indexes, acquires detection data based on index items, cleans the detection data, fills up missing data based on a generated countermeasure network, calculates the weight of indexes in the hazard index system by using an entropy weight method, determines the risk value of a secondary index and a primary index of each sample, then carries out whole cereal multidimensional heterogeneous data label coding and risk level analysis, and finally carries out whole cereal risk target cause and effect reasoning based on a Bayesian network. The invention improves the accuracy and the credibility of the spot check data, characterizes the risk degree of the whole cereal food, improves the causal reasoning precision and can realize the dynamic risk early warning.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY & BUSINESS

title_en: Intensive care system and method based on multidimensional data fusion and intelligent early warning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical data processing, and provides an intensive care system based on multidimensional data fusion and intelligent early warning, which comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the multi-source data acquisition module is used for acquiring vital sign data, image data, laboratory test data and environment monitoring data of a patient in real time; the multi-dimensional data fusion engine is connected with the data preprocessing module and is used for fusing the multi-source data by adopting a self-adaptive weighted fusion algorithm to generate a comprehensive health index. Through dynamic weight distribution (clinical importance+real-time credibility), the error rate of the comprehensive health index is reduced by 42%, the DNN model based on LSTM is sensitive to trend abnormity, the detection rate of high risk events is improved by 35%, the false alarm rate is reduced by 28%, the problem of fusion deviation caused by medical data isomerism is solved, and the early warning delay is remarkably reduced by combining LSTM time sequence analysis.
assignees: LISHUI CITY PEOPLES HOSPITAL

title_en: Multi-dimensional-based medicine production data monitoring and management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional-based medical production data monitoring and management system and a multi-dimensional-based medical production data monitoring and management method, and particularly relates to the field of data monitoring and management, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a multi-dimensional analysis module and a data storage module; the invention acquires multi-source data such as production flow, quality index, equipment state and environmental parameter in real time through a data acquisition module, after cleaning, de-duplication and standardization treatment through a preprocessing module, a multi-dimensional analysis module is used for constructing a production-quality-equipment-environment collaborative analysis framework, a quantization model and an associated algorithm are used for carrying out data fusion and intelligent research and judgment, comprehensive analysis results comprising efficiency optimization, quality assessment, fault early warning and environment regulation are generated, and finally, the safety, high-efficiency management and life cycle maintenance of the data are realized through a layered storage module.
assignees: DONGYING PINGMING PHARMACEUTICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Composite high-temperature drought dynamic early warning method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite high-temperature drought dynamic early warning method based on multi-source data fusion, which belongs to the technical field of big data analysis and mining, and comprises the following steps: collecting multisource observation data in a region to form a unified grid data matrix, carrying out marking and interpolation processing on the missing data to generate a weight matrix, identifying potential abnormality, dividing grid abnormality levels, adjusting data risk fusion weight factors, analyzing region composite risk indexes, determining region composite high-temperature drought risk early warning levels, the composite high-temperature drought dynamic early warning method based on multi-source data fusion provided by the invention realizes unified acquisition, spatial alignment and quality assessment of multi-source data, improves data reliability, performs gridding risk calculation, combines sliding average and threshold judgment to realize dynamic region risk early warning, can simultaneously consider the composite effect of high temperature and drought, quantifies risk level, and improves early warning accuracy, timeliness and reliability.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-sensor data fusion control method for automatic assembly line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sensor data fusion control method for an automatic assembly line, which relates to the technical field of data fusion and comprises the following steps of: when multi-source data fusion is carried out, firstly, data information is obtained in real time through a multi-source sensor, and the obtained data information is preprocessed, so that the accuracy and the integrity of the data are ensured. According to the invention, through analyzing the data quality and the fusion performance index and the system robustness and the environment adaptability index in real time, the system can accurately detect the influence of electromagnetic interference and environment fluctuation on the data and dynamically evaluate the state. And when the system is abnormal, an early warning and adjustment strategy is automatically triggered, so that the continuity of data fusion is ensured, and the downtime and human intervention are reduced. When the abnormality exceeds the self-repairing capability of the system, the system can give out early warning, ensure the efficient and safe operation of the production line and improve the capability of coping with the sudden problem.
assignees: JIANGXI LONGEN INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Data quality assessment method and system based on rule engine and machine learning
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a data quality assessment method and a data quality assessment system based on a rule engine and machine learning, which are characterized in that multisource heterogeneous data is accessed through a unified interface, massive data is processed in parallel by adopting a slicing mechanism and a working pool, regular matching, rule verification such as a numerical range and an enumeration value are executed on structured data, K-means clustering anomaly detection and self-encoder feature extraction are executed on unstructured data, the rule engine and the machine learning dual-mode analysis are innovatively fused, six-dimensional quality indexes are dynamically calculated, and finally a multi-format visual report is generated by an aggregation result. The embodiment of the invention solves the problems of single traditional evaluation dimension, static stiffness of rules, low processing efficiency and the like, shortens the actual measurement hundred million-level data evaluation time to 30 minutes, achieves 92.5 percent of abnormality detection accuracy, comprehensively supports 12 data sources such as databases, file systems, cloud storage and the like, and meets the multidimensional monitoring requirement of ISO 8000 international standards on data quality.
assignees: CENTURY LONGMAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Harm early warning method based on environment real-time big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hazard early warning method based on real-time big data of environment, which relates to the technical field of environment detection and has the technical scheme that a data acquisition module acquires the environment in real time through multiple channels to obtain the environment data; the data processing module acquires the environment data, performs data cleaning, data normalization and data fusion processing on the environment data to form an environment data matrix with a unified format, and the analysis and evaluation module acquires the environment data matrix, calculates an environment quality index EQI and acquires environment quality evaluation. According to the invention, multi-source data are acquired through various acquisition methods such as an Internet of things sensor, a remote sensing satellite, an unmanned aerial vehicle and social media, so that more comprehensive environment detection data are provided, and meanwhile, the acquired environment data are subjected to data cleaning, data normalization and data fusion processing, so that the complexity of environmental factors and the influence of acquisition errors on the environment data can be effectively reduced, and more accurate early warning information is obtained.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ANHUAN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: River flow missing data reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river flow missing data reconstruction method which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a river network topological structure, quantifying hydraulic correlation, S2, carrying out space-time feature fusion and multi-source information extraction, S3, carrying out multi-task collaborative flow reconstruction and confidence prediction, S4, carrying out dynamic weighting and result correction on meteorological factors, and S5, carrying out anomaly detection and dynamic model updating. The method comprises the steps of setting a river flow missing data reconstruction method, mutually fusing and using all steps, performing topology-aware space-time diagram convolution, namely encoding a river network topological structure into a weighted adjacent matrix for the first time, extracting spatial correlation characteristics through a diagram convolution network, solving the problem of neglecting hydraulic connection in the traditional method, performing a multi-task collaborative learning mechanism, namely synchronously outputting a flow reconstruction value and confidence level, combining topology smoothness constraint, realizing reconstruction reliability quantification while guaranteeing accuracy, and performing meteorological dynamic weighting correction, namely dynamically adjusting node weights based on real-time rainfall intensity, and accurately adapting nonlinear response of water flow in a heavy rainfall period.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCIAL WATER CONSERVANCY INVESTMENT JIANGHE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multisource protection information aggregation and anomaly verification method and system
abstract_en: A multisource protection information gathering and abnormality checking method and system comprise the steps of collecting physical parameters, pressing plate states and recording data in a set period after an action event occurs, extracting characteristic data, inputting the action event and the characteristic data into a pre-training abnormality detection algorithm to judge whether the operation is abnormal, identifying a secondary equipment function, acquiring expected source data corresponding to the secondary equipment function from a dispatching center, calculating expected pressing plate states of corresponding secondary equipment according to the expected source data if all the expected source data are acquired, setting priorities for different source data if the expected pressing plate states are acquired, calculating expected pressing plate states according to the priorities of existing data and the missing data if the missing data priority is lower than a set threshold, otherwise suspending abnormality detection of the secondary equipment, sending early warning, and judging whether the pressing plate is abnormal or not according to the pressing plate states and the expected pressing plate states for the secondary equipment which is not suspended. The invention reduces false alarm and missing alarm and ensures the safety of system operation.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Permanent basic farmland quality intelligent monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a permanent basic farmland quality intelligent monitoring system and method, which realize accurate monitoring and dynamic management through multi-module cooperation, calculate terrain gradient and canopy height based on LiDAR point cloud, generate complexity index in combination with meteorological data, improve an A-algorithm to optimize an unmanned aerial vehicle inspection path, extract hyperspectral data to analyze soil and crop states, calibrate an electrode response curve, calculate biological effectiveness index in combination with humiture and dynamically adjust an early warning threshold value, identify abnormal data by adopting an isolated forest algorithm and conduct grading treatment, merge multisource data by adopting space-time Kriging interpolation and CNMF algorithm to construct a space-time cube, synthesize indexes such as ecological protection level, economic value and the like to generate a graded soil quality index model, generate disease thermodynamic diagram and store key data in an uplink, and realize farmland quality real-time monitoring, risk early warning and ecological economic balance decision through multisource heterogeneous data fusion, dynamic weight optimization and block chain technology.

title_en: Electric power metering and electric charge accounting system based on multi-source data and intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power metering and electric charge accounting system based on multi-source data and an intelligent algorithm, which relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-source power credibility weighted fusion model and outputting multi-source credibility weighted fusion power; S2, carrying out section-level correction and equivalent electric quantity calculation on electric energy flowing in a current settlement time slice, S3, constructing a user side clear electric quantity distribution model, carrying out dynamic calculation on the clear electric quantity of a user, S4, constructing an electric charge base number model, carrying out dynamic pricing on the clear electric quantity, S5, optimizing the obtained electric charge base number, and S6, establishing an anomaly identification and dynamic verification mechanism. The invention forms a full-link intelligent system by constructing a credible fusion mechanism of multi-source heterogeneous data, realizing self-calibration modeling of a metering point topological structure, introducing a precise clearing method oriented to user contracts and line losses, and combining a strategy-driven electricity fee accounting model and a cross-period consistency anomaly detection mechanism.
assignees: GANSU SHINING SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multisource data fusion supervision system for geological disaster management engineering
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster engineering supervision, and particularly discloses a multi-source data fusion supervision system for geological disaster management engineering, which is characterized in that the real-time acquisition, multi-protocol analysis, high-precision time synchronization, advanced denoising, missing value interpolation, outlier filtering and preliminary feature extraction of data are realized at a data source end, so that the data quality and the real-time performance are remarkably improved, and the processing load of a central platform is reduced; the real-time state mapping of the physical world and the virtual space and the recognition and correction scheme matching of the abnormal result of the disaster management project realize the matching of the multistage early warning linkage and the automatic emergency plan, provide visual and comprehensive visual display and decision support, greatly improve the supervision efficiency, early warning accuracy and emergency response speed, provide reliable technical guarantee for the safe and stable operation of the geological disaster management project, and effectively reduce the disaster risk and economic loss.

title_en: Automatic DCMM evaluation system based on multi-source heterogeneous data integration mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic DCMM evaluation system based on a multi-source heterogeneous data integration mechanism, which relates to the technical field of data quality management, wherein the automatic DCMM evaluation system comprises a data source management module, a data integration module, a data quality evaluation module, a data quality diagnosis module and a data quality monitoring module, wherein the modules are connected by electric signals, and the data source management module is used for accessing various types of data sources and collecting original multi-source heterogeneous data from a plurality of data sources. According to the invention, the accuracy and the integrity of the data are improved by comprehensively monitoring and evaluating the data quality, the abnormal early warning coefficient is calculated, the potential data quality risk is identified in time, when the data quality abnormality is detected, the early warning mechanism is automatically triggered, and the alarm is sent to inform related personnel, so that the data quality problem can be found and solved at the first time, and the reliability and the credibility of the data are improved.
assignees: DATA EASY BEIJING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and analyzing steam leakage of shaft seal of steam turbine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of steam turbine shaft seal leakage monitoring, and provides a steam turbine shaft seal leakage monitoring analysis method and a system, wherein in the system, a distributed monitoring sensor is used for collecting multisource heterogeneous shaft seal working parameters of a steam turbine in real time and carrying out fusion treatment on the shaft seal working parameters; the monitoring cloud platform is used for generating a steam leakage trend curve, correcting the steam leakage trend curve, generating a fitting prediction curve by combining abnormal amplitude of a rotor, performing predictive analysis on seal working parameters by combining a pre-trained seal prediction model, and outputting a seal state evaluation result, the early warning feedback module is used for triggering a classification early warning instruction to be sent to a visual user end in an encrypted manner, and the visual user end is used for analyzing the classification early warning instruction into classification early warning information and visually presenting the classification early warning information. The invention reduces the influence of noise and other interference factors, improves the data quality, and can monitor the steam leakage of the shaft seal more accurately.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;HUANENG POWER INT INC DANDONG POWER PLANT

title_en: Multi-source data fusion law enforcement record generation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data fusion, in particular to a system and a method for generating a law enforcement record of multi-source data fusion, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the data acquisition module normalizes and eliminates repeated data, the anomaly detection module performs data check and cleaning, the information source evaluation module performs quantization scoring on the data source, the weight adjustment module dynamically adjusts the weight based on the scoring, the data fusion module performs weighted fusion and field check, and the collaborative law enforcement record is output. In the invention, the data quality is further ensured by calculating the checksum deviation value of the data value range, and the reliability of the data set is enhanced by removing the abnormal data. Quality evaluation and input fairness of the data sources are ensured through quantization scoring and dynamic weight adjustment, so that law enforcement records are more comprehensive and authoritative. The refined data processing not only improves the accuracy of law enforcement records, but also strengthens the safety and the integrity of information, thereby remarkably improving the response speed and the decision quality of law enforcement institutions.

title_en: Mining new energy vehicle risk early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining new energy vehicle risk early warning system and a mining new energy vehicle risk early warning method, which relate to the field of data mining equipment and comprise the steps of collecting multi-source sensing data of a mining new energy vehicle, a mining operation working condition label, a real-time position of a mining area vehicle and mining area environment state information; the method comprises the steps of carrying out modal reliability assessment on multi-source sensing data according to mining area environment state information to obtain dynamic confidence weight, carrying out weighted fusion on the multi-source sensing data based on the dynamic confidence weight to generate fusion sensing characteristics, constructing a multi-mode large model based on the multi-source sensing data and the mining area environment state information, inputting the fusion sensing characteristics and mine operation working condition labels into the multi-mode large model to output thermal runaway risk probability, constructing a space-time diagram structure based on real-time position of a mining area vehicle and the thermal runaway risk probability, and calculating a risk propagation value by fusing initial risk of a single vehicle, inter-vehicle distance and aging attenuation factors based on a risk diffusion dynamics model and introducing the space-time diagram structure.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY SAFETY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Automatic driving system reliability self-diagnosis method and platform based on multi-mode sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic driving system reliability self-diagnosis method and platform based on multi-mode sensor fusion, the method comprises the steps of obtaining image mode data, carrying out feature extraction by utilizing a vision transducer model, generating an environment scene tag, representing the type of a current environment, carrying out statistics on key mode features in actual automatic driving operation data, obtaining a mode scoring vector corresponding to each environment scene tag, reflecting priori credibility of each sensor mode in the environment, calculating mode trust weight by softmax, obtaining a confidence weight vector, carrying out weighted fusion on the key mode features based on the confidence weight vector, obtaining fusion features, generating mode reconstruction features according to the fusion features, generating a mode consistency error vector based on the mode reconstruction features, combining the confidence weight vector and the mode consistency error vector, and determining an early warning signal of the current system, wherein the early warning signal is used for judging whether fusion degradation or mode failure risk exists in the system.

title_en: Fatigue driving monitoring and early warning method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fatigue driving monitoring and early warning method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, and relates to the technical field of multi-source data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting and preprocessing the face, physiological signs, historical driving behaviors, vehicle environment and maintenance multi-source data of a driver; and then three layers of fusion are carried out, wherein the unified dimension of the data layer is aligned with time, the characteristic layer is used for constructing a fatigue characteristic index FCF, the decision layer is used for calculating a fatigue driving risk index FDR by adopting an entropy weight-AHP combined weighting method, four early warning grades are divided for hierarchical early warning through cluster analysis based on the FDR value, and meanwhile, the robustness of the system is improved through sensor fault switching, data conflict resolution and personalized baseline calibration. The invention fuses all-link data of 'physiological-behavior-environment-vehicle', and obviously improves the accuracy, early stage and reliability of fatigue monitoring.
assignees: TIANJIN RICHSOFT ELECTRIC POWER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;SIJI ZHILIAN TIANJIN INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-attention sleep system and method for polymorphic sleep data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-attention sleep system and method for multi-state sleep data fusion, comprising a data acquisition module, a signal preprocessing module, a frequency division multiplexing module, a characteristic extraction module, a model training module, a sleep stage module, a correlation analysis module and an early warning system module, wherein the data acquisition module is responsible for acquiring environmental data and physiological data of a user, the signal preprocessing module is used for dividing, normalizing and denoising acquired EEG and EOG signals, the frequency division multiplexing module is used for decomposing a preprocessed signal frame into a plurality of narrow-band signals by using a frequency division multiplexing technology, the characteristic extraction module is used for extracting characteristics from the decomposed narrow-band signals, the model training module is used for training the characteristics, the sleep stage module is used for carrying out real-time or off-line sleep stage through the trained model, the sleep quality evaluation module is used for calculating sleep quality indexes based on the result of the sleep stage, the correlation analysis module is used for carrying out correlation analysis on the relations between different sleep stages and the sleep quality indexes, the quality evaluation model is generated, and the early warning system module is used for setting early warning threshold according to the sleep quality evaluation result and the quality evaluation model.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN TOURISM

title_en: Hanger state monitoring method, system, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of monitoring of lifting appliances, and particularly discloses a method, a system, a terminal and a medium for monitoring the state of a lifting appliance, wherein the method is used for realizing real-time state confirmation by acquiring multiple sensor signals corresponding to preset key states of the lifting appliance and combining time alignment processing and multi-source signal consistency judgment; and further predicting the fault trend of the sensor through a trained state prediction model and generating a pre-maintenance suggestion. The system and the terminal are provided with corresponding functional modules, so that high-reliability monitoring of the state of the lifting appliance and fault early warning are realized cooperatively, and the monitoring accuracy and the safety guarantee level are remarkably improved. By introducing a multi-sensor redundancy detection mechanism, misjudgment or missed judgment caused by single sensor faults is effectively avoided, and reliability and accuracy of detection of the key state of the lifting appliance are remarkably improved.
